trans-unit.source: The second line under the title in the grid, the tag, the carousel and the panel; `Meta` when null.
trans-unit.target: 网格、标签、轮播和面板中标题下方的第二行；为 null 时使用 `Meta`。

trans-unit.source: Any object of yours (the record behind the card).
trans-unit.target: 你的任意对象（卡片背后的记录）。

trans-unit.source: The name on the card, the floating tag, the detail and the bottom panel.
trans-unit.target: 卡片、悬浮标签、详情和底部面板上的名称。

trans-unit.source: The value on the right of a list row and a carousel caption, and on a cover ("$96", "2 pieces").
trans-unit.target: 列表行右侧以及轮播说明和封面上的值（"$96"、"2 pieces"）。

trans-unit.source: Arc's line chart: one or more measures over time with series toggles, a crosshair that glides between points and a tooltip that follows on its own spring. Lines draw in from the left the first time the chart is seen, and a new range morphs every line from the shape on screen (resampled on shared x positions) while the value axis springs to its new range and the gridlines ride it. A hidden series flattens into the baseline as it fades. Motion is code-driven (`MotionValue` and a per-point spring array) because every animated value is a coordinate inside one self-drawn geometry, which ControlTheme transitions cannot express.
trans-unit.target: Arc 折线图：一个或多个随时间变化的度量，带有系列切换、在数据点之间滑动的十字准线，以及按自身弹簧跟随的提示框。图表首次出现时，线条从左侧绘制出现；切换到新范围时，每条线会从屏幕上的形状变形（在共享的 x 位置上重新采样），同时数值轴以弹簧移动到新范围，网格线随之移动。隐藏的系列会在淡出时压平到基线。动效由代码驱动（`MotionValue` 加上每个点的弹簧数组），因为每个动画值都是同一幅自绘几何图形中的一个坐标，而 ControlTheme 过渡无法表达这一点。

trans-unit.source: Smooth monotone curves that never swing past the data, or straight segments.
trans-unit.target: 平滑的单调曲线（不会超出数据范围），或直线段。

trans-unit.source: Keys of hidden series. Two-way; the legend toggles it.
trans-unit.target: 隐藏系列的键。双向绑定；图例可切换其显示状态。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the legend shows or hides a series; the argument carries the hidden series keys.
trans-unit.target: 图例显示或隐藏系列时引发；参数包含隐藏系列的键。

trans-unit.source: Keeps the current shapes on screen, dimmed and breathing, while the next range loads.
trans-unit.target: 加载下一范围期间，保留当前图形并使其变暗并呈呼吸效果。

trans-unit.source: Horizontal gridlines at the value ticks.
trans-unit.target: 在数值刻度处显示水平网格线。

trans-unit.source: Series toggles. Null shows the legend when there is more than one series.
trans-unit.target: 系列切换项。为 null 时，若系列多于一个则显示图例。

trans-unit.source: The category (time) axis labels under the plot.
trans-unit.target: 绘图区下方的分类（时间）轴标签。

trans-unit.source: The value axis labels in the right-hand gutter.
trans-unit.target: 右侧边距中的数值轴标签。

trans-unit.source: Formats value-axis ticks. Defaults to a compact number, such as 1.2K.
trans-unit.target: 设置数值轴刻度的格式。默认为紧凑数字，例如 1.2K。

trans-unit.source: Fixes the top of the value axis (default: the next nice tick above the data).
trans-unit.target: 固定数值轴的顶部（默认：数据之上的下一个整齐刻度）。

trans-unit.source: Fixes the bottom of the value axis (default: zero, or the data minimum when it dips below).
trans-unit.target: 固定数值轴的底部（默认：零；若数据最小值低于零，则为数据最小值）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the cell as an accent-colored link with an underline that strengthens on hover. A click on the text raises `CellInvoked` with `Part`; the cell is not selected by that click.
trans-unit.target: 把单元格显示为强调色链接，下划线在悬停时加深。点击文字会以 `Part` 触发 `CellInvoked`；该次点击不会选中单元格。

trans-unit.source: The Login block as one control: it shows one of the five sign in and sign up layouts, chosen by `Variant`. Each layout is also a control of its own (`SignIn`, `LoginCentered`, `LoginSplit`, `LoginImmersive`, `SignupForm`) with its own properties and events; `Form` is the one being shown, so a host that switches layouts at run time configures it after each switch.
trans-unit.target: 以一个控件呈现登录区块：它显示五种登录与注册布局之一，由 `Variant` 选择。每种布局本身也是一个控件（`SignIn`、`LoginCentered`、`LoginSplit`、`LoginImmersive`、`SignupForm`），拥有各自的属性和事件；`Form` 是当前显示的那一个，因此在运行时切换布局的宿主需要在每次切换后再配置它。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Form` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Form` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Variant` changed and `Form` is a new control; configure it here.
trans-unit.target: `Variant` 变更且 `Form` 为新控件时触发；请在此处进行配置。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Variant` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Variant` 属性。

trans-unit.source: A passkey-first sign in and sign up screen (Arc's Login › Centered block): a card on a quiet ring backdrop that morphs from the passkey view through an email address and a six digit code to the signed-in account, with single sign-on buttons, a sign in / sign up switch in the top bar and a status line in the footer. Steps rise into place out of a small blur while the card's height follows on a spring; the resend countdown rolls; the backdrop drifts with a fine pointer.
trans-unit.target: 以通行密钥为先的登录与注册界面（Arc 的 Login › Centered 区块）：卡片位于安静的环形背景上，依次从通行密钥视图变为邮箱地址、六位验证码，最终变为已登录的账号；卡片上有单点登录按钮，顶栏有登录 / 注册切换，页脚有状态行。步骤从轻微模糊中浮现，卡片高度随弹簧动画跟随变化；重发倒计时以滚动方式显示；背景随细微的指针移动而漂移。

trans-unit.source: The account the card shows: the address a code was sent to, or the signed-in address.
trans-unit.target: 卡片显示的账号：验证码发送到的地址，或已登录的地址。

trans-unit.source: The code the simulated email contains (Arc's `demoCode`); shown as helper copy while no `VerifyCodeAsync` is set.
trans-unit.target: 模拟邮件中包含的验证码（Arc 的 `demoCode`）；在未设置 `VerifyCodeAsync` 时作为辅助文字显示。

trans-unit.source: The account a simulated passkey or single sign-on resolves to (Arc's `demoEmail`).
trans-unit.target: 模拟通行密钥或单点登录解析到的账号（Arc 的 `demoEmail`）。

trans-unit.source: The text of the email field (Arc's `email` state); two-way. Kept when the card moves between views.
trans-unit.target: 邮箱输入框的文本（Arc 的 `email` 状态），双向绑定。卡片切换视图时保留。

trans-unit.source: True while a request runs (sending or checking a code, a provider); actions are ignored meanwhile.
trans-unit.target: 请求执行期间为 True（发送或校验验证码、第三方登录）；期间的操作会被忽略。

trans-unit.source: Fill the host with no frame (Arc's `fullScreen`): no border, square corners, no minimum height. Off by default: a framed 640px block.
trans-unit.target: 填满宿主且无框（Arc 的 `fullScreen`）：无边框、直角，且没有最小高度。默认关闭：为带框的 640px 区块。

trans-unit.source: All built-in text; replace the object to localize or reword it.
trans-unit.target: 所有内置文字；替换该对象即可本地化或改写。

trans-unit.source: How the person signed in (meaningful on the Done view).
trans-unit.target: 用户的登录方式（在完成视图上有意义）。

trans-unit.source: Sign in (default) or create an account; two-way. Setting it moves the card as the top bar's switch does.
trans-unit.target: 登录（默认）或注册账号；双向绑定。设置该值时，卡片会随顶栏的开关一起切换。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a footer link is activated; handle it to open the destination yourself.
trans-unit.target: 页脚链接被激活时触发；处理此事件可自行打开目标。

trans-unit.source: The passkey request: Idle, Waiting (the device is asked) or Verified.
trans-unit.target: 通行密钥请求的状态：Idle、Waiting（向设备发起验证）或 Verified。

trans-unit.source: The footer's Privacy link (Arc's `privacyHref`).
trans-unit.target: 页脚 Privacy 链接的地址（Arc 的 `privacyHref`）。

trans-unit.source: Seconds before another code can be requested (Arc's `RESEND_SECONDS`, 30).
trans-unit.target: 再次请求验证码前需等待的秒数（Arc 的 `RESEND_SECONDS`，30）。

trans-unit.source: Raised once a sign in or sign up succeeds (Arc's `onSignIn(email, method, mode)`).
trans-unit.target: 登录或注册成功后引发（Arc 的 `onSignIn(email, method, mode)`）。

trans-unit.source: Executed with the `LoginCenteredSignedInEventArgs` after `SignedIn`.
trans-unit.target: 在 `SignedIn` 之后，以 `LoginCenteredSignedInEventArgs` 作为参数执行。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Sign out returns the card to the passkey view.
trans-unit.target: 当 "Sign out" 使卡片返回通行密钥视图时触发。

trans-unit.source: The line in the footer, also announced to screen readers ("Code sent to …").
trans-unit.target: 页脚中的状态行，同时也会由屏幕阅读器朗读（"Code sent to …"）。

trans-unit.source: The view on show: Passkey, Email, Code or Done.
trans-unit.target: 正在显示的视图：Passkey、Email、Code 或 Done。

trans-unit.source: The footer's Terms link (Arc's `termsHref`). An in-page address (`#terms`) only says in the status line where it would go.
trans-unit.target: 页脚的条款链接（Arc 的 `termsHref`）。页内地址（`#terms`）只会在状态行中说明它将去往的位置。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `NavigateEvent`: a footer link was activated. Set `Handled` to open the destination yourself; otherwise an absolute `http`, `https` or `mailto` address opens with the platform launcher, and an in-page address (`#terms`, Arc's default) only says in the status line where it would go.
trans-unit.target: `NavigateEvent` 的参数：页脚链接已被激活。设置 `Handled` 可自行打开目标；否则绝对地址 `http`、`https` 或 `mailto` 会由平台启动器打开，而页内地址（`#terms`，Arc 的默认值）只会在状态行中说明将前往的位置。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SignedInEvent` (Arc's `onSignIn(email, method, mode)`).
trans-unit.target: `SignedInEvent`（Arc 的 `onSignIn(email, method, mode)`）的参数。

trans-unit.source: Data for `FormChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `FormChanged` 的事件数据。

trans-unit.source: A full-page magic-link sign-in over a picture: the product's mark and a sign-in / sign-up switch along the top, a frosted glass card in the middle, a note and the legal links along the bottom. The card walks through three steps: the email form (with single sign-on buttons under "or"), the Sent step (an envelope folds shut over the address, Open mail app, and a resend countdown) and the Done step (a drawn check, the account and the method, Sign out).
trans-unit.target: 整页式魔法链接登录，覆盖在图片之上：顶部为产品标识与登录 / 注册切换，中部为毛玻璃卡片，底部为说明文字与法律链接。卡片依次经过三个步骤：邮箱表单（在 "or" 下方提供单点登录按钮）、已发送步骤（信封在地址上方折叠合上、打开邮件应用按钮，以及重发倒计时）和完成步骤（绘制的对勾、账号与登录方式、退出登录）。

trans-unit.source: The address the link went to, or the signed-in address (trimmed, lower case); null on the form.
trans-unit.target: 链接发送到的地址，或已登录的账号地址（已去除首尾空白并转为小写）；表单页上为 null。

trans-unit.source: The product's mark: an outline on a 20-unit box, drawn 2.25 wide with round ends. Null draws the default notebook mark.
trans-unit.target: 产品标识：在 20 单位的方框上绘制的轮廓，线宽 2.25，线端为圆头。为 null 时绘制默认的笔记本标识。

trans-unit.source: The product's name in the header and the headings ("Fieldnote").
trans-unit.target: 产品名称，显示在页眉和标题中（"Fieldnote"）。

trans-unit.source: The address a provider sign-in uses in the demo when the email field holds no valid address.
trans-unit.target: 当邮箱输入框中没有有效地址时，第三方登录在演示中使用的地址。

trans-unit.source: The text of the email field (two way).
trans-unit.target: 邮箱输入框的文本（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: True while the page waits for a send, the mail app or a provider.
trans-unit.target: 页面等待发送、邮件应用或第三方登录时为 True。

trans-unit.source: Fills its container edge to edge with square corners (the page is the whole window). False (default): a block with 26px corners and at least 640px high.
trans-unit.target: 以直角从边到边填满其容器（页面即整个窗口）。False（默认）：圆角为 26px、高度至少 640px 的区块。

trans-unit.source: Shows "or" and the single sign-on buttons (default true).
trans-unit.target: 显示 "or" 以及单点登录按钮（默认为 true）。

trans-unit.source: Every text the page shows or announces.
trans-unit.target: 页面显示或播报的全部文字。

trans-unit.source: A link went out (the first one, or another from the Sent step).
trans-unit.target: 链接已发出（第一次发送，或在已发送步骤中再次发送）。

trans-unit.source: The mail app's address (for example `mailto:`). With one (and no `OpenMailAppAsync`), Open mail app opens it and the page waits on the Sent step for `CompleteSignIn`; without one it runs the demo.
trans-unit.target: 邮件应用的地址（例如 `mailto:`）。设置后（且没有 `OpenMailAppAsync`），打开邮件应用会打开它，页面停留在已发送步骤，等待 `CompleteSignIn`；否则运行演示。

trans-unit.target: 登录（默认）或创建账号（两种模式，双向切换）；头部的开关会切换它。

trans-unit.source: Terms, Privacy or the mail app was chosen. Handle it to open the destination yourself.

trans-unit.target: 裁剪图片时保持在视野内的焦点，以分数表示（默认 0.5, 0.58：居中，略低于中线）。

trans-unit.source: The provider the person signed in with, or null.
trans-unit.target: 用户登录所使用的第三方登录方式，或 null。

trans-unit.target: 单点登录的第三方登录方式，每个对应一个等宽按钮。为空（默认值）时显示 Google、Apple 和 GitHub。

trans-unit.target: 已发送步骤中再次发送链接前需等待的秒数（30）。

trans-unit.source: The person signed in (the emailed link, a provider, or `CompleteSignIn`).
trans-unit.target: 用户已登录（通过邮件链接、第三方登录或 `CompleteSignIn`）。

trans-unit.target: 用户在完成步骤中退出登录（或调用了 `SignOut`）时触发。

trans-unit.target: 服务条款的地址。未设置时，"Terms" 会在页脚显示一条说明。

trans-unit.source: The demo's delays.
trans-unit.target: 演示的延迟时间。

trans-unit.source: Every text a `LoginImmersive` page shows or announces, with English defaults. Sentences that carry a value (the product, an address, a provider, a count of seconds) are functions.
trans-unit.target: `LoginImmersive` 页面显示或播报的所有文字，附英文默认值。携带值（产品、地址、第三方登录、秒数）的句子为函数。

trans-unit.source: A single sign-on provider of a `LoginImmersive` page: one equal-width button in the row under "or", with the provider's mark before its name. The name also fills the busy and success sentences ("Opening {name}").
trans-unit.target: `LoginImmersive` 页面的单个单点登录提供方：位于 "or" 下方一行中的等宽按钮，名称前显示提供方的标识。名称也用于忙碌和成功提示（"Opening {name}"）。

trans-unit.source: The provider's mark on a 24-unit box, filled with `MarkBrush` (null: the button's text colour).
trans-unit.target: 提供方的标识，位于 24 单位的方框中，以 `MarkBrush` 填充（为 null 时使用按钮的文字颜色）。

trans-unit.source: The fill of `Mark`; null follows the button's text colour in both themes.
trans-unit.target: `Mark` 的填充色；为 null 时在两种主题下都跟随按钮的文字颜色。

trans-unit.source: The provider's name, shown on its button.
trans-unit.target: 第三方登录的名称，显示在其按钮上。

trans-unit.source: An app-defined value that identifies the provider in handlers (for example an OAuth scheme name).
trans-unit.target: 由应用定义的值，用于在处理程序中标识该第三方登录（例如 OAuth 方案名称）。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SignedIn`.
trans-unit.target: `SignedIn` 的参数。

trans-unit.source: How long the built-in simulation waits at each beat (the measured beats of the reference preview). Only used for actions whose handler (`SendLinkAsync`, `OpenMailAppAsync`, `SignInWithProviderAsync`) is not set, except `LinkSentHold`, which always applies.
trans-unit.target: 内置模拟在每个节拍处等待的时长（即参考预览中测得的节拍）。仅用于未设置处理程序（`SendLinkAsync`、`OpenMailAppAsync`、`SignInWithProviderAsync`）的操作，`LinkSentHold` 除外，它始终生效。

trans-unit.source: Split login page: an email-first sign-in in the left column (brand and "Sign up" above, the steps in the middle, a status line and the legal links below) beside a full-height picture. Continue looks the account up, the password step shows it as a chip, Sign in checks the password, narrows to a check and opens the account with a progress line before greeting the person by name; single sign-on skips the password. "Forgot password?" sends a reset link with a resend countdown. The flow is simulated with the reference preview's timings until you set the asynchronous handlers (`LookupAccountAsync`, `VerifyPasswordAsync`, `SignInWithProviderAsync`, `SendResetLinkAsync`); `SignedIn` hands the account to your app. Breakpoints follow the block's own width: 5:6 columns from 1100, 1:1 from 760, the form alone below 760 (the picture hides), tighter padding below 480.
trans-unit.target: 分栏登录页：左栏是以电子邮件为先的登录（上方为品牌和 "Sign up"，中间为步骤，下方为状态行和法律链接），右侧是全高图片。"Continue" 会查找账户，密码步骤将其显示为标签；"Sign in" 检查密码，收缩为对勾并打开账户，同时显示进度行，然后以名字问候用户；单点登录则跳过密码。"Forgot password?" 会发送带重新发送倒计时的重置链接。该流程按参考预览的时间设置模拟，直到你设置异步处理程序（`LookupAccountAsync`、`VerifyPasswordAsync`、`SignInWithProviderAsync`、`SendResetLinkAsync`）为止；`SignedIn` 将账户交给你的应用。断点依据区块自身宽度：1100 起为 5:6 栏，760 起为 1:1，760 以下仅显示表单（图片隐藏），480 以下内边距更紧凑。

trans-unit.source: The account being signed in or signed in; null on the email step.
trans-unit.target: 正在登录或已登录的账户；在邮箱步骤时为 null。

trans-unit.source: Accounts to recognize when `LookupAccountAsync` is not set (an email matching one, case-insensitive, shows its name and picture); when set this wins over `Accounts`.
trans-unit.target: 未设置 `LookupAccountAsync` 时用于识别的账号（邮箱与其中之一匹配时，不区分大小写，会显示其名称和图片）；设置后，此项优先于 `Accounts`。

trans-unit.source: The brand mark (24 × 24 view box, stroked in the accent color); null draws the built-in notebook.
trans-unit.target: 品牌标识（24 × 24 视图框，以强调色描边）；为 null 时绘制内置的笔记本图标。

trans-unit.source: The product name beside the brand mark; also used in the headings and the block's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 紧挨品牌标识的产品名称；也用于标题和区块的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: The account single sign-on uses when the email field holds no valid address (null: the first account, else a built-in sample).
trans-unit.target: 邮箱字段中没有有效地址时，单点登录使用的账号（为 null 时：第一个账号，若没有则使用内置示例）。

trans-unit.source: The password the simulated check accepts while `VerifyPasswordAsync` is not set.
trans-unit.target: 未设置 `VerifyPasswordAsync` 时，模拟校验接受的密码。

trans-unit.source: The text of the email field (two-way). Signing out puts the account's email back here.
trans-unit.target: 邮箱字段的文本（双向绑定）。登出时会将账号的邮箱放回此处。

trans-unit.source: True while an action runs.
trans-unit.target: 操作执行期间为 True。

trans-unit.source: True fills the parent with square corners and no border (a whole screen); false (default) is a framed block with a 1px border, 26px corners and at least 640 high.
trans-unit.target: True 时填满父容器，采用直角且无边框（整屏显示）；false（默认）为带框区块，具有 1px 边框、26px 圆角，且高度至少为 640。

trans-unit.source: Every built-in text (English defaults).
trans-unit.target: 所有内置文本（英文默认值）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when "Sign up", "Terms" or "Privacy" is used; handle it to navigate yourself.
trans-unit.target: 使用 "Sign up"、"Terms" 或 "Privacy" 时引发；请自行处理以导航。

trans-unit.source: Runs with the `LoginSplitLink` when a link is used.
trans-unit.target: 使用链接时，与 `LoginSplitLink` 一起执行。

trans-unit.source: The picture of the right column, cropped to cover it; null draws a metal facade in code.
trans-unit.target: 右侧栏的图片，裁剪以铺满该区域；为 null 时由代码绘制金属外立面。

trans-unit.source: The picture's focal point as fractions of its size (default 0.5, 0.58: centered, a little below the middle).
trans-unit.target: 图片的焦点，以其尺寸的比例表示（默认 0.5, 0.58：居中，略低于中间）。

trans-unit.source: Address of "Privacy" (see `SignUpHref`).
trans-unit.target: "Privacy" 的地址（参见 `SignUpHref`）。

trans-unit.source: Single sign-on buttons; when set this wins over `Providers`. An empty list hides the divider and the buttons.
trans-unit.target: 单点登录按钮；设置后优先于 `Providers`。空列表会隐藏分隔线和按钮。

trans-unit.source: Seconds before another reset link can be asked for (default 30).
trans-unit.target: 再次申请重置链接前需等待的秒数（默认 30）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a password reset link went out (first send and every resend).
trans-unit.target: 密码重置链接发出时引发（首次发送和每次重新发送时）。

trans-unit.source: Address of "Sign up". With an address, an unhandled `Navigate` opens it; without, the status line says where it would go.
trans-unit.target: "Sign up" 的地址。设置地址后，未处理的 `Navigate` 会打开该地址；未设置时，状态行会说明将前往的位置。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the greeting appears after a sign-in (Arc's `onSignIn`).
trans-unit.target: 登录后出现问候语时触发（Arc 的 `onSignIn`）。

trans-unit.source: Runs with the `LoginSplitSignedInEventArgs` after a sign-in.
trans-unit.target: 登录后以 `LoginSplitSignedInEventArgs` 作为参数执行。

trans-unit.source: Raised after Sign out.
trans-unit.target: 在登出后引发。

trans-unit.source: The visible status line (also announced politely); null when empty.
trans-unit.target: 可见的状态行（同时以礼貌方式播报）；为空时为 null。

trans-unit.source: The step on show.
trans-unit.target: 当前显示的步骤。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the step changes.
trans-unit.target: 步骤变更时触发。

trans-unit.source: Address of "Terms" (see `SignUpHref`).
trans-unit.target: "Terms" 的地址（参见 `SignUpHref`）。

trans-unit.source: Pauses of the simulated flow and the beats of the sign-in sequence.
trans-unit.target: 模拟流程的暂停时长，以及登录序列的节拍。

trans-unit.source: A person who can sign in to a `LoginSplit`: a name, an email and an optional picture. The chip, the account row and the greeting show it; without a picture the avatar shows the initials of the name.
trans-unit.target: 可登录 `LoginSplit` 的账号：包含名称、邮箱和可选的图片。芯片、账号行和问候语都会显示它；没有图片时，头像显示名称的首字母。

trans-unit.source: Every built-in text of `LoginSplit` (English defaults): headings, field labels, buttons, errors, the status line and what screen readers hear. Replace the whole object through `Labels` to localize or rename; texts with values are functions.
trans-unit.target: `LoginSplit` 的所有内置文本（英文默认值）：标题、字段标签、按钮、错误信息、状态栏，以及屏幕阅读器读出的内容。通过 `Labels` 整体替换即可本地化或改名；带值的文本为函数。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `NavigateEvent`. Set `Handled` to keep the block from opening `Href`.
trans-unit.target: `NavigateEvent` 的参数。设置 `Handled` 可阻止区块打开 `Href`。

trans-unit.source: A single sign-on button of a `LoginSplit`: a name and a mark.
trans-unit.target: `LoginSplit` 中的单点登录按钮，包含名称和标识。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ResetLinkSentEvent`.
trans-unit.target: `ResetLinkSentEvent` 的参数。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SignedInEvent`.
trans-unit.target: `SignedInEvent` 的参数。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SignedOutEvent`.
trans-unit.target: `SignedOutEvent` 的参数。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `StepChangedEvent`.
trans-unit.target: `StepChangedEvent` 的参数。

trans-unit.source: The pauses of the simulated flow a `LoginSplit` plays when no handler is set, and the beats of the sign-in sequence. Defaults are the reference preview's measured timings.
trans-unit.target: 未设置处理程序时，`LoginSplit` 播放的模拟流程中的停顿，以及登录序列中的节拍。默认值为参考预览中测得的时长。

trans-unit.source: An Arc-styled Markdown document rendered by StreamMark: headings, lists, tables, quotes, links, inline code and fenced code highlighted in Arc's syntax palette. Show static text with `Text`, or stream a reply with `Append` / `Complete` (or your own `Stream`). The document grows with its content (no internal scrolling); put long documents in a `ScrollViewer`.
trans-unit.target: 由 StreamMark 渲染的 Arc 风格 Markdown 文档：标题、列表、表格、引用、链接、行内代码，以及按 Arc 语法配色高亮的围栏代码块。使用 `Text` 显示静态文本，或使用 `Append` / `Complete`（或你自己的 `Stream`）流式输出回复。文档随内容增长（无内部滚动）；长文档请放入 `ScrollViewer`。

trans-unit.source: Vertical space between blocks (paragraphs, lists, code, tables).
trans-unit.target: 区块之间的垂直间距（段落、列表、代码、表格）。

trans-unit.source: The 0-based index of the current match, or -1 when the search has no match.
trans-unit.target: 当前匹配的序号（从 0 开始），没有匹配时为 -1。

trans-unit.source: The current document is parsed and applied, so `GetOutline` and the scroll methods have their final targets. Raised again when a new `Text` or `Stream` becomes ready, and after a new template is applied. Runs on the UI thread.
trans-unit.target: 当前文档已解析并应用，因此 `GetOutline` 与跳转方法的目标已最终确定。新的 `Text` 或 `Stream` 就绪、以及重新套用模板后再次引发。在 UI 线程上运行。

trans-unit.source: True when the document has a selection, so a copy action can be enabled.
trans-unit.target: 文档存在选区时为 true，可用于启用复制操作。

trans-unit.source: True when the current document has been parsed and the result is applied to the view, so the outline, the search matches and the scroll targets are final. A static `Text` becomes ready once; a stream becomes ready when it completes. False before the template is applied and while a new source is being parsed.
trans-unit.target: 当前文档已解析且结果已应用到视图时为 true，此时大纲、查找匹配与跳转目标均已最终确定。静态 `Text` 就绪一次；流在结束时就绪。模板尚未应用时、以及新源正在解析期间为 false。

trans-unit.source: Whether `Append` paces the text (true, the default: it is released in small steps that follow the arrival rate). False shows every appended piece as one batch at once: the host has already paced it, for example in whole words on a fixed clock.
trans-unit.target: `Append` 是否按节奏释放文本（true，默认值：文本以小步释放，并跟随到达速率）。为 false 时，每次追加的内容都会一次性整体显示：宿主已自行按节奏处理，例如以固定时钟逐个显示完整单词。

trans-unit.source: Whether a stream is attached and has not completed yet.
trans-unit.target: 是否已附加串流且尚未完成。

trans-unit.source: Body line height in pixels; NaN (default) uses the font size times Arc's prose leading (1.65).
trans-unit.target: 正文行高，单位为像素；NaN（默认）时使用字体大小乘以 Arc 的正文行距（1.65）。

trans-unit.source: A link was clicked (anchors inside the document scroll by themselves and do not arrive here).
trans-unit.target: 链接被点击时触发（文档内的锚点会自行滚动，不会传到这里）。

trans-unit.source: The number of matches of the last `Find`, 0 when nothing is searched.
trans-unit.target: 最近一次 `Find` 的匹配数量，未查找时为 0。

trans-unit.source: Opens allowed absolute links (http, https, mailto) with the system launcher when no `LinkClicked` handler marks the event handled and the link policy does not ask for confirmation.
trans-unit.target: 在没有 `LinkClicked` 处理程序将事件标记为已处理，且链接策略不要求确认时，使用系统启动器打开允许的绝对链接（http、https、mailto）。

trans-unit.source: How long each batch of text appended with `Append` fades in at full motion; null uses Arc's standard duration. A host that paces the text itself usually sets 150 ms.
trans-unit.target: 通过 `Append` 追加的每批文本以完整动效淡入所需的时长；为 null 时使用 Arc 的标准时长。宿主自行控制节奏时通常设为 150 ms。

trans-unit.source: Whether appended text still fades in at reduced motion (a short opacity fade). False shows it at once, which suits a reply that grows continuously: there is no whole to fade.
trans-unit.target: 通过 `Append` 追加的文本在减少动效时是否仍淡入（短暂的不透明度渐变）。为 false 时立即显示，适合持续增长的回复：此时没有完整的整体可供淡入。

trans-unit.source: The matches or the current match of `Find` changed (including when the document changes under a search and the query is run again). Runs on the UI thread.
trans-unit.target: `Find` 的匹配或当前匹配发生变化（包括查找期间文档变化、查询重新执行）。在 UI 线程上运行。

trans-unit.source: The selection of the document view changed; `HasSelection` and the copy results follow.
trans-unit.target: 文档视图的选区发生变化；`HasSelection` 与复制结果随之更新。

trans-unit.source: StreamMark services (plugins, code block options, link policy). Null uses services set on an ancestor with `MarkdownServices.SetServices`, else `DefaultServices`.
trans-unit.target: StreamMark 服务（插件、代码块选项、链接策略）。为 null 时使用祖先元素上通过 `MarkdownServices.SetServices` 设置的服务，否则使用 `DefaultServices`。

trans-unit.source: A streamed reply to show instead of `Text`. `Append` creates one when none is set; you can also supply your own (for example one fed from a worker thread with `Push`).
trans-unit.target: 要显示的流式回复，代替 `Text`。未设置时，`Append` 会创建一个；你也可以提供自己的流（例如通过 `Push` 从工作线程供给的流）。

trans-unit.source: The Markdown source to show. Setting it ends a stream started with `Append`.
trans-unit.target: 要显示的 Markdown 源文本。设置该属性会结束由 `Append` 开始的流。

trans-unit.source: Fails text longer than `Length` characters.
trans-unit.target: 文字长度超过 `Length` 个字符时不通过。

trans-unit.source: A filing group of memories (About you, Preferences, Projects, People by default).
trans-unit.target: 记忆的一个归档分组（默认为“关于你”“偏好”“项目”“人物”）。

trans-unit.source: The sentence shown in the group when it has no memories while it is the only group on screen.
trans-unit.target: 当该分组是屏幕上唯一的分组、且其中没有记忆时，在分组中显示的文字。

trans-unit.source: The key a memory's `GroupKey` refers to.
trans-unit.target: 记忆的 `GroupKey` 所指向的键。

trans-unit.source: The label of the filter pill and the group heading.
trans-unit.target: 筛选胶囊和分组标题的标签。

trans-unit.source: One thing the assistant remembers about the person. Data only: an `AvaloniaObject` so that the properties bind and a change (an edit from elsewhere) reaches the row on screen.
trans-unit.target: 助手对用户记住的一件事。仅为数据：它是一个 `AvaloniaObject`，因此属性可以绑定，其他地方的更改（例如编辑）也能同步到屏幕上的行。

trans-unit.source: The key of the `MemoryGroup` the memory is filed under.
trans-unit.target: 该记忆所归入的 `MemoryGroup` 的键。

trans-unit.source: Stable id, unique within `Memories`.
trans-unit.target: 稳定的 id，在 `Memories` 内唯一。

trans-unit.source: The avatar image for `PersonName`; without one the avatar shows the first letter.

trans-unit.source: One row of a `MenuSurface`: a leading icon (a Lucide `Geometry` such as `{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}`, or any control), a header, an optional shortcut hint and the check or radio indicator of toggle rows. Rows never draw their own hover or focus fill: the surface's shared highlight glides to the row under the pointer and jumps to the keyboard position. Activation runs `Command`, raises `Click` and the surface's `ItemClicked`, then closes the menu unless `StaysOpenOnClick` is set.
trans-unit.target: `MenuSurface` 中的一行：前导图标（Lucide `Geometry`，例如 `{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}`，或任意控件）、标题、可选的快捷键提示，以及切换行的勾选或单选指示器。各行不绘制自己的悬停或焦点填充：由菜单面板共享的高亮会滑动到指针所在的行，并跳到键盘所在的位置。激活时会执行 `Command`、引发 `Click` 和菜单面板的 `ItemClicked`，然后关闭菜单，除非设置了 `StaysOpenOnClick`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the row is activated (pointer release, Enter or Space), before the menu closes.
trans-unit.target: 行被激活（指针释放、Enter 或空格）时引发，发生在菜单关闭之前。

trans-unit.source: Command run when the row is activated; the row is disabled while the command cannot execute.
trans-unit.target: 行被激活时执行的命令；命令无法执行时该行被禁用。

trans-unit.source: Parameter passed to Command when the row is activated.

trans-unit.source: Arc metric card: a compact summary for a number that needs context (uptime, orders). The value rolls like an odometer (`AnimatedCounter`, from zero on first view); the label, context and change chip roll in from the side the number moved toward (a larger number rises from below, a smaller one drops from above), and the chip's width springs to fit. A signed change reads its direction in color as well as sign; set `IsChangeGlyphVisible` to add a direction glyph and `Sparkline` for a small trend line.
trans-unit.target: Arc 指标卡片：用于展示需要上下文的数字的紧凑摘要（如运行时长、订单数）。数值以里程表式滚动（`AnimatedCounter`，首次显示时从零开始）；标签、上下文和变化标签从数字移动的方向滚入（较大的数字从下方升起，较小的数字从上方落下），标签宽度以弹簧方式适配内容。带符号的变化同时通过颜色和符号指示方向；设置 `IsChangeGlyphVisible` 可添加方向图标，设置 `Sparkline` 可显示小型趋势线。

trans-unit.source: The change chip, such as "+12%"; empty hides the chip. Write the sign: color is not the only cue.
trans-unit.target: 变化标签，例如 “+12%”；为空时隐藏标签。请写明正负号：颜色并非唯一的提示。

trans-unit.source: Direction read from the sign of `Change`.
trans-unit.target: 由 `Change` 的符号读取的方向。

trans-unit.source: The comparison line, such as "vs last week".
trans-unit.target: 对比说明行，例如 “较上周”。

trans-unit.source: Fraction digits of the number (default 0).
trans-unit.target: 数字的小数位数（默认 0）。

trans-unit.source: Adds a trending up / down glyph to a signed change chip (default false, like Arc).
trans-unit.target: 在带符号的变化标签上添加上升或下降的趋势图标（默认 false，与 Arc 一致）。

trans-unit.source: What is measured.
trans-unit.target: 所衡量的对象。

trans-unit.source: Text before the number, such as "$".
trans-unit.target: 数字前的文本，例如 “$”。

trans-unit.source: Optional values for a small trend line beside the number.
trans-unit.target: 可选的数值，用于在数字旁绘制小型趋势线。

trans-unit.source: Unit after the number, such as "%" or " ms".
trans-unit.target: 数字后的单位，例如 “%” 或 “ ms”。

trans-unit.source: The number; it rolls from zero on first view, then between values.
trans-unit.target: 数值；首次显示时从零滚动到该值，之后在不同值之间滚动。

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of a sparse mixture-of-experts layer. Tokens enter one at a time; a router scores every expert (a small bar each), the token travels to its top-k experts, which light up in a first and second choice color and count it, and their outputs merge into the token's output chip. Experts have a capacity: a full expert skips the token, and a token whose every choice is full passes through unchanged. The header switches between top 1 and top 2 and shows the parameters that run per token; a load balance bar sits under the stage. Pointing at, focusing or pinning a token or an expert freezes the story on it and shows its route or its load. The routing is computed from the tokens' scores (or stable scores derived from their text); the numbers are illustrative.
trans-unit.target: 稀疏混合专家层的动画讲解。Token 逐个进入；路由器为每个专家打分（每个专家一根小柱），token 被送往其前 top-k 个专家，这些专家以第一和第二选择颜色亮起并对其计数，它们的输出汇入 token 的输出标签块。专家有容量：已满的专家会跳过该 token，所有选择都已满的 token 则原样通过。标题可在 top 1 与 top 2 之间切换，并显示每个 token 运行的参数；负载均衡条位于舞台下方。指向、聚焦或固定某个 token 或专家会冻结演示并显示其路由或负载。路由根据 token 的分数计算（或由其文本推导出的稳定分数）；数字仅为示意。

trans-unit.source: The parameters that run for one token at the current top k, in billions.
trans-unit.target: 在当前 top-k 下，每个 token 运行的参数量（单位：十亿）。

trans-unit.source: The tokens each expert takes before it is full, or null when nothing is ever dropped.
trans-unit.target: 每位专家在满员前可接收的 token 数；若从不丢弃任何 token 则为 null。

trans-unit.source: Scales each expert's capacity, ⌈factor × tokens × k / experts⌉ tokens (default 1). A full expert skips further tokens. `PositiveInfinity` never drops a token; zero, negative and NaN values count as 1.
trans-unit.target: 缩放每位专家的容量，即 ⌈factor × tokens × k / experts⌉ 个 token（默认为 1）。已满的专家会跳过后续的 token。`PositiveInfinity` 从不丢弃 token；零、负数和 NaN 均按 1 计算。

trans-unit.source: The token being routed, or −1 while the summary shows.
trans-unit.target: 正在路由的 token 的索引；显示摘要时为 −1。

trans-unit.source: The experts, 2 to 12 (more are cut to the first 12). Leave it empty, or give fewer than two, for the eight default experts. Changing the experts starts the story over.
trans-unit.target: 专家，数量为 2 到 12（超过 12 个的只取前 12 个）。留空，或给出少于两个，则使用默认的八个专家。更改专家会重新开始演示。

trans-unit.source: The first choice's color (null: chart series 1, which follows the accent).
trans-unit.target: 第一选择的颜色（null：图表系列 1，跟随强调色）。

trans-unit.source: The expert being inspected (hovered, keyboard-focused or pinned), or −1.
trans-unit.target: 正在检查（悬停、键盘聚焦或固定）的专家；否则为 −1。

trans-unit.source: The token being inspected (hovered, keyboard-focused or pinned), or −1.
trans-unit.target: 正在检查（悬停、键盘聚焦或固定）的 token；否则为 −1。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or speaks; replace it to translate or reword.
trans-unit.target: 卡片显示或朗读的每一个文字；替换它即可翻译或改写。

trans-unit.source: The load balance the card shows, 0 to 1; null before anything is routed.
trans-unit.target: 卡片显示的负载均衡，范围 0 到 1；尚未路由任何内容时为 null。

trans-unit.source: The parameter counts in billions behind the active-parameters readout (default 480 in all, 6 shared, 12 per expert): shared + k × per expert run for each token.
trans-unit.target: 激活参数读数背后的参数量，单位为十亿（默认总计 480，其中共享 6，每个专家 12）：每个 token 运行的为 共享 + k × 每个专家。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a token leaves the router for its experts, with its route.
trans-unit.target: token 离开路由器前往其专家时引发，附带其路由。

trans-unit.source: The planned route of every token for the current top k and capacity.

trans-unit.source: The tokens to route, in order. Leave it empty for the default sentence (see `MixtureOfExpertsSamples`). Changing the tokens starts the story over.

trans-unit.source: One expert of a `MixtureOfExperts`: a short name, what it tends to handle and an icon.
trans-unit.target: `MixtureOfExperts` 的一位专家：一个简短名称、它通常处理的内容以及一个图标。

trans-unit.source: A short sentence on what the expert tends to handle, shown while it is inspected.
trans-unit.target: 一句简短说明该专家通常处理什么，在被检查时显示。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroked glyph drawn at 14 px (Lucide style); null shows the first letter of the name.
trans-unit.target: 24×24 描边图形，以 14 px 绘制（Lucide 风格）；为 null 时显示名称的首字母。

trans-unit.source: The expert's name, best one short word (the narrow layout shows only the icon and speaks the name).
trans-unit.target: 专家的名称，最好是一个简短的词（窄布局只显示图标，朗读时才念出名称）。

trans-unit.source: Every word a `MixtureOfExperts` shows or speaks, in English by default. Replace the instance to translate or reword; sentences with numbers or names are functions so the word order can change. Footer notes may contain `{token}`, which is replaced by a small chip with the token's text. Numbers of parameters arrive formatted ("30", "2.5").
trans-unit.target: `MixtureOfExperts` 显示或朗读的每一个文字，默认为英文。替换整个实例即可翻译或改写；包含数字或名称的句子为函数，以便调整词序。页脚说明可以包含 `{token}`，它会被替换为一个显示该 token 文字的小标签块。参数数量已格式化后传入（如 "30"、"2.5"）。

trans-unit.source: How one token was routed: its normalized gate scores, the experts it chose (best first) with their weights within the choice, the chosen experts that were full and skipped it, and the expert loads once it has been routed. trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Routed`: a token leaves the router for its experts.

trans-unit.source: One token that a `MixtureOfExperts` routes: its text and, optionally, the router's raw score for every expert. (The name ends in Item because `MixtureOfExpertsToken` is the control's design token.)
trans-unit.target: `MixtureOfExperts` 路由的一个 token：其文字，以及可选的路由器对每个专家的原始分数。（名称以 Item 结尾，是因为 `MixtureOfExpertsToken` 是该控件的设计 token。）

trans-unit.source: The router's raw score for each expert, in the order of `Experts` ("24, 6, 3, 58" in XAML). Scores are non-negative and are normalized to sum to 1; missing entries count as 0 and extra ones are ignored. Null derives stable example scores from `Text`.
trans-unit.target: 路由器对 `Experts` 中每位专家的原始分数，按其顺序排列（XAML 中写作 "24, 6, 3, 58"）。分数为非负数，并被标准化为和为 1；缺失的条目按 0 计，多余的条目忽略。为 null 时由 `Text` 推导出稳定的示例分数。

trans-unit.source: A blind test of two models: one prompt goes to two anonymous models, both answers stream in at the same pace, and only after the person votes are the models revealed. trans-unit.source: Chooses a model and its reasoning effort from one compact pill. The pill shows the current choice; its menu lists a few featured models with a one-line note each, an effort setting, and every other model grouped by provider. Under the pill a summary shows what the model can hold and costs, and confirms each change for a moment. A composition of `ModelPill`, `ModelMenu` and `ModelSummary`: the catalog, the selection and the effort are properties, so bind them or read them back from the events. The pill opens on a pointer press or on Enter, Space and ArrowDown; the menu has a featured list, an Effort row and a More models row that open submenus (or pages in a narrow window); choosing closes the menu and returns focus to the pill; the effort moves to the nearest level a new model offers. Set `IsSummaryVisible` to false for the pill alone (a toolbar, a header). Screen readers hear a polite announcement after each change ("Now using Aurora Prime 3, medium effort"); the visible confirmation under the summary stays for `NoticeDuration`.
trans-unit.target: 从一个紧凑的胶囊中选择模型及其推理强度。胶囊显示当前选择；其菜单列出几个精选模型（每个附一行说明）、一项推理强度设置，以及按提供方分组的其他所有模型。胶囊下方的概览显示该模型可容纳的内容与费用，并在每次更改后短暂给出确认。它由 `ModelPill`、`ModelMenu` 和 `ModelSummary` 组合而成：目录、选择和推理强度都是属性，因此可以绑定它们，或从事件中读回。胶囊在指针按下，或按 Enter、Space 与 ArrowDown 时打开菜单；菜单包含精选列表、Effort 行和 More models 行，它们会打开子菜单（窗口较窄时改为页面）；选择后菜单关闭，焦点回到胶囊；推理强度会移到新模型所提供的最接近的一档。把 `IsSummaryVisible` 设为 false，就只剩胶囊（用于工具栏或标题栏）。每次更改后，屏幕阅读器会听到一条礼貌式播报（"Now using Aurora Prime 3, medium effort"）；概览下方的确认提示会保留 `NoticeDuration` 的时长。

trans-unit.source: Arc morph select: a select whose trigger is the list. Opening grows the trigger itself into the options surface (width, height and corners spring together, P9), a single highlight glides between options (P7), and the chosen label lifts out of the list and settles into the trigger (P8) while the trigger springs to its new width (P5). Supports groups (`Group`), icons and trailing meta, type-ahead, search for long lists and the full listbox keyboard model. Use it for property pickers and form fields with up to a few hundred options. Keyboard: Enter, Space and the arrows open on the selected option (Home / End open on the first or last); arrows, PageUp / PageDown (8 at a time) and Home / End move; Enter or Space picks; Alt+Up picks and closes; typing jumps (or searches when search is on); Escape closes and returns focus; Tab closes without picking.
trans-unit.target: Arc 变形选择框：触发器本身即列表。打开时，触发器会直接变形为选项面板（宽度、高度与圆角一同以弹簧变化，P9），单个高亮在选项之间滑动（P7），所选标签从列表中浮起并落入触发器（P8），同时触发器以弹簧变为新宽度（P5）。支持分组（`Group`）、图标与尾随元数据、类型查找、长列表搜索以及完整的列表框键盘操作模型。适用于属性选择器以及最多数百个选项的表单字段。键盘：Enter、空格与方向键会在所选选项上打开（Home / End 在第一个或最后一个选项上打开）；方向键、PageUp / PageDown（每次 8 项）与 Home / End 用于移动；Enter 或空格用于选取；Alt+Up 选取并关闭；输入字符会跳转（开启搜索时则进行搜索）；Escape 关闭并返回焦点；Tab 关闭且不选取。

trans-unit.source: A guided form that asks for one thing at a time: a card with a progress list and a step count, one step of fields, and Back and Continue buttons (Continue reads `CompleteLabel` on the last step). Submitting the last step shows a success block in place of the fields and folds the buttons away. Steps slide 20 px in the direction of travel while the card springs to the new step's height (both ways); done steps draw a check and the count rolls. Every step keeps its fields alive while other steps are shown, so values survive Back and Continue. Enter in a single-line text field submits the step. A step can block its submission with `ValidateAsync`, with `StepValidating`, or by a field with a data validation error; `CompleteAsync` runs the final submission with a spinner on the button.

trans-unit.source: A home for updates: a bell with an unread badge that opens a panel of notifications with read state, an All / Unread switch, expandable details and bulk actions ("Mark all read", "Clear read"). Use it when updates need a persistent place instead of a brief toast, and connect the read state to your data store through `IsRead` and the `ReadChanged` and `Dismissed` events. The panel grows out of the bell (6px toward it at scale 0.97, standard 240ms) and leaves in 120ms; counts roll, the summary rises into its new wording, the view highlight glides on the morph spring, rows collapse their height on the smooth spring as they leave (cascading 35ms apart after a bulk action) and settle in with a 4px rise when the panel opens. Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the bell. Ported from Arc's free notification-center block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli).
trans-unit.target: 更新的常驻入口：一个带未读徽标的铃铛，点击后打开通知面板，面板包含已读状态、All / Unread 切换、可展开的详情以及批量操作（“Mark all read”、“Clear read”）。当更新需要持久的位置，而非短暂的消息提示时使用它，并通过 `IsRead` 与 `ReadChanged` 及 `Dismissed` 事件，将已读状态连接到你的数据存储。面板从铃铛处展开（朝铃铛方向偏移 6px，缩放至 0.97，标准时长 240ms），并在 120ms 内收起；计数滚动更新，摘要以向上推入的方式切换为新措辞，视图高亮沿变形弹簧滑动，行离开时以平滑弹簧收起高度（批量操作后按 35ms 间隔依次级联），面板打开时各行以 4px 上移的方式落定。按 Escape 关闭面板，并将焦点返回铃铛。移植自 Arc 免费的通知中心模块（MIT 许可，版权所有 (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli）。

trans-unit.source: Arc number field: a bounded number with clear increment controls. The value rolls like an odometer, the steppers and ArrowUp / ArrowDown repeat and speed up while held, Shift, PageUp and PageDown take large steps, Home and End jump to the limits, and `IsScrubEnabled` lets the label be dragged sideways. Typing edits a plain draft that applies live while valid and commits on Enter, blur or the next step (snapped to the step grid and clamped). A press past a limit strains the value toward it, shakes the refused stepper and names the limit beside the label (`"Max 10 seats"`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 数字输入框：带有明确增减控件的有界数值。数值以里程表式滚动；步进按钮及 ArrowUp / ArrowDown 按住时会重复并逐步加速；Shift、PageUp 与 PageDown 以较大步长调整；Home 与 End 跳到上下限；`IsScrubEnabled` 允许左右拖动标签来调整数值。输入时编辑一份普通草稿：有效时即时生效，并在按下 Enter、失去焦点或执行下一步时提交（会对齐步长网格并限制在范围内）。按压超出上下限时，数值会向该限制拉伸，被拒绝的步进按钮会抖动，并在标签旁标出该限制（`"Max 10 seats"`）。

trans-unit.source: A row of single-character slots for one-time codes (Arc's OTP input block): a visible label, one slot per character, helper and error copy under the row. Typing fills a slot and moves on; a paste fills the slots from the focused one; arrow keys move between slots and Backspace on an empty slot clears the one before it. Characters rise into their slot, a paste lands as a short left to right wave, one focus ring glides between the slots, and a new error nudges the row side to side once. `Value` is two-way; `Completed` fires when an edit fills the last slot, which is where a host checks the code.
trans-unit.target: 用于一次性验证码的单字符格子行（Arc 的 OTP 输入块）：可见的标签、每个字符一个格子，以及行下方的辅助文字和错误文字。输入时填入格子并移到下一格；粘贴时从当前聚焦的格子开始依次填入；方向键可在格子之间移动，在空格子上按 Backspace 会清除前一个格子。字符会向上升入格子，粘贴时呈现一道从左到右的短促波浪动画，一个焦点环在格子之间滑动，新的错误会让整行左右轻晃一次。`Value` 为双向绑定；编辑填满最后一个格子时触发 `Completed`，宿主应在此处校验验证码。

trans-unit.source: Focuses the first slot when the field is loaded (Arc's `autoFocus`).
trans-unit.target: 加载时聚焦第一个格子（Arc 的 `autoFocus`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after every edit by the person that leaves all slots filled (Arc: `if (next.length === length) verify(next)`).
trans-unit.target: 用户每次编辑后引发，且所有格子均已填满时引发。（Arc：`if (next.length === length) verify(next)`）

trans-unit.source: Executed with the code when an edit fills every slot (after `Completed`).
trans-unit.target: 编辑填满所有格子时执行，参数为验证码（在 `Completed` 之后）。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the slots (Arc's `description`).

trans-unit.source: Error copy under the slots (Arc's `error`); non-empty makes the field invalid, and a new error shakes the row once.

trans-unit.source: Which characters the slots accept (Arc's `inputMode`): digits only (default) or any text.
trans-unit.target: 格子接受的字符类型（Arc 的 `inputMode`）：仅数字（默认）或任意文本。

trans-unit.source: True while every slot holds a character.
trans-unit.target: 所有格子都有字符时为 true。

trans-unit.target: 无效状态：格子和焦点环显示为危险色。只要 `ErrorMessage` 不为空，此值始终为 true。

trans-unit.source: When true the slots keep focus and arrow keys but ignore typing, paste and deletion (while a host checks a code).
trans-unit.target: 为 true 时，格子保留焦点和方向键，但忽略输入、粘贴和删除（用于主机校验验证码期间）。

trans-unit.target: 验证码，每个格子一个字符（Arc 的 `value` 和 `onChange`）；双向绑定。

trans-unit.source: The frame of a project or record page (Arc page header block): a fixed header with breadcrumbs, a large title with a status badge, a description, a meta row, actions and tabs, over the scrolling body of the selected tab. Scrolling the body past 16px folds the header into a compact bar (the breadcrumbs give way to the title and its status, which scrolls back to the top when chosen); it opens again only near the top (4px), so it never flickers. Secondary actions fold into the "More actions" menu when the breadcrumbs would get less than 240px, and return at 272px. Tab counts roll digit by digit, a 2px indicator glides between tabs, and panels slide in from the side of travel. Breakpoints follow the control's own width: below 560px the padding tightens, the root crumb and the compact badge hide and the title steps down a size; below 460px the primary action shows only its icon. Ported from Arc's free page-header block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli) and made data driven: tabs are `PageHeaderTab` items (or data items with `ItemTemplate` and `ContentTemplate`), actions are `PageHeaderAction`s.
trans-unit.target: 项目或记录页面（Arc 页头区块）的框架：顶部固定的页头，包含面包屑、带状态徽标的大号标题、描述、元信息行、操作和标签，下方是所选标签的可滚动正文。正文滚动超过 16px 时，页头折叠为紧凑栏（面包屑让位于标题及其状态；选择标题时会滚回顶部）；只有回到顶部附近（4px 以内）才会重新展开，因此不会闪烁。当面包屑可用宽度将小于 240px 时，次要操作折叠进“More actions”菜单，宽度达到 272px 时重新展开。标签计数逐位滚动，2px 指示条在标签之间滑动，面板从移动方向一侧滑入。断点依据控件自身的宽度：低于 560px 时内边距收紧，根面包屑和紧凑徽标隐藏，标题降一级字号；低于 460px 时主要操作只显示图标。移植自 Arc 的免费页头区块（MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli），并改为数据驱动：标签为 `PageHeaderTab` 项（或带有 `ItemTemplate` 和 `ContentTemplate` 的数据项），操作为 `PageHeaderAction`。

trans-unit.source: Arc pagination: previous and next buttons around a sliding window of five page buttons and one current-page mark that travels between them on a morph spring. When the window moves, the numbers travel like a belt by the number of slots it moved (smooth spring), entering numbers fade in and leaving ones fade out quickly. `CurrentPage` is 1-based, two-way and clamped to `1..PageCount`; with `ShowBoundaryPages` the first and last pages stay reachable behind an ellipsis.
trans-unit.target: Arc 分页：上一页、下一页按钮之间是由五个页码按钮组成的滑动窗口，以及一个当前页标记，它会借助形变弹簧在各按钮之间移动。窗口移动时，页码会按移动的格数像传送带一样平移（平滑弹簧）；新出现的页码淡入，离开的页码快速淡出。`CurrentPage` 从 1 开始计数，双向绑定，并限制在 `1..PageCount` 范围内；启用 `ShowBoundaryPages` 后，首页与末页仍可通过省略号访问。

trans-unit.source: The current page, 1-based. Two-way; values outside `1..PageCount` are clamped for display.
trans-unit.target: 当前页码，从 1 开始。双向绑定；超出 `1..PageCount` 范围的值在显示时会被限制。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.
trans-unit.target: 导航地标的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.target: 下一页按钮的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.target: 页码按钮无障碍名称的格式；`{0}` 为页码。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the previous button.
trans-unit.target: 上一页按钮的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: Keeps the first and last pages visible behind an ellipsis when the window does not reach them (not in Arc).

trans-unit.source: Arc password field: a labeled password input with a reveal toggle inside the frame. The toggle's eye is crossed out by a slash that draws itself (it is never swapped for a second icon), and after the first toggle every switch between dots and characters resolves in place from a light blur. Enter or Space on the toggle shows or hides the password; the toggle reports its pressed state and switches its name between `ShowPasswordText` and `HidePasswordText`.
trans-unit.target: Arc 密码输入框：带标签的密码输入框，外框内有显示切换按钮。切换按钮的眼睛图标上有一条自行绘制的斜线（从不替换为第二个图标）；首次切换之后，圆点与字符之间的每次切换都会通过轻微模糊原地过渡。在切换按钮上按 Enter 或 Space 可显示或隐藏密码；该按钮会报告其按下状态，并在 `ShowPasswordText` 与 `HidePasswordText` 之间切换其名称。

trans-unit.source: Name of the toggle while the password is shown.
trans-unit.target: 密码显示时切换按钮的名称。

trans-unit.source: Shows the password as text (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 以文字形式显示密码（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: Name of the toggle while the password is hidden.
trans-unit.target: 密码隐藏时切换按钮的名称。

trans-unit.source: Arc password strength: a new-password field that shows how strong the password is while it is typed. Four segments fill in a staggered wave and change tone, the strength word rises when strength improves and drops when it falls, each requirement checks off with a drawn tick (unmet length rules show a rolling "4 more"), and a new `ErrorMessage` shakes the field once. Scoring runs on the device through a pluggable `Scorer` (default: `PasswordStrengthEstimator`, synchronous and cheap).
trans-unit.target: Arc 密码强度：新密码输入框，在输入时即显示密码的强度。四段分段条以交错波浪的方式填充并变换色调，强度文字在强度提升时上升、下降时下降；每项要求都会以绘制的勾号逐一打勾（未满足的长度规则会显示滚动的 "4 more"）；新的 `ErrorMessage` 会让输入框抖动一次。评分在本机通过可替换的 `Scorer` 完成（默认：`PasswordStrengthEstimator`，同步且开销小）。

trans-unit.source: How characters are counted for `ShortLength`; null counts code points.
trans-unit.target: `ShortLength` 的字符计数方式；为 null 时按码点计数。

trans-unit.source: The current level, 0 (empty) to 4 (strong).
trans-unit.target: 当前等级，从 0（空）到 4（强）。

trans-unit.source: Every user-facing string (English defaults).
trans-unit.target: 所有面向用户的字符串（英文默认值）。

trans-unit.source: Requirements to check. Strength is the share of rules met, spread over four steps.
trans-unit.target: 需要检查的要求。强度为满足规则的占比，分布在四个等级上。

trans-unit.source: Scores the password; null uses `PasswordStrengthEstimator` with `ShortLength`.
trans-unit.target: 为密码评分；为 null 时使用带有 `ShortLength` 的 `PasswordStrengthEstimator`。

trans-unit.source: Below this many characters the meter holds at its first step and reads "Too short". Default 8.
trans-unit.target: 低于此字符数时，强度条停留在第一段并显示 "Too short"。默认 8。

trans-unit.source: Raised after every scored change of the password.
trans-unit.target: 每次密码经过评分并发生变化后触发。

trans-unit.source: The current strength word.
trans-unit.target: 当前的强度文字。

trans-unit.source: An animated card payment: the customer pays at checkout, the gateway tokenizes the card, the authorization request travels through the card network to the issuing bank, the issuer approves or declines, the response comes back and approved payments settle to the merchant account, whose balance grows.
trans-unit.target: 动画演示的卡片支付：顾客在结账时付款，支付网关对卡片进行令牌化，授权请求经卡组织传送至发卡银行，发卡行批准或拒绝，响应返回；获批的付款结算至商户账户，其余额随之增长。

trans-unit.source: The amount paid (default 42).
trans-unit.target: 已支付的金额（默认 42）。

trans-unit.source: Last four digits of the card.
trans-unit.target: 卡号的后四位数字。

trans-unit.source: ISO currency code (default USD).
trans-unit.target: ISO 货币代码（默认 USD）。

trans-unit.source: Every N-th payment is declined (0 never declines).
trans-unit.target: 每第 N 笔付款会被拒绝（0 表示从不拒绝）。

trans-unit.source: Arc phone input: a phone field with a country picker. The number formats as it is typed in the selected country's shape (separators only print while digits follow, a typed trunk prefix is kept) with a faint guide showing the rest of the expected number; the value comes out in E.164. The flag button grows into a searchable country list (one morphing surface), pasted or autofilled international numbers pick their own country (+1 picks Canada by area code), and typing "+" in the number jumps into the picker with a calling-code search. After blur an incomplete or too long number shows "Numbers in United Kingdom have 10 digits" unless `IsValidationEnabled` is off or an `ErrorMessage` replaces it; a valid number shows a check. Keyboard: on the country button ArrowDown / ArrowUp open the list and a printable key opens it seeded with that key; in the search ArrowDown / ArrowUp, PageDown / PageUp (8 rows), Home / End (with an empty search) move, Enter picks, Escape closes and returns to the button, Tab closes. In the number, Backspace / Delete on a separator delete the digit beside it.
trans-unit.target: Arc 电话输入框：带国家选择器的电话字段。号码会按所选国家的格式边输入边排版（分隔符仅在后面有数字时才显示，输入的国内长途前缀会保留），并以浅色提示显示预期号码的其余部分；值以 E.164 格式输出。国旗按钮会展开为可搜索的国家列表（同一个变形面板）；粘贴或自动填充的国际号码会自动选择对应国家（+1 按区号选择加拿大）；在号码中输入 "+" 会跳转到选择器并按国际区号搜索。失去焦点后，不完整或过长的号码会显示 "英国号码应为 10 位数字"，除非关闭了 `IsValidationEnabled` 或被 `ErrorMessage` 替换；有效号码会显示勾号。键盘操作：在国家按钮上，ArrowDown / ArrowUp 打开列表，可打印字符键会打开列表并以该字符作为搜索初始值；在搜索框中，ArrowDown / ArrowUp、PageDown / PageUp（8 行）、Home / End（搜索框为空时）可移动，Enter 选择，Escape 关闭并返回按钮，Tab 关闭。在号码中，在分隔符上按 Backspace / Delete 会删除其旁边的数字。

trans-unit.source: A small surface anchored to a trigger and opened by a click, for interactive content that should not block the page: share settings, a small filter form, a picker built from your own controls. Two ways to use it: Code can open any content anchored to any control with `ShowAt`. The panel starts 5px toward its trigger at scale 0.97, fades in fast and settles on a spring from the side it actually landed on; it leaves in about 160ms at half the travel, and an open and a close reverse each other mid-flight. Escape and a press outside close it and return focus to the trigger; focus moves into the panel on open. The trigger answers presses with color only (no press scale), since the panel is measured against it.
trans-unit.target: 一个锚定在触发器上、由点击打开的小型浮层，适用于不应阻塞页面的交互内容：分享设置、小型筛选表单、由您自己的控件组成的选择器。有两种用法：代码可通过 `ShowAt` 将任意内容锚定到任意控件上打开。面板从触发器方向偏移 5px 开始，缩放比例为 0.97，快速淡入并以弹簧从实际落位的一侧稳定下来；关闭时约 160ms 内完成，移动距离为一半，且打开与关闭在过程中可相互反转。按下 Escape 或在外部按下会关闭面板，并将焦点返回触发器；打开时焦点会移入面板。触发器仅以颜色响应按下（无按压缩放），因为面板是相对于它测量的。

trans-unit.source: Alignment along the trigger edge (default Start).
trans-unit.target: 沿触发器边缘的对齐方式（默认 Start）。

trans-unit.source: Shows how much of a known task is complete (Arc Progress). One smooth spring drives both the fill and the counted percentage, so the number always matches the bar; the fill slides in from the left (keeping its round end) and turns to the success color at 100%, where a check settles in beside the count. `Minimum` is treated as 0 like Arc; a non-positive `Maximum` counts as 100.
trans-unit.target: 显示已知任务的完成进度（Arc 进度条）。同一个平滑弹簧同时驱动填充与计数百分比，因此数字始终与进度条一致；填充从左侧滑入（保留圆形末端），达到 100% 时变为成功色，同时一个对勾在计数旁落定。`Minimum` 与 Arc 一致，视为 0；非正数的 `Maximum` 按 100 计算。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsComplete` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `IsComplete` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Shows the counted percentage and, at 100%, a check (Arc `showValue`).
trans-unit.target: 显示计数的百分比；达到 100% 时还会显示对勾（Arc 的 `showValue`）。

trans-unit.source: Visible label above the bar; it is also the accessible name (defaults to "Progress").
trans-unit.target: 进度条上方的可见标签；同时也是无障碍名称（默认为 "Progress"）。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Percentage` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Percentage` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Shows a number as a horizontal bar with its text at the right edge. The value is read against `Minimum` and `Maximum` (0 to 100 by default, which suits a percent column).
trans-unit.target: 把数字显示为水平条，文字显示在右端。值按 `Minimum` 和 `Maximum` 读取（默认 0 到 100，适合百分比列）。

trans-unit.source: A compact sprint board: a few stages as columns, each task a card that the arrow buttons send one stage left or right, a sprint line that fills as tasks reach the finished stage, a team row, an All work / My work switch and an Add button. A moved card flies in a straight line to the end of its new column while the old column closes up; filtered cards fade out in place as the others close the gap. Everything works with Tab, Enter and Space, and screen readers hear each move. Sized for tens of tasks; for hundreds, drag and drop and virtualization, use a full kanban board.
trans-unit.target: 紧凑的冲刺看板：若干阶段作为列，每个任务是一张卡片，箭头按钮可将其向左或向右移动一个阶段；冲刺进度条随任务到达已完成阶段而填充；团队行、All work / My work 切换开关以及添加按钮。被移动的卡片会沿直线飞到新列末尾，原列随之收拢；被筛选的卡片在原位淡出，其他卡片则填补空缺。全部操作均可通过 Tab、Enter 和空格键完成，屏幕阅读器会播报每次移动。适用于数十个任务；数百个任务时，需要拖放与虚拟化，请改用完整的看板。

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of prompt caching. Up to four requests share a prompt prefix (tool schemas, instructions, documents, the chat so far) and add a new message each. The first processes every segment in one steady sweep and carries the prefix into the cache panel, where a time-to-live ring fills; later requests read the prefix back under one passing band and only process their message, and their processed tokens, input cost and first-token time roll down from the row above. A toggle edits one segment: the next request matches the cache only up to it, shows a break there and writes the rest again. When no request arrives the ring drains on an accelerated clock and the cache expires; then the round starts over. The totals roll into the input cost saved and the first-token speedup. Costs and times are computed from `Pricing` and `FirstTokenEstimator`; the numbers are illustrative.
trans-unit.target: 提示缓存的动画讲解。最多四个请求共享一段提示前缀（工具架构、指令、文档、至今的对话），并各自添加一条新消息。第一个请求以稳定的一次扫过处理每个段落，并将前缀带入缓存面板，其中的存活时间环逐渐填满；后续请求在一条掠过的光带下读回前缀，只处理它们的消息，而它们处理的 token、输入成本与首个 token 时间会从上一行向下滚入。切换开关可编辑一个段落：下一个请求只会匹配到该段落为止的缓存，在那里显示断点，并重新写入其余部分。若没有请求到达，存活时间环会以加速的时钟排空，缓存随之过期；然后整轮重新开始。合计数值汇总为节省的输入成本与首个 token 加速比。成本与时间由 `Pricing` 和 `FirstTokenEstimator` 计算；数字仅为示意。

One selection ring springs from card to card, so the eye follows the change, and a 6px dot pops into the chosen card's indicator. Behaves as a radio group: one tab stop, arrows (mirrored in right-to-left) move and select, Home / End jump to the ends and Enter / Space select. Disabled cards are skipped and show their reason. Cards come from `ItemsSource` or inline `RadioCardOption` items; `SelectedValue` (two-way) is the selected option's value.
trans-unit.target: Arc 单选卡片：用于需要超过文字标签的选择（套餐、配送速度、地区）的可选选项卡片。单个选中环会从一张卡片弹向另一张，让视线跟随变化；选中卡片的指示器中会弹出一个 6px 的圆点。其行为与单选组一致：只有一个 Tab 停靠点，方向键（在从右到左的布局中镜像）移动并选中，Home / End 跳到两端，Enter / Space 选中。禁用的卡片会被跳过，并显示其原因。卡片来自 `ItemsSource` 或内联的 `RadioCardOption` 项；`SelectedValue`（双向绑定）为所选选项的值。

trans-unit.source: A choice is required (reported to assistive technology).
trans-unit.target: 必须进行选择（会告知辅助技术）。

trans-unit.source: Card placement: Grid (responsive columns, the default) or List (full-width rows with the meta at the end).
trans-unit.target: 卡片排列方式：Grid（响应式列，默认）或 List（全宽行，元信息位于末尾）。

trans-unit.source: Narrowest a grid column may get before the grid drops a column (Arc default 180).
trans-unit.target: 网格列可收窄到的最小宽度，低于此宽度时网格会减少一列（Arc 默认 180）。

trans-unit.source: Arc radio group: choose one option from a visible set. One highlight (a `ControlOn` border with a faint fill) glides to the chosen row on the morph spring while the new dot springs in and the old one shrinks away, so a change reads as a single physical move. Arrow keys take the same path; the group is one tab stop (the selected row). Options come from `ItemsSource` or inline `RadioOption` items; `SelectedValue` (two-way) is the selected option's `Value`. The `Header` is the legend and the group's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: Arc 单选组：从一组可见选项中选择其一。一个高亮框（`ControlOn` 边框加淡色填充）会以形变弹簧滑动到所选行，新的圆点弹入，旧的圆点缩小消失，因此变化看起来像一次连贯的物理移动。方向键走同样的路径；整个组只有一个 Tab 停靠点（所选行）。选项来自 `ItemsSource` 或内联的 `RadioOption` 项；`SelectedValue`（双向绑定）为所选选项的 `Value`。`Header` 为图例，也是该组的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: One option of a `RadioGroup` (Arc `{ value, label, description? }`). Use it in `ItemsSource` or inline in XAML; the group reports `Value` as its `SelectedValue`.
trans-unit.target: `RadioGroup` 的一个选项（Arc 的 `{ value, label, description? }`）。可用于 `ItemsSource` 或 XAML 内联；该组会将 `Value` 作为其 `SelectedValue` 报告。

trans-unit.source: Fails a number outside `Minimum` and `Maximum`; empty values and other types pass.
trans-unit.target: 数字超出 `Minimum` 和 `Maximum` 时不通过；空值和其他类型通过。

trans-unit.source: The state of one reaction (Arc's `Reaction`): how many people chose it and whether the viewer did. A reaction whose count reaches zero leaves the bar.
trans-unit.target: 单个回应的状态（Arc 的 `Reaction`）：选择它的人数，以及观看者是否已选择。计数降为零的回应会离开回应栏。

trans-unit.source: One reaction the picker offers (Arc's `ReactionOption`): an id, a label and a 24×24 Lucide glyph.
trans-unit.target: 选取器提供的一个回应（Arc 的 `ReactionOption`）：包含 id、标签和一个 24×24 的 Lucide 图形。

trans-unit.source: Arc reactions: a bar of reaction pills with counts plus an add button that opens a compact picker, like Slack's reactions on a comment, post or release note. One tap adds or removes the viewer's reaction: the count rolls (only the digits that change, in the direction it moved), the icon gets a velocity kick that stacks on quick taps (P27), the viewer's own reactions take the accent and a filled glyph. Pills scale in out of a blur and leave the bar when their count reaches zero while the rest glide into place (P26, P19); a new row grows the bar on a spring (P6). Hovering or focusing a pill shows its label and who reacted (`Tooltip`). Keyboard: Enter / Space toggles a pill or opens the picker; in the picker every arrow moves and wraps, Home / End jump, Enter picks, Escape closes and returns focus to the add button. Each change is announced politely.
trans-unit.target: Arc 回应：一排带计数的回应胶囊，以及一个打开紧凑选取器的添加按钮，类似 Slack 在评论、帖子或发布说明上的回应。单击即可添加或移除观看者的回应：计数滚动（仅滚动变化的数字，方向与变化方向一致），图标会获得速度冲击，快速连点时叠加（P27）；观看者自己的回应使用强调色和实心图形。胶囊从模糊中缩放出现，计数降为零时离开回应栏，其余胶囊滑动就位（P26、P19）；新增一行时，回应栏会以弹簧扩展（P6）。悬停或聚焦到胶囊上会显示其标签以及谁做出了回应（`Tooltip`）。键盘操作：Enter / Space 切换胶囊或打开选取器；在选取器中，所有方向键都会移动并循环，Home / End 跳转，Enter 选取，Escape 关闭并将焦点返回添加按钮。每次变化都会以礼貌方式通报。

trans-unit.target: 添加按钮的名称与提示（默认 "Add reaction"）。

trans-unit.target: 选取器打开时为 true。

trans-unit.target: 显示的回应，按回应栏中的顺序排列（双向绑定）。计数降为零的回应会离开回应栏。

trans-unit.target: 观看者添加或移除回应时触发（Arc 的 onValueChange），在 `Value` 变化之后。

trans-unit.source: One thought of a `ReasoningTree`: a short label for the node, the full sentence for the tag and screen readers, an illustrative score and the thoughts it leads to. The tree reads three levels: the thoughts given to `Thoughts` are depth 1, their children depth 2 and their grandchildren depth 3; deeper thoughts are ignored. Add a thought to one parent only.
trans-unit.target: `ReasoningTree` 中的一个思路：节点的简短标签、用于标签与屏幕阅读器的完整句子、一个示意分数，以及它所通向的思路。树会呈现三个层级：给予 `Thoughts` 的思路为深度 1，它们的子节点为深度 2，孙节点为深度 3；更深的思路将被忽略。请只把一个思路添加到一个父节点下。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Key` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Key` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Label` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Label` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Score` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Score` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Text` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Text` 属性。

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of tree search over thoughts (tree of thoughts with beam search). Each depth proposes candidate thoughts as edges draw out of their parents, scores them with bars that fill while the digits count, keeps the best `BeamWidth` and prunes the rest (they fade and their edges retract), and the survivors expand one depth further, up to three. The last depth picks its best thought as the answer, and the winning path draws from the question to the answer with a sheen at its head while each node on it lights up. Play, pause, step and restart drive the story; the beam width control starts it over. Wide cards read left to right in four columns; narrow ones become an indented outline. The scores are illustrative values, not the output of a model.
trans-unit.target: 对思路进行树搜索（思路树加束搜索）的动画讲解。每个深度会提出候选思路，边线从其父节点中抽出；随着数字计数，条形逐渐填满以为其打分；保留最佳的 `BeamWidth` 个并剪枝其余（它们淡出，边线收回），幸存者再向下展开一层，最多三层。最后一层选出其最佳思路作为答案，获胜路径从问题沿线绘制至答案，光泽位于其头部，路径上的每个节点依次亮起。宽卡片从左到右分为四列阅读；窄卡片则变为缩进的大纲。播放、暂停、单步和重新开始驱动演示过程；束宽控件会使其重新开始。分数为示意值，并非模型的输出。

trans-unit.target: 定义 `Answer` 属性。

trans-unit.target: `Answered` 的参数：搜索到达的答案，以及它是如何得出的。

trans-unit.source: Every word a `ReasoningTree` shows or announces, in English by default: column headers, the header status, the beam width label, the tag and accessible names of the thoughts and the polite announcements. Replace the instance to translate or reword; sentences with numbers are functions so that word order can change. The playback buttons are named by `PlaybackLabels`.
trans-unit.target: `ReasoningTree` 显示或宣读的每一个文字，默认为英文：列标题、标题状态、束宽标签、思路的标签与无障碍名称，以及实时区域的播报。替换整个实例即可翻译或改写；包含数字的句子为函数，以便调整词序。播放按钮的名称由 `PlaybackLabels` 指定。

trans-unit.source: One check of a `ReleaseReadiness` gate: a title, an optional line under it and whether it is done. Every required check must be done before the release can start; optional checks (`IsRequired` false) are shown and can be ticked, but do not hold the release back.
trans-unit.target: `ReleaseReadiness` 关卡中的一个检查项：一个标题、标题下方的一行可选说明，以及是否已完成。发布开始前，所有必需检查项都必须完成；可选检查项（`IsRequired` 为 false）会显示并可勾选，但不会阻止发布。

trans-unit.source: The line under the title; also read as the checkbox's help text. Null shows the title alone.
trans-unit.target: 标题下方的一行说明，同时也作为复选框的帮助文字朗读。为 null 时只显示标题。

trans-unit.source: Whether the check is done (two-way: ticking the checkbox writes it back).
trans-unit.target: 检查项是否已完成（双向绑定：勾选复选框会将其写回）。

trans-unit.source: The value `Reset` puts back. When it is not set, Reset puts back the value `IsDone` had when the block first showed the check.
trans-unit.target: `Reset` 恢复的值。未设置时，Reset 恢复区块首次显示该检查项时 `IsDone` 的值。

trans-unit.source: A release gate: a few checks that must all be done before the one action unlocks. A header names the release and its owners, a bar fills as checks are ticked (and turns green when every required one is done), a switch chooses whether to notify a channel, and the button runs `ReleaseAction`. While it runs the button shows a spinner and the checks lock; on success the button reads `ReleasedText`, a status line opens under the footer and a reset button appears; on failure the error shows in the same line and the release can be tried again.
trans-unit.target: 发布关卡：若干检查项，必须全部完成后才能解锁唯一的操作。标题栏列出发布名称及其负责人，进度条随检查项勾选而填充（所有必需项完成后变为绿色），开关决定是否通知频道，按钮运行 `ReleaseAction`。运行期间按钮显示加载指示，检查项被锁定；成功时按钮显示 `ReleasedText`，页脚下方打开状态行，并出现重置按钮；失败时错误信息显示在同一行，并可再次尝试发布。

trans-unit.source: The word joining the last two owners' names ("and").
trans-unit.target: 连接最后两位负责人姓名的词（"and"）。

trans-unit.source: The channel told about the release ("#launches"), used by the switch and the success line.
trans-unit.target: 接收发布通知的频道（"#launches"），由开关和成功信息行使用。

trans-unit.source: Arc's reorderable list: organize items with direct drag and drop. Rows are dragged by their grip (pointer capture): the row lifts, follows the pointer, the rows it passes slide aside on springs and the drop settles on a quick spring with the release velocity; holding a row near the edge of a scrolling ancestor scrolls it. Keyboard: ↑/↓ on a grip moves the row one place at once (Arc), Space / Enter picks it up so arrows preview the move, Space / Enter drops it and Escape cancels; every step is announced. A mutable `ItemsSource` (or inline items) is reordered in place; `Reordered` reports each move. Drag motion is render transforms only.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可重排列表：通过直接拖放整理项目。行通过抓手拖动（指针捕获）：行会抬起并跟随指针，经过的行会以弹簧滑开，释放时以快速弹簧结合释放速度落定；将行按住在滚动祖先的边缘附近会滚动它。键盘操作：抓手上的 ↑/↓ 会立即将该行移动一位（与 Arc 一致），Space / Enter 拾起该行，此时方向键可预览移动，Space / Enter 放下，Escape 取消；每一步都会被通报。可变的 `ItemsSource`（或内联项）会就地重新排序；`Reordered` 报告每次移动。拖动动效仅使用渲染变换。

trans-unit.source: Title used in the grip's accessible name and in announcements (defaults to `Title` or the item text).
trans-unit.target: 用于抓手无障碍名称与通报的标题（默认为 `Title` 或项目文本）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the list.
trans-unit.target: 列表的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: When true (default) a mutable source is reordered in place; otherwise only `Reordered` is raised.
trans-unit.target: 为 true（默认）时，可变的数据源会就地重新排序；否则仅引发 `Reordered`。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a row was moved by dragging or from the keyboard.
trans-unit.target: 通过拖动或键盘移动某一行之后引发。

trans-unit.source: A row of a `ReorderableList` as Arc models it: an id, a title and an optional detail line.
trans-unit.target: Arc 建模的 `ReorderableList` 中的一行：包含一个 id、一个标题和一个可选的详细信息行。

trans-unit.source: Fails an empty value (null, empty text).
trans-unit.target: 空值（null、空文字）不通过。

trans-unit.source: One pane of a `ResizablePanels` group. It carries the pane's configuration (label, default share, limits, collapsibility) and shows its content. Below its minimum the content keeps its minimum width, stays anchored to the moving edge and fades, so a closing pane slides away like a drawer instead of being crushed.
trans-unit.target: `ResizablePanels` 组中的一个窗格。它承载窗格的配置（标签、默认占比、限制、是否可折叠）并显示其内容。低于最小尺寸时，内容保持最小宽度，锚定在移动的边缘并淡出，因此关闭中的窗格会像抽屉一样滑走，而不是被挤压。

trans-unit.source: Starting share of the group; shares are relative and need not add up to 100.
trans-unit.target: 组的起始占比；占比为相对值，不必加起来等于 100。

trans-unit.source: Stable id (dividers reference panes by id).
trans-unit.target: 稳定的 id（分隔线通过 id 引用窗格）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the pane is hidden. Two-way; the initial value is Arc's defaultCollapsed (needs `IsCollapsible`).
trans-unit.target: 窗格是否已隐藏。双向绑定；初始值取 Arc 的 defaultCollapsed（需要 `IsCollapsible`）。

trans-unit.source: Dragging well past the minimum, or flicking toward the edge, snaps the pane closed.
trans-unit.target: 拖动明显超过最小尺寸，或朝边缘快速轻扫时，窗格会吸附关闭。

trans-unit.source: Names the pane for its divider, for example "Folders".
trans-unit.target: 为分隔线标注该窗格的名称，例如 "Folders"。

trans-unit.source: Maximum width in px (infinite by default).
trans-unit.target: 最大宽度，单位为 px（默认无限制）。

trans-unit.source: Width in px where the pane starts to resist (Arc: 80). Its content never reflows below it.
trans-unit.target: 窗格开始产生阻力的宽度，单位为 px（Arc 为 80）。低于此宽度时内容不会重排。

trans-unit.source: Arc resizable panels: a horizontal split view whose panes trade space when the dividers between them are dragged, the way a mail or code editor window works. Dividers follow the pointer 1:1, resist past a pane's limits (rubber band up to 44px) and snap collapsible panes closed when dragged well past their minimum or flicked toward the edge; on release the panes settle on the smooth spring keeping the pointer's velocity. Each divider is focusable: arrows resize by 16px (Shift 64px) on the snappy spring, Home / End jump to the limits, Enter hides or restores a collapsible neighbour, Escape during a drag puts the divider back, and a double-click resets the layout. The group needs a definite height. `Sizes` (two-way, percent) persists the layout.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可调整大小的窗格：水平分割视图，拖动其间的分隔线时窗格之间相互让出空间，与邮件或代码编辑器窗口的方式相同。分隔线以 1:1 紧随指针，超出窗格限制时产生回弹（最多 44px）；拖到明显超过最小尺寸，或朝边缘快速轻扫时，可折叠窗格会吸附关闭。松开后，窗格会以保留指针速度的平滑弹簧稳定下来。每条分隔线都可获得焦点：方向键每次调整 16px（按住 Shift 为 64px），使用灵敏弹簧；Home / End 跳到限制位置；Enter 隐藏或恢复可折叠的相邻窗格；拖动过程中按 Escape 会将分隔线复位；双击会重置布局。该组需要确定的高度。`Sizes`（双向，百分比）用于保存布局。

trans-unit.source: Names the group for assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 为该组命名，供辅助技术使用。

trans-unit.source: Raised with each pane's share in percent after a resize settles.
trans-unit.target: 调整大小稳定后引发，附带每个窗格的占比（百分比）。

trans-unit.source: Each pane's share in percent. Updated after every resize settles; set it (for example from saved settings) to restore a layout. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 每个窗格的占比（百分比）。每次调整大小稳定后更新；设置它（例如从保存的设置中读取）即可恢复布局。双向绑定。

trans-unit.source: A city on a `RevenueGlobe`: where payments come from (and, for `Headquarters`, where they go). Coordinates are in degrees; the city's local time uses `UtcOffsetHours`.
trans-unit.target: `RevenueGlobe` 上的城市：付款从这里发出（对于 `Headquarters`，则是付款的去向）。坐标以度为单位；城市的本地时间由 `UtcOffsetHours` 决定。

trans-unit.source: A live payments map: a dotted globe on which every payment flies as an arc from its city to the headquarters, a day timeline under it (payments per 15 minutes, the playhead, replay and live controls), and a panel with today's revenue, the regions against their forecast and the top cities. Drag the globe to spin it (it glides and drifts back and forth when idle), hover a city for its figures, pick a city or a region to fly there, replay the day at 1500× or drag the playhead to any moment; every figure follows the playhead.
trans-unit.target: 实时付款地图：地球上的每笔付款都会以弧线从其城市飞向总部，地球下方是一条全天时间轴（每 15 分钟的付款笔数、播放头、回放与实时控件），另有一个面板显示今日营收、各区域相对预测的情况以及热门城市。拖动地球可使其旋转（松手后会滑行，空闲时会来回漂移）；悬停城市可查看其数据；选择城市或区域即可飞至该处；可以 1500× 的速度回放当天，或拖动播放头到任意时刻；所有数字都会随播放头变化。

trans-unit.source: Arc's light rich text editor: Markdown shortcuts as you type, a floating selection toolbar that morphs into a link field, a slash menu for blocks, its own undo history, and HTML plus Markdown output. Blocks are paragraphs, three heading levels, nested bulleted and numbered lists, quotes, code blocks and dividers; inline marks are bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code and links.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的轻量富文本编辑器：输入时支持 Markdown 快捷语法，浮动的选区工具栏可变形为链接输入框，斜杠菜单用于插入块，拥有独立的撤销历史，并支持 HTML 和 Markdown 输出。块包括段落、三级标题、嵌套的无序和有序列表、引用、代码块和分隔线；行内标记包括粗体、斜体、删除线、行内代码和链接。

trans-unit.source: A ridgeline (joy plot, Arc "Ridgeline"): one smoothed density curve per group, overlapping like ridges and shaded by median. Every curve is sampled on a shared 96-point grid, so a new dataset or domain morphs each ridge from its on-screen shape on one 0.7s spring; the first view rolls the rows in from the top. Hover or ↑ / ↓ lifts a ridge (a copy drawn above the rest) with its middle half and median; ← / → move a reading cursor along the values.
trans-unit.target: 山脊图（joy plot，即 Arc 的 "Ridgeline"）：每组一条平滑的密度曲线，像山脊一样相互重叠，并按中位数着色。所有曲线都在共享的 96 点网格上采样，因此新的数据集或取值范围会通过一个 0.7s 的弹簧，使每条山脊从当前屏幕形状变形过渡；首次显示时各行从顶部滚入。悬停或按 ↑ / ↓ 可抬起一条山脊（在其他山脊上方绘制一份副本），并显示其中间一半和中位数；← / → 沿数值移动读数光标。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the lifted ridge changes.

trans-unit.source: Arc scroll area: native scrolling (wheel, keyboard, touch inertia, snap points) with thin overlay scrollbars that appear while scrolling or hovering and fade away at rest, and edge fades that appear only where content continues, each exactly as long as the content hidden past that edge (up to `FadeLength`). The thumb thickens under the pointer, can be dragged, and pressing the track pages toward the pointer.
trans-unit.target: Arc 滚动区域：原生滚动（滚轮、键盘、触摸惯性、吸附点），搭配细窄的覆盖式滚动条，滚动或悬停时出现、静止时淡出；边缘淡出仅在内容继续延伸处出现，每段淡出的长度与该边缘之外被隐藏的内容相符（最长为 `FadeLength`）。滚动条滑块在指针下方会变粗、可拖动，按下轨道会朝指针方向翻页。

trans-unit.source: Which edges still have content beyond them.
trans-unit.target: 仍有内容延伸到其外的边缘。

trans-unit.source: Raised when content starts or stops extending past an edge.
trans-unit.target: 内容开始或停止延伸越过某个边缘时引发。

trans-unit.source: Length of each edge fade in px (Arc: 28). 0 turns the fades off.
trans-unit.target: 每个边缘淡出的长度，单位为 px（Arc 为 28）。0 表示关闭淡出。

trans-unit.target: 可滚动的轴。默认为 `Vertical`。

trans-unit.source: When the overlay scrollbars show.
