trans-unit.source: Arc's Scrub input: a compact, Figma-style number field for inspectors and property panels. Drag the label sideways to scrub the value (Shift ten times coarser, Alt ten times finer, switching live and shown in a tag above the field), or click in and type an exact value: entries accept arithmetic such as `12*2` or `(100-24)/2` and a unit from `Units` such as `50%` (see `ScrubExpression`). Arrow keys step, Enter commits, Escape restores the last value, and a double click on the label restores `ResetValue`. At `Minimum` and `Maximum` the field strains past the limit with rubber band resistance and springs back on release; a rejected entry shakes and turns the edge red for 900ms. The row has no label or message rows of its own (the label is the drag handle) and fills its column by default.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的 Scrub 输入框：紧凑的 Figma 风格数字字段，适用于检查器和属性面板。横向拖动标签即可调整数值（按住 Shift 时粗 10 倍，按住 Alt 时细 10 倍，切换时实时生效，并在字段上方的提示中显示），也可以点击进入并输入精确值：输入内容支持 `12*2` 或 `(100-24)/2` 等算术表达式，以及 `Units` 中的单位，例如 `50%`（参见 `ScrubExpression`）。方向键逐步调整，Enter 提交，Escape 恢复上一个值，双击标签会恢复 `ResetValue`。到达 `Minimum` 和 `Maximum` 时，字段会以橡皮筋式阻力越过限制，松开后回弹；被拒绝的输入会抖动，并将边缘变为红色 900ms。该行本身没有标签或消息行（标签即拖动手柄），默认填满其所在列。

trans-unit.source: Step with Shift held (null: ten times `Step`).
trans-unit.target: 按住 Shift 时的步长（null：为 `Step` 的 10 倍）。

trans-unit.source: Step with Alt held (null: a tenth of `Step`).
trans-unit.target: 按住 Alt 时的步长（null：为 `Step` 的十分之一）。

trans-unit.source: True for 900ms after a rejected entry.
trans-unit.target: 被拒绝的输入之后的 900ms 内为 true。

trans-unit.source: Arc's `pointerLock`, kept for API parity (default true). Avalonia has no pointer lock, so scrubbing always uses normal pointer capture, as Arc does when a browser refuses the lock: a long drag can reach the screen edge.
trans-unit.target: 对应 Arc 的 `pointerLock`，仅为保持 API 一致而保留（默认 true）。Avalonia 没有指针锁定，因此调整数值时始终使用普通的指针捕获，与浏览器拒绝锁定时 Arc 的做法相同：长距离拖动可能会到达屏幕边缘。

trans-unit.source: True while the label is being dragged.
trans-unit.target: 拖动标签期间为 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the value's position between the limits as a quiet wash (null: on when both limits are finite).
trans-unit.target: 以柔和的底色显示数值在上下限之间的位置（null：两个上下限均为有限值时显示）。

trans-unit.source: Values wrap from the maximum to the minimum instead of stopping (needs both limits, Maximum > Minimum).
trans-unit.target: 数值从最大值回绕到最小值，而不是停止（需要两个上下限，且 Maximum > Minimum）。

trans-unit.source: The label, which is also the drag handle: text (weight 500) or a control such as a 14px `ArcGlyph`.
trans-unit.target: 标签，同时也是拖动手柄：文本（字重 500）或控件，例如 14px 的 `ArcGlyph`。

trans-unit.source: Upper limit (default positive infinity: none).
trans-unit.target: 上限（默认为正无穷：无上限）。

trans-unit.source: Lower limit (default negative infinity: none).
trans-unit.target: 下限（默认为负无穷：无下限）。

trans-unit.source: Pointer travel in px for one step while scrubbing (default 2).
trans-unit.target: 拖动时指针移动多少 px 变化一步（默认 2）。

trans-unit.source: Decimal places kept (null: the larger of the decimals of `Step` and the fine step).
trans-unit.target: 保留的小数位数（null：取 `Step` 与细步长中较大的小数位数）。

trans-unit.source: A double click on the label returns here (null: no reset).
trans-unit.target: 双击标签后返回的值（null：不重置）。

trans-unit.source: Small (30px, 12px text) or Medium (36px, 14px text, default). Arc has no large size: Large renders as Medium.
trans-unit.target: Small（30px，12px 文字）或 Medium（36px，14px 文字，默认）。Arc 没有 Large 尺寸：Large 会渲染为 Medium。

trans-unit.source: One step for arrows and scrubbing (default 1).
trans-unit.target: 方向键和拖动时每次变化的步长（默认 1）。

trans-unit.source: The unit after the number (two-way). Null shows the first of `Units`, or none.
trans-unit.target: 数字后面的单位（双向绑定）。为 null 时显示 `Units` 中的第一个单位，或不显示单位。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the unit button; `{0}` is the unit (Arc: "Unit: px. Change unit").
trans-unit.target: 单位按钮的无障碍名称；`{0}` 为单位（Arc 为 "Unit: px. Change unit"）。

trans-unit.source: Units a typed value may carry; with more than one the unit becomes a button that cycles them.
trans-unit.target: 输入值可携带的单位；多于一个时，单位会变为一个按钮，点击即可循环切换。

trans-unit.source: The value (two-way, default 0).
trans-unit.target: 数值（双向绑定，默认 0）。

trans-unit.source: Raised for every real change of `Value`: each step of a scrub, typed entries, key steps and resets (Arc's `onValueChange`), and values set from code or a binding (`Programmatic`).
trans-unit.target: `Value` 每次实际变化时引发：拖动的每一步、键入的输入、方向键步进和重置，以及从代码或绑定设置的值（`Programmatic`）（对应 Arc 的 `onValueChange`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised once when a change settles: a scrub ends (or is cancelled), Enter or blur commits typing, a key step lands, or a reset. Like Arc it also fires when a commit leaves the value unchanged (a clamped entry at the limit).
trans-unit.target: 变化稳定后引发一次：拖动结束（或被取消）、按下 Enter 或失焦提交输入、方向键步进落定，或重置时。与 Arc 一致，即使提交后值未变（例如在上限处被钳制的输入）也会引发。

trans-unit.source: A date range over `Date`, edited with a two-thumb slider. The range spans `Minimum` to `Maximum` (the oldest and newest item date when null); `Start` and `End` are the chosen ends (null: that end of the range). Items of kinds outside `AppliesTo` pass the filter, so a range over documents does not hide people.
trans-unit.target: 按 `Date` 的日期范围，通过双滑块编辑。范围从 `Minimum` 到 `Maximum`（为 null 时取最早和最新项目的日期）；`Start` 和 `End` 为所选的两端（为 null 时该端取范围边界）。不在 `AppliesTo` 所列种类之内的项目不受此筛选影响，因此针对文档的日期范围不会隐藏人员。

trans-unit.source: The kinds the range applies to, as a comma separated list ("Docs, Files"). Empty: every item. Also words the default caption ("Applies to docs and files").
trans-unit.target: 此范围适用的种类，以逗号分隔的列表表示（"Docs, Files"）。为空时适用于所有项目。也用于默认注脚的文字（"Applies to docs and files"）。

trans-unit.source: The chosen end of the range (two-way). Null: the maximum.
trans-unit.target: 所选的范围结束端（双向绑定）。为 null 时取最大值。

trans-unit.source: The newest date the slider reaches. Null: the newest item date.
trans-unit.target: 滑块能到达的最新日期。为 null 时取最新项目的日期。

trans-unit.source: The oldest date the slider reaches. Null: the oldest item date.
trans-unit.target: 滑块能到达的最早日期。为 null 时取最早项目的日期。

trans-unit.source: The chosen start of the range (two-way). Null: the minimum.
trans-unit.target: 所选的范围起始端（双向绑定）。为 null 时取最小值。

trans-unit.source: Arc search field: a labeled search input with a leading glass that wakes up (full contrast) while the field is focused or filled, and a clear button that pops into a reserved slot, so the field never changes width. Every keystroke updates the two-way `Text` (debounce expensive filtering yourself); Escape clears the field, Enter raises `SearchSubmitted`, and clearing with the button returns focus to the field.
trans-unit.target: Arc 搜索框：带标签的搜索输入框，左侧的放大镜图标在字段获得焦点或已填入内容时亮起（全对比度），清除按钮会出现在预留的位置，因此字段宽度永远不会改变。每次击键都会更新双向绑定的 `Text`（开销大的过滤请自行做防抖处理）；Escape 清空字段，Enter 引发 `SearchSubmitted`，用按钮清空后焦点会回到字段。

trans-unit.source: Name of the clear button.
trans-unit.target: 清除按钮的名称。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Enter is pressed in the field.
trans-unit.target: 在字段中按下 Enter 时引发。

trans-unit.source: A way to narrow the results of a `SearchResults`: a `SearchValueFilter` (a group of checkbox values) or a `SearchDateFilter` (a date range). Filters AND together; the values of one value filter OR.
trans-unit.target: 用于缩小 `SearchResults` 结果的一种方式：`SearchValueFilter`（一组复选框值）或 `SearchDateFilter`（日期范围）。各筛选器之间为与关系；同一个值筛选器的各个值之间为或关系。

trans-unit.source: A muted line under the filter ("Applies to docs and files").
trans-unit.target: 筛选器下方的弱化提示行（"Applies to docs and files"）。

trans-unit.source: Names the attribute of `SearchResultItem` the filter reads (see `Attributes`).
trans-unit.target: 指定筛选器读取的 `SearchResultItem` 属性名（参见 `Attributes`）。

trans-unit.source: The heading above the filter ("Type", "Team", "Edited").
trans-unit.target: 筛选器上方的标题（"Type"、"Team"、"Edited"）。

trans-unit.source: One value of a `SearchValueFilter`: a checkbox with a label and a count.
trans-unit.target: `SearchValueFilter` 的一个值：带文字标签和数量的复选框。

trans-unit.source: The results behind the value. `SearchResults` writes it while it filters; with `IsFilteringEnabled` false it is yours (a server's facet counts) and the control only reads it. A value with a count of 0 is dimmed and cannot be ticked, but keeps its place.
trans-unit.target: 该值对应的结果数量。`SearchResults` 在筛选时写入此值；当 `IsFilteringEnabled` 为 false 时由你设置（例如服务器的分面计数），控件只读取它。数量为 0 的值会变暗且无法勾选，但仍保留其位置。

trans-unit.source: Whether the checkbox is ticked (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 复选框是否已勾选（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: The text beside the checkbox; `Value` when null.
trans-unit.target: 复选框旁的文字；为 null 时使用 `Value`。

trans-unit.source: What an item's attribute has to equal (ignoring case).
trans-unit.target: 项目的属性必须等于的值（忽略大小写）。

trans-unit.source: One key/value row of a result's detail sheet.
trans-unit.target: 结果详情面板中的一行键值。

trans-unit.source: A person's photo for the avatar before the value.
trans-unit.target: 人物的照片，显示在值之前的头像中。

trans-unit.source: A person's name: a small avatar with their initials is shown before the value.
trans-unit.target: 人物的姓名：值之前会显示一个带其姓名首字母的小头像。

trans-unit.source: The muted name on the left ("Team").
trans-unit.target: 左侧弱化显示的名称（"Team"）。

trans-unit.source: A muted remark after the value ("3 weeks ago").
trans-unit.target: 值之后弱化显示的备注（"3 weeks ago"）。

trans-unit.source: The value on the right.
trans-unit.target: 右侧显示的值。

trans-unit.source: One searchable entry of a `SearchResults`: a document, a person, a file or anything else your workspace holds. `Kind` and `Attributes` feed the filters, the text properties are searched and shown, and the detail properties fill the sheet that opens when the result is chosen.
trans-unit.target: `SearchResults` 中一个可搜索的条目：文档、人员、文件或工作区中的任何其他内容。`Kind` 和 `Attributes` 用于筛选器；文本属性会被搜索并显示；详情属性会填充选中结果时打开的详情面板。

trans-unit.source: A photo for a person: the row and the detail show a round avatar instead of the icon.
trans-unit.target: 人物的照片：行和详情中会显示圆形头像而非图标。

trans-unit.source: A person's name: the avatar shows its initials (and the photo's fallback). Setting it switches the row to an avatar.
trans-unit.target: 人物的姓名：头像会显示其姓名首字母（也是照片加载失败时的回退内容）。设置后该行会切换为头像。

trans-unit.source: The paragraphs shown in the detail sheet, separated by blank lines. Searched and marked there.
trans-unit.target: 详情面板中显示的段落，以空行分隔。在此处进行搜索并醒目标示。

trans-unit.source: A last, muted line under the snippet, such as an email address. Not searched.
trans-unit.target: 摘录下方最后一行弱化显示的文字，例如电子邮件地址。不参与搜索。

trans-unit.source: When the result was last edited; sorts "Newest" and feeds a `SearchDateFilter`.
trans-unit.target: 结果最后编辑的时间；用于 "Newest" 排序，并为 `SearchDateFilter` 提供数据。

trans-unit.source: A 20px icon: a 24×24 Lucide `Geometry` or a control. Default: Lucide FileText.
trans-unit.target: 20px 图标：24×24 的 Lucide `Geometry` 或一个控件。默认为 Lucide FileText。

trans-unit.source: Stable id; the title is used when it is empty.
trans-unit.target: 稳定的 id；为空时使用标题。

trans-unit.source: When false the result is listed dimmed, skipped by the keyboard cursor and cannot be opened.
trans-unit.target: 为 false 时，该结果以淡化样式列出，键盘光标会跳过它，且无法打开。

trans-unit.source: Extra words that also find the result (synonyms, ids, tags).
trans-unit.target: 同样可用于查找结果的额外词语（同义词、id、标签）。

trans-unit.source: The type of the result ("Docs", "People", "Files"): the value of the filter whose key is `KindKey`.
trans-unit.target: 结果的类型（"Docs"、"People"、"Files"）：即键为 `KindKey` 的筛选器的值。

trans-unit.source: The singular name of the kind ("Doc") used in the subtitle and the detail sheet; `Kind` when null.
trans-unit.target: 该类型的单数名称（"文档"），用于副标题和详情面板；为 null 时使用 `Kind`。

trans-unit.source: Where the result lives: a path or a breadcrumb ("Engineering / Handbook"). Also searched.
trans-unit.target: 结果所在的位置：路径或面包屑（"Engineering / Handbook"）。同样参与搜索。

trans-unit.source: A passage of the content; long passages are cut to a window around the first match. Searched.
trans-unit.target: 内容的一段文字；较长的段落会裁剪为围绕第一个匹配项的一个窗口。参与搜索。

trans-unit.source: The line under the title (a person's role and city). When null the row shows "`KindLabel` in `Location`" (or just the location).
trans-unit.target: 标题下方的一行（人员的角色和城市）。为 null 时该行显示 "`KindLabel` in `Location`"（或仅显示位置）。

trans-unit.source: Any value you want back when the result is opened.
trans-unit.target: 任意希望在打开结果时取回的值。

trans-unit.source: The name of the result; searched first, marked where it matches and ranked by.
trans-unit.target: 结果的名称；优先参与搜索，匹配处会高亮显示，并作为排序依据。

trans-unit.source: The address "Copy link" puts on the clipboard.
trans-unit.target: "复制链接"写入剪贴板的地址。

trans-unit.source: A search results page for a workspace (an original TKCode design, after Algolia InstantSearch's search box, hits, highlight, refinement list and stats). A large search field with a suggestions popup (recent and suggested searches), a filters column (checkbox groups whose counts follow the query and the other filters, and a date range), a results header with the count, the time it took and a sort switch, the active filters as removable chips, and the results: people and documents in one list, matches marked in titles and in a snippet cut around the first match. One cursor block glides between the results; Enter or a click opens a result in a detail dialog (a bottom sheet on narrow screens). Below 560 the filters move behind a button into a sheet.
trans-unit.target: 工作区的搜索结果页面（TKCode 原创设计，参照 Algolia InstantSearch 的搜索框、命中结果、高亮、细化列表和统计信息）。包含一个大型搜索框及建议弹层（最近搜索和推荐搜索）、筛选列（复选框分组，其计数随查询和其他筛选条件变化，另有日期范围）、带数量、耗时和排序切换的结果标题栏、以可移除标签形式显示的已启用筛选器，以及结果列表：人员和文档混合显示，标题和摘录中的匹配项均会高亮，摘录围绕第一个匹配项裁剪。一个光标块在结果之间平滑移动；按 Enter 或点击可在详情对话框中打开结果（窄屏时为底部面板）。宽度小于 560 时，筛选器会收入按钮后的面板中。

trans-unit.source: The number of filter values ticked plus date ranges narrowed (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 已勾选的筛选值数量加上已缩小范围的日期范围数量（只读）。

trans-unit.source: The result under the cursor, or null.
trans-unit.target: 游标所在的结果，或为 null。

trans-unit.source: The word between the last two kinds of the default caption. Default "and".
trans-unit.target: 默认标题中最后两种类型之间的连接词。默认为 "and"。

trans-unit.source: The caption of a date filter without one; {0} lists its kinds ("docs and files"). Default "Applies to {0}".
trans-unit.target: 未设置标题的日期筛选器的标题；{0} 列出其类型（"docs and files"）。默认为 "Applies to {0}"。

trans-unit.source: The "Best match" sort option.
trans-unit.target: "最佳匹配"排序选项。

trans-unit.source: The link that clears every filter (in the column and in the active filters bar). Default "Clear all".
trans-unit.target: 清除所有筛选器的链接（位于筛选列和已启用筛选器栏中）。默认为 "Clear all"。

trans-unit.source: The empty state's button that clears the filters. Default "Clear filters".
trans-unit.target: 空状态中用于清除筛选器的按钮。默认为 "Clear filters"。

trans-unit.source: Names the clear button of the field. Default "Clear search".
trans-unit.target: 搜索框清除按钮的名称。默认为 "Clear search"。

trans-unit.source: Names the close buttons of the detail and the filters sheet. Default "Close".
trans-unit.target: 详情面板和筛选器面板关闭按钮的名称。默认为 "Close"。

trans-unit.source: The detail's secondary button. Default "Copy link".
trans-unit.target: 详情中的次要按钮。默认为 "Copy link"。

trans-unit.source: The month and year format of a date range ("Sep 2025"). Default "MMM yyyy".
trans-unit.target: 日期范围的月份和年份格式（"Sep 2025"）。默认为 "MMM yyyy"。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a button of the detail is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 按下详情中的按钮时触发。

trans-unit.source: Replaces the built-in content of the detail (everything between the header and the buttons); its data is the `SearchResultItem`.
trans-unit.target: 替换详情中的内置内容（标题与按钮之间的全部内容）；其数据为 `SearchResultItem`。

trans-unit.source: How long the search took, shown after the count ("in 0.12 seconds"). Null shows nothing; the app measures it.
trans-unit.target: 搜索耗时，显示在数量之后（"in 0.12 seconds"）。为 null 时不显示；耗时由应用测量。

trans-unit.source: The time after the count; {0} is the seconds. Default "in {0} seconds".
trans-unit.target: 数量之后的时间文本；{0} 为秒数。默认为 "in {0} seconds"。

trans-unit.source: Empty state description. Default "Check the spelling or try fewer words."
trans-unit.target: 空状态描述。默认为 "Check the spelling or try fewer words."

trans-unit.source: Empty state description while filters hide results. Default "The filters leave nothing. Remove one to see more."
trans-unit.target: 筛选器隐藏所有结果时的空状态描述。默认为 "The filters leave nothing. Remove one to see more."

trans-unit.source: Empty state title; {0} is the query. Default "No results for “{0}”".
trans-unit.target: 空状态标题；{0} 为查询内容。默认为“No results for “{0}””。

trans-unit.source: The narrow layout's button that opens the filters. Default "Filters".
trans-unit.target: 窄屏布局中用于打开筛选器的按钮。默认为 "Filters"。

trans-unit.source: The filters column title. Default "Filters".
trans-unit.target: 筛选列的标题。默认为 "Filters"。

trans-unit.source: True while at least one filter narrows the results (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 至少有一个筛选器缩小结果范围时为 true（只读）。

trans-unit.source: The key hint "to move". Default "to move,".
trans-unit.target: 按键提示"移动"。默认为 "to move,"。

trans-unit.source: The key hint "to open". Default "to open,".
trans-unit.target: 按键提示"打开"。默认为 "to open,"。

trans-unit.source: The key hint "to search". Default "to search".
trans-unit.target: 按键提示"搜索"。默认为 "to search"。

trans-unit.source: Executed with the opened `SearchResultItem`.
trans-unit.target: 以被打开的 `SearchResultItem` 执行。

trans-unit.source: Whether Enter or a click opens the built-in detail. Turn it off when your app navigates on `ItemInvoked`.
trans-unit.target: 按 Enter 或点击时是否打开内置详情。当应用在 `ItemInvoked` 中进行导航时请关闭此项。

trans-unit.source: When true (default) the items are matched, filtered, counted and sorted here. Set it to false when a server searched: the items are shown as given, `Count` is yours, and the query's terms are still marked.
trans-unit.target: 为 true（默认）时，项会在此处进行匹配、筛选、计数和排序。当搜索由服务器执行时请设为 false：项按原样显示，`Count` 由你自行提供，查询词仍会高亮标示。

trans-unit.source: Whether the keyboard hints show under the results. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 是否在结果下方显示键盘提示。默认 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows skeleton rows in place of the results (keeping the previous results' height).
trans-unit.target: 以骨架行代替结果显示（保持先前结果的高度）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the suggestions popup opens under the focused field. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 是否在获得焦点的输入框下方打开建议弹层。默认 true。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a result is opened with Enter or a click (before the detail shows; set Handled to skip the detail).
trans-unit.target: 通过 Enter 或点击打开结果时引发（在显示详情之前；设置 Handled 可跳过详情）。

trans-unit.source: Items to search; when null the inline `Items` are used. Collection changes are followed.
trans-unit.target: 要搜索的项目；为 null 时使用内联的 `Items`。会跟随集合的变化。

trans-unit.source: The kind and the location in a result's subtitle; {0} is the kind label, {1} the location. Default "{0} in {1}".
trans-unit.target: 结果副标题中的类型和位置；{0} 为类型标签，{1} 为位置。默认 "{0} in {1}"。

trans-unit.source: Names the search landmark and the search field.
trans-unit.target: 为搜索地标与搜索字段指定名称。

trans-unit.source: Stats text while `IsLoading` is true. Default "Searching…".
trans-unit.target: `IsLoading` 为 true 时的统计信息文本。默认为“Searching…”。

trans-unit.source: The first row of the detail table: how often the query matches. Default "Matches".
trans-unit.target: 详情表格的第一行：查询的匹配次数。默认 "Matches"。

trans-unit.source: How many recent searches are kept. Default 5.
trans-unit.target: 保留的最近搜索数量。默认 5。

trans-unit.source: The "Newest" sort option.
trans-unit.target: "Newest" 排序选项。

trans-unit.source: Stats text (and empty title without a query) when nothing matches. Default "No results".
trans-unit.target: 没有任何匹配时的统计信息文本（无查询时也用作空状态标题）。默认为“No results”。

trans-unit.source: Stats text for one result; {0} is the count. Default "{0} result".
trans-unit.target: 单个结果的统计文本；{0} 为数量。默认 "{0} result"。

trans-unit.source: The detail's primary button; {0} is the kind label in lower case. Default "Open {0}".
trans-unit.target: 详情的主按钮；{0} 为小写的类型标签。默认 "Open {0}"。

trans-unit.source: The result whose detail is open, or null (two-way). Setting it opens that result's detail.
trans-unit.target: 当前打开详情的结果，或为 null（双向）。设置此项会打开该结果的详情。

trans-unit.source: Results listed first; more follow when the list is scrolled to its end or "Show more" is pressed. Default 15.
trans-unit.target: 首先列出的结果数；当列表滚动到末尾或按下 "Show more" 时会加载更多。默认 15。

trans-unit.source: Hint in the empty search field.
trans-unit.target: 搜索框为空时的提示文字。

trans-unit.source: The text in the search field (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 搜索框中的文本（双向）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a query is submitted: Enter in the field, or a suggestion chosen.
trans-unit.target: 提交查询时引发：在输入框中按 Enter，或选择了某个建议时。

trans-unit.source: The group of recent searches in the popup. Default "Recent".
trans-unit.target: 弹层中最近搜索的分组。默认 "Recent"。

trans-unit.source: Names the remove button of a filter chip. Default "Remove filter".
trans-unit.target: 为筛选器标签的移除按钮命名。默认 "Remove filter"。

trans-unit.source: The number of results for the current query and filters.
trans-unit.target: 当前查询和筛选器下的结果数量。

trans-unit.source: Stats text for several results; {0} is the count (it rolls). Default "{0} results".
trans-unit.target: 多个结果的统计文本；{0} 为数量（数字会滚动更新）。默认 "{0} results"。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the query, a filter or the sort order changed (ask your server again).
trans-unit.target: 查询、筛选器或排序方式更改时引发（请让服务器重新搜索）。

trans-unit.source: The key hint on the field's keycap (the key that focuses it). Default "/".
trans-unit.target: 输入框键帽上的按键提示（即用于聚焦该输入框的按键）。默认 "/"。

trans-unit.source: Button under the listed results when more are left. Default "Show more".
trans-unit.target: 当仍有更多结果时，显示在已列出结果下方的按钮。默认 "Show more"。

trans-unit.source: How the results are ordered (two-way). Default `BestMatch`.
trans-unit.target: 结果的排序方式（双向）。默认 `BestMatch`。

trans-unit.source: The group of suggested searches in the popup. Default "Suggested".
trans-unit.target: 弹层中建议搜索的分组。默认 "Suggested"。

trans-unit.source: Queries offered under "Suggested" in the popup and when nothing matches; choosing one fills the search field.
trans-unit.target: 在弹层的 "Suggested" 下以及无匹配结果时提供的查询；选择其中一项会填充搜索框。

trans-unit.source: The "A to Z" sort option.
trans-unit.target: "A to Z" 排序选项。

trans-unit.source: The word before the suggestions of the empty state. Default "Try".
trans-unit.target: 空状态下建议之前的提示词。默认 "Try"。

trans-unit.source: A group of checkbox values over one attribute. Tick several values to see results with any of them. Leave `Values` empty to list the values found in the items (in the order they first appear); list them yourself to fix their order and labels. `SearchResults` writes each value's `Count`: the results that value would show with the query and the other filters applied.
trans-unit.target: 基于同一属性的一组复选框值。勾选多个值可查看匹配其中任一值的结果。将 `Values` 留空时，会按项中值首次出现的顺序列出找到的值；如需固定顺序和标签，请自行列出。`SearchResults` 会写入每个值的 `Count`：即在应用查询和其他筛选器后，该值会显示的结果数。

trans-unit.source: The account security page: a checkup of four safeguards (password, two-step verification, passkeys, recovery codes), the password with a change form that opens in place, the two-step methods, and every signed-in session with a way to sign it out. Each action happens on the page; the host hears about it through routed events.
trans-unit.target: 账户安全设置页：检查四项安全保障（密码、两步验证、通行密钥、恢复码），提供可就地展开的密码修改表单、两步验证方式，以及所有登录会话，并可将其退出登录。每项操作都在页面内完成，宿主通过路由事件获知。

trans-unit.source: Raised when "Add passkey" is pressed; the host runs the passkey ceremony and updates `PasskeyCount`.
trans-unit.target: 按下“添加通行密钥”时引发；宿主执行通行密钥流程并更新 `PasskeyCount`。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the meter moves under the summary text and "Sign out other sessions" moves under the list (default 560).
trans-unit.target: 低于此宽度时，进度条移至摘要文本下方，“退出其他登录会话”移至列表下方（默认 560）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the account has a password (default true). Without one the row offers "Set password" and the form asks only for the new password; a successful change sets it to true (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 账户是否已设置密码（默认为 true）。未设置时，该设置行提供“设置密码”，表单仅要求输入新密码；修改成功后将其设为 true（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: Whether sign-ins ask for a code from an authenticator app (two-way, follows its switch).
trans-unit.target: 是否在登录时要求输入验证器应用中的验证码（双向绑定，跟随其开关）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the password form is open.
trans-unit.target: 是否已展开密码表单。

trans-unit.source: Whether the security checkup card is shown at the top (default true).
trans-unit.target: 是否在顶部显示安全检查卡片（默认为 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether sign-ins send a code by text message (two-way, follows its switch).
trans-unit.target: 是否在登录时通过短信发送验证码（双向绑定，跟随其开关）。

trans-unit.source: Every built-in text and the culture for dates; replace the whole object to localize.
trans-unit.target: 所有内置文本以及日期区域设置；替换整个对象即可本地化。

trans-unit.source: Raised after "Sign out other sessions" was confirmed and every other session's row has left.
trans-unit.target: 在“退出其他登录会话”获得确认且其他会话的各行均已移除后引发。

trans-unit.source: How many passkeys the account has.
trans-unit.target: 账户拥有的通行密钥数量。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the password form is submitted. Set `ErrorMessage` to reject it.
trans-unit.target: 提交密码表单时引发。设置 `ErrorMessage` 可拒绝此次提交。

trans-unit.source: When the password was last changed; null reads "Never changed". Set to the clock's time after a successful change (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 密码最后一次修改的时间；为 null 时显示“从未修改”。修改成功后设为时钟的当前时间（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: The phone number for text messages; only its last four digits are shown ("•••• 4821"). Without one the text message switch is disabled.
trans-unit.target: 短信使用的电话号码；仅显示末四位（“•••• 4821”）。没有号码时，短信开关会被禁用。

trans-unit.source: How many of the four safeguards are on (0–4): a password, two-step verification by either method, at least one passkey, and recovery codes.
trans-unit.target: 四项安全防护中已开启的数量（0–4）：密码、任一方式的两步验证、至少一个通行密钥，以及恢复码。

trans-unit.source: When the recovery codes were created; null means there are none.
trans-unit.target: 恢复码的创建时间；null 表示没有恢复码。

trans-unit.source: Raised when "View codes" or "Create codes" is pressed; the host shows or creates the codes and updates `RecoveryCodesCreatedAt`.
trans-unit.target: 按下“查看恢复码”或“创建恢复码”时引发；宿主应用会显示或创建恢复码，并更新 `RecoveryCodesCreatedAt`。

trans-unit.source: Which cards are shown (default all): show only the sessions, or only the password, on a page of your own.
trans-unit.target: 显示哪些卡片（默认全部）。例如在自己的页面上只显示登录会话，或只显示密码。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a session's "Sign out" row has left and the session was taken off `Sessions`.
trans-unit.target: 登录会话的“退出登录”行离开，且该会话已从 `Sessions` 中移除后引发。

trans-unit.source: The signed-in sessions, listed current first, then by most recent activity. A signed-out session leaves its row and is removed from this list when the list can be changed. Defaults to an empty observable list.
trans-unit.target: 已登录的会话，当前会话排在最前，其余按最近活动时间排序。已退出登录的会话会离开其行，并在列表可以修改时从此列表中移除。默认为空的可观察列表。

trans-unit.source: Arc segmented control: a row of buttons for switching between a small set of related views. One selection pill glides between them on the morph spring; segments never scale or change weight, only their label color follows. Arrows (wrapping), Home and End move the selection like a tab list and only the selected segment is a tab stop. When the options are wider than the control the row scrolls inside itself with faded edges, and the selected segment is always scrolled fully into view. `ItemIntent` fires when the pointer or focus reaches a segment before it is chosen (preload what it shows).
trans-unit.target: Arc 分段控件：一排按钮，用于在一小组相关视图之间切换。选中的胶囊会在变形弹簧上于各段之间滑动；分段从不缩放或改变字重，只有标签颜色随之变化。方向键（循环）、Home 和 End 会像标签列表一样移动选中项，且只有选中的分段才是 Tab 停靠点。当选项宽于控件时，该行会在内部滚动并带有淡出的边缘，选中的分段总是被完整滚动到可见范围内。`ItemIntent` 会在指针或焦点到达某个分段、但尚未被选中之前引发（可用于预加载其内容）。

trans-unit.source: The pointer or keyboard focus reached a segment (it may not be selected yet).
trans-unit.target: 指针或键盘焦点已到达某个分段（该分段可能尚未被选中）。

trans-unit.source: One option of a `SegmentedControl` (Arc `Segment`): a short label and optional accessory.
trans-unit.target: `SegmentedControl` 的一个选项（Arc 的 `Segment`）：一个简短的标签和可选的附件。

trans-unit.source: Arc select: a labelled, compact choice field with a keyboard friendly menu (Radix Select semantics). The shown value rolls in the direction of the list, the menu drops from the trigger, a highlight glides between options and the chosen option carries a check. Use it for short, fixed lists such as regions or sort orders. Options come from `ItemsSource` (any objects, `SelectOption` records) or inline `SelectItem` children; labels use `TextSelector`, `DisplayMemberBinding` or `ToString()`, values use `ValueSelector`, `SelectedValueBinding` or the item. Keyboard: Enter, Space and the arrows open; arrows, Home / End and PageUp / PageDown move the highlight; Enter or Space picks; Escape closes without a change; typing jumps to the next matching option (and picks it directly while the menu is closed).
trans-unit.target: Arc 选择框：带标签的紧凑型选择字段，配有对键盘友好的菜单（Radix Select 语义）。显示的值会沿列表方向滚动切换，菜单从触发器处展开，高亮在选项之间滑动，所选选项带有勾选标记。适用于地区或排序方式等简短的固定列表。选项来自 `ItemsSource`（任意对象，或 `SelectOption` 记录）或内联的 `SelectItem` 子元素；标签使用 `TextSelector`、`DisplayMemberBinding` 或 `ToString()`，值使用 `ValueSelector`、`SelectedValueBinding` 或选项本身。键盘操作：Enter、Space 和方向键可打开；方向键、Home / End 和 PageUp / PageDown 移动高亮；Enter 或 Space 选中；Escape 关闭且不做更改；键入字符会跳到下一个匹配的选项（菜单关闭时则直接选中该选项）。

trans-unit.source: Declares one option of a `Select`, `Combobox`, `MultiSelect`, `MorphSelect` or `ChipGroup` inline in XAML: `<arc:SelectItem Content="United States" Value="us" />`. The owning control draws the option itself (virtualized and filtered without containers), so this element only carries data; set `IsEnabled` to false for an option that can be seen but not picked.

trans-unit.target: 供 `ItemsSource` 列表使用的普通选项记录，该分类中的所有选择框无需选择器即可识别：`new SelectOption("us", "United States")`。

trans-unit.source: An organization map you can zoom into without losing your place: teams hold project cards, projects hold task blocks, tasks open into their details and checklist. Each zoom level shows different information (team leads and counts, then project titles and health, then task titles and due dates, then the task's summary, assignee and checklist), not the same picture larger. Scroll or pinch to zoom about the pointer, drag to pan, click anything to fly into it; the breadcrumbs, the details panel and the screen-reader text follow whatever is under the center of the view. A minimap, zoom buttons and a guided tour sit on the map; ticking a checklist item updates the task and every total above it.
trans-unit.target: 一张可以放大查看的组织地图，缩放时不会丢失你的位置：团队承载项目卡片，项目包含任务块，任务可展开为详情和清单。每一级缩放显示的信息各不相同（先是负责人和数量，然后是项目标题和健康度，再是任务标题和截止日期，最后是任务摘要、负责人和清单），而不是同一画面的放大。滚动或捏合可以以指针为中心缩放，拖动可以平移，点击任意内容即可飞入。面包屑、详情面板和屏幕阅读器文本都会跟随视图中心所在的内容变化。地图上提供小地图、缩放按钮和导览；勾选清单项会更新该任务以及上方的所有合计。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a checklist item is ticked or unticked on the map.
trans-unit.target: 在地图上勾选或取消勾选清单项时触发。

trans-unit.source: The node under the keyboard cursor (null when there is none, or when the cursor is on a checklist item).
trans-unit.target: 键盘光标所在的节点（没有时为 null；光标位于清单项上时也为 null）。

trans-unit.source: Where the details panel goes (default `Auto`).
trans-unit.target: 详情面板的位置（默认 `Auto`）。

trans-unit.source: Formats dates and percentages; null uses `Default` ("Sep 23", "59%").
trans-unit.target: 格式化日期和百分比；为 null 时使用 `Default`（"Sep 23"、"59%"）。

trans-unit.source: The heading above the map; hidden when null.
trans-unit.target: 地图上方的标题；为 null 时隐藏。

trans-unit.source: Shows the breadcrumbs in the map's top-left corner. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 在地图左上角显示面包屑。默认 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the gesture hint until the first interaction. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 在首次交互之前显示手势提示。默认 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the minimap (bottom left) once the view leaves the whole organization. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 当视图离开整个组织视角后，显示小地图（左下角）。默认 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the tour button in the map's top-right corner. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 在地图右上角显示导览按钮。默认 true。

trans-unit.source: Whether the tour is playing (two-way). Any manual interaction with the map stops it.
trans-unit.target: 导览是否正在播放（双向绑定）。对地图的任何手动操作都会停止导览。

trans-unit.source: Shows the zoom buttons and readout (bottom right). Default true.
trans-unit.target: 显示缩放按钮和读数（右下角）。默认 true。

trans-unit.source: The largest zoom (default 53, deep enough to read a task's checklist); the smallest is always 1.
trans-unit.target: 最大缩放倍数（默认 53，足以看清任务的清单）；最小值始终为 1。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a node is clicked or chosen with Enter (the camera then flies into it).
trans-unit.target: 节点被点击或按 Enter 选择时触发（随后相机会飞入该节点）。

trans-unit.source: The organization to map: its teams, their projects and tasks.
trans-unit.target: 要绘制的组织：其团队、团队的项目以及任务。

trans-unit.source: The node in view (two-way): the organization, a team, a project or a task. It follows the camera (whatever is under the center at the current zoom); setting it flies there.
trans-unit.target: 视图中的节点（双向绑定）：组织、团队、项目或任务。它跟随相机移动（即当前缩放级别下位于中心的内容）；设置该属性会飞入对应节点。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the node in view changes (camera flights, pans and zooms included).
trans-unit.target: 视图中的节点发生变化时触发（包括相机飞行、平移和缩放）。

trans-unit.source: The chain from the organization down to `Scope` (what the breadcrumbs show).
trans-unit.target: 从组织到 `Scope` 的路径链（即面包屑显示的内容）。

trans-unit.source: The map's height in px; when null it is 48% of the control's width between 400 and 580 (420 in containers narrower than 600 px).
trans-unit.target: 地图的高度（像素）；为 null 时取控件宽度的 48%，并限制在 400 到 580 之间（在宽度小于 600 px 的容器中为 420）。

trans-unit.source: The line under the heading; when null it is built from `SubtitleFormat`; an empty string hides it.
trans-unit.target: 标题下方的副标题行；为 null 时由 `SubtitleFormat` 生成；空字符串则隐藏。

trans-unit.source: The automatic subtitle: `{0}` teams, `{1}` projects, `{2}` tasks.
trans-unit.target: 自动生成的副标题：`{0}` 个团队、`{1}` 个项目、`{2}` 个任务。

trans-unit.source: Every label, button name and announcement (English defaults); assign a new instance to change wording.
trans-unit.target: 所有标签、按钮名称和播报文字（英文默认值）；赋一个新实例即可修改文案。

trans-unit.source: How long the tour waits at each stop after arriving (default 1.5 s; 2.4 s at reduced motion).
trans-unit.target: 导览到达每个站点后停留的时长（默认 1.5 秒；减少动效时为 2.4 秒）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the tour starts.
trans-unit.target: 导览开始时触发。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the tour stops, at its end or interrupted.
trans-unit.target: 导览停止时触发，无论是播放结束还是被中断。

trans-unit.source: The tour's stops in order; the organization as a stop means the whole map. When null the tour visits a team, one of its projects, two tasks, a second team and one of its projects, then returns to the whole map.
trans-unit.target: 导览的站点，按顺序排列；将组织本身作为站点即代表整个地图。为 null 时，导览依次访问一个团队、其中一个项目、两个任务、第二个团队及其中一个项目，然后回到整个地图。

trans-unit.source: The zoom relative to the whole organization in view (1 = fit).
trans-unit.target: 相对于当前视图中整个组织的缩放倍率（1 表示适合视图）。

trans-unit.source: The zoom as the readout shows it: one decimal under 10 ("1.6×"), whole numbers above ("31×").
trans-unit.target: 读数显示的缩放值：小于 10 时保留一位小数（"1.6×"），10 及以上取整数（"31×"）。

trans-unit.source: One line of a task's checklist. Ticking every item marks the task done; unticking one of a done task puts it back in review (`SemanticZoomTask`).
trans-unit.target: 任务清单中的一行。勾选全部项目即将任务标记为完成；取消勾选已完成任务的某一项，任务会退回评审中（`SemanticZoomTask`）。

trans-unit.source: The item is ticked (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 该项已勾选（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: What has to be done.
trans-unit.target: 需要完成的事项。

trans-unit.source: Tasks below this node that are blocked.
trans-unit.target: 此节点下受阻的任务。

trans-unit.source: A one-line description (teams: shown in the hover card; projects: used in generated task summaries).
trans-unit.target: 一行描述（团队：在悬停提示卡中显示；项目：用于生成任务摘要）。

trans-unit.source: Tasks below this node that are done.
trans-unit.target: 此节点下已完成的任务。

trans-unit.source: An optional identifier for your own bookkeeping.
trans-unit.target: 可选的标识符，供你自行记录使用。

trans-unit.source: Projects below this node that are not on track (teams and the organization).
trans-unit.target: 下方未按计划推进的项目（团队和组织）。

trans-unit.source: The earliest due date among the open tasks below this node (null when none is due).
trans-unit.target: 此节点下方未完成任务中最早的截止日期（没有任务到期时为 null）。

trans-unit.source: Tasks below this node whose status is not done.
trans-unit.target: 此节点下方状态不是已完成的任务。

trans-unit.source: The node above this one (null for the organization or a node not added anywhere yet).
trans-unit.target: 此节点的上一层节点（组织或尚未添加到任何位置的节点为 null）。

trans-unit.source: Everyone involved, without repeats: leads first, then the assignees of the tasks below.
trans-unit.target: 所有相关人员，不重复：先列出牵头人，再列出下方任务的负责人。

trans-unit.source: Completion from 0 to 1: a task's share of ticked checklist items (1 when done); a project, team or the organization averages every task below it.
trans-unit.target: 完成度，取值从 0 到 1：任务为其已勾选清单项所占的比例（已完成时为 1）；项目、团队或组织则对其下方每个任务取平均值。

trans-unit.source: Projects below this node (a project counts itself).
trans-unit.target: 此节点下方的项目数（项目计入自身）。

trans-unit.source: Tasks below this node (a task counts itself).
trans-unit.target: 此节点下方的任务数（任务计入自身）。

trans-unit.source: The name shown on the map, in breadcrumbs and in the panel.
trans-unit.target: 在地图、面包屑和面板中显示的名称。

trans-unit.source: The root of a `SemanticZoom` map: the organization and its teams.
trans-unit.target: `SemanticZoom` 地图的根节点：组织及其团队。

trans-unit.source: The key numbers of one node of a `SemanticZoom` map: its kind and name, open and blocked tasks and the next due date, progress as a large percentage with a bar, and the people involved as an avatar stack with a closing note. Numbers roll digit by digit when `Scope` or its totals change. `SemanticZoom` shows one beside or under its map; use it on its own by binding `Scope`.
trans-unit.target: `SemanticZoom` 地图中某个节点的关键数字：其类型和名称、未完成与受阻任务、下一个截止日期、以大号百分比加进度条显示的进度，以及以头像堆叠加结尾说明显示的相关人员。当 `Scope` 或其总数变化时，数字会逐位滚动。`SemanticZoom` 会在其地图旁边或下方显示一个面板；若要单独使用，请绑定 `Scope`。

trans-unit.source: Formats the next due date and the percentage; null uses `Default`.
trans-unit.target: 格式化下一个截止日期和百分比；为 null 时使用 `Default`。

trans-unit.source: Two columns (under a wide map) or one (beside a map, or in narrow containers). Default two.
trans-unit.target: 两列（位于宽地图下方时）或一列（位于地图旁边或窄容器中）。默认为两列。

trans-unit.source: The node whose numbers are shown (the organization, a team, a project or a task).
trans-unit.target: 要显示其数字的节点（组织、团队、项目或任务）。

trans-unit.source: Labels and notes (English defaults).
trans-unit.target: 标签与备注（英文默认值）。

trans-unit.source: A person on a `SemanticZoom` map: a team or project lead, or a task's assignee or reviewer. Without an `Avatar` the map draws a muted circle with the person's initials.
trans-unit.target: `SemanticZoom` 地图上的一位人员：团队或项目的牵头人，或任务的负责人或评审人。未设置 `Avatar` 时，地图会绘制一个淡色圆圈，内含此人的姓名首字母。

trans-unit.source: A picture drawn in a circle; null draws the initials instead.
trans-unit.target: 绘制在圆形中的图片；为 null 时改为显示首字母。

trans-unit.source: Initials for the fallback circle; null takes the first letters of the first two words of `Name`.
trans-unit.target: 后备圆圈中的首字母；为 null 时取 `Name` 前两个词的首字母。

trans-unit.source: The person's full name.
trans-unit.target: 此人的全名。

trans-unit.source: Job title, shown under the name in a task's details.
trans-unit.target: 职位名称，在任务详情中显示于姓名下方。

trans-unit.source: A project: a card of task blocks with a lead, a health and a due date.
trans-unit.target: 项目：由任务区块组成的卡片，包含牵头人、健康度和截止日期。

trans-unit.source: When the project is due (shown on its card and in its hover card).
trans-unit.target: 项目的截止日期（显示在其卡片和悬停提示卡中）。

trans-unit.source: How the project is doing (the dot beside its status line).
trans-unit.target: 项目的进展状况（状态行旁边的点）。

trans-unit.source: The project lead.
trans-unit.target: 项目的牵头人。

trans-unit.source: A task: a block on its project's card, and when zoomed in, a card with its status, summary, assignee and checklist. Ticking the last open checklist item marks the task `Done`; unticking an item of a done task puts it back `InReview`. Set `Status` yourself at any time.
trans-unit.target: 任务：项目卡片上的一个区块；放大后，则显示一张包含其状态、摘要、负责人和清单的卡片。勾选最后一个未完成的清单项会将任务标记为 `Done`；取消勾选已完成任务的某个清单项，则会将其恢复为 `InReview`。你可随时自行设置 `Status`。

trans-unit.source: Who is doing it.
trans-unit.target: 由谁负责执行。

trans-unit.source: How many comments it has.
trans-unit.target: 其评论的数量。

trans-unit.source: When it is due.
trans-unit.target: 截止时间。

trans-unit.source: The estimate in points.
trans-unit.target: 以点数表示的估算值。

trans-unit.source: Who reviews it (used in the generated summary of a task in review; null uses the project lead).
trans-unit.target: 由谁评审它（用于生成处于评审中的任务的摘要；为 null 时使用项目牵头人）。

trans-unit.source: Where the task stands.
trans-unit.target: 任务当前所处的状态。

trans-unit.source: The description in the task's details; null generates one from the status (`SemanticZoomTexts`).
trans-unit.target: 任务详情中的描述；为 null 时根据状态生成（参见 `SemanticZoomTexts`）。

trans-unit.source: A team: a panel of project cards with a lead.
trans-unit.target: 团队：由项目卡片组成的面板，并带有牵头人。

trans-unit.source: The team lead, shown in the team's header and hover card.
trans-unit.target: 团队牵头人，显示在团队的标题和悬停提示卡中。

trans-unit.source: A settings command palette: one search field that finds any setting and changes it in place. Toggles flip, choices cycle through their options and actions run, all without leaving the keyboard; focus stays in the search field while the arrow keys move a highlight that glides between rows. A notice in the footer confirms each change. Write the settings inline (`SettingsCommandToggle`, `SettingsCommandChoice`, `SettingsCommandAction`) or bind `Items`. Their values are styled properties, so `IsChecked` and `SelectedOption` bind two-way and the rows follow changes made elsewhere.
trans-unit.target: 设置命令面板：一个搜索框，可以找到任意设置并原位修改。开关会翻转，选项会在各个可选值之间循环，操作会直接执行，全程无需离开键盘；焦点保持在搜索框中，方向键移动高亮，高亮在各设置行之间滑动。页脚的提示会确认每次修改。可以内联编写设置（`SettingsCommandToggle`、`SettingsCommandChoice`、`SettingsCommandAction`），也可以绑定 `Items`。它们的值是样式属性，因此 `IsChecked` 和 `SelectedOption` 支持双向绑定，各设置行会跟随其他地方的修改。

trans-unit.source: The highlighted setting that Enter acts on, or null when nothing is on show.
trans-unit.target: 高亮的设置，按 Enter 即对其执行操作；没有可显示的设置时为 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Escape is pressed with an empty query: close the palette. Mark it handled so a surrounding Dialog does not handle the same Escape again.
trans-unit.target: 在查询为空时按下 Escape 时引发，用于关闭面板。将其标记为已处理，使外层的 Dialog 不会再次处理同一次 Escape。

trans-unit.source: Whether the palette draws its own panel (surface, border, radius and floating shadow). Turn it off inside a Dialog or another surface.
trans-unit.target: 是否由面板自行绘制外框（底色、边框、圆角和浮动阴影）。在 Dialog 或其他容器中使用时请关闭。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an action is invoked with Enter or a click, after its command ran.
trans-unit.target: 通过 Enter 或点击调用操作时引发，在其命令执行之后。

trans-unit.source: The settings to search, in the order they are listed when the query is empty.
trans-unit.target: 要搜索的设置，查询为空时按此顺序列出。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text; replace the whole object to localize the palette.
trans-unit.target: 内置文本；如需本地化面板，请替换整个对象。

trans-unit.source: The text in the search field (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 搜索框中的文本（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: The tallest the result list gets before it scrolls.
trans-unit.target: 结果列表在出现滚动之前可达到的最大高度。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the user changes a toggle or a choice (not when the app sets the value).
trans-unit.target: 用户修改开关或选项时引发（应用通过代码设置值时不引发）。

trans-unit.source: A command such as "Change email" or "Sign out everywhere". Enter or a click runs `Command`, then the palette raises `ItemInvoked`. The row shows the `Shortcut` in key caps and, for links to another page, an arrow.
trans-unit.target: 一条命令，例如“修改邮箱”或“在所有设备上退出登录”。按 Enter 或点击会执行 `Command`，然后面板引发 `ItemInvoked`。该设置行以键帽形式显示 `Shortcut`；如果是跳转到其他页面的链接，则显示箭头。

trans-unit.source: The command to run.
trans-unit.target: 要执行的命令。

trans-unit.source: The parameter passed to `Command`.
trans-unit.target: 传递给 `Command` 的参数。

trans-unit.source: Whether the action opens another page; the row shows an arrow.
trans-unit.target: 是否打开其他页面；设置行会显示箭头。

trans-unit.source: The app's shortcut for the action, shown in key caps, such as "mod+shift+d" (Command on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere) or "Ctrl+,". The palette only shows it; the app handles the shortcut itself.
trans-unit.target: 应用为该操作设置的快捷键，以键帽形式显示，例如“mod+shift+d”（Mac 上为 Command，其他平台为 Ctrl）或“Ctrl+,”。面板只负责显示，快捷键由应用自行处理。

trans-unit.source: A setting with a few named values. Enter or a click moves to the next option (after the last comes the first); the left and right arrow keys, and the arrows beside the value, step without wrapping.
trans-unit.target: 具有若干命名值的设置。按 Enter 或点击切换到下一个选项（最后一个之后回到第一个）；左右方向键以及值旁边的箭头逐项移动，不循环。

trans-unit.source: The values in order. In XAML a comma-separated string works: `Options="Light, Dark, System"`.
trans-unit.target: 按顺序排列的值。在 XAML 中可以使用逗号分隔的字符串：`Options="Light, Dark, System"`。

trans-unit.source: The current value (two-way). When null it becomes the first option.
trans-unit.target: 当前值（双向绑定）。为 null 时变为第一个选项。

trans-unit.source: One line under the header (trimmed to a single line); also searched.
trans-unit.target: 标题下方的一行文字（会截断为单行）；同时参与搜索。

trans-unit.source: The group the row is listed under, such as "Appearance"; also searched. Without one it is listed under "Settings" when other settings have a group.
trans-unit.target: 该设置行所在的分组，例如“外观”；同时参与搜索。未指定分组时，若其他设置有分组，则归入“设置”。

trans-unit.source: The setting's name, shown in the row and searched first.
trans-unit.target: 设置的名称，显示在设置行中，并优先参与搜索。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon (for example an `ArcIcons` member) shown in a tile before the header.
trans-unit.target: 24×24 描边图标（例如 `ArcIcons` 的成员），显示在标题前的图块中。

trans-unit.source: Whether the setting can be changed. Disabled rows are dimmed and skipped by the keyboard.
trans-unit.target: 是否可以修改该设置。禁用的设置行会变暗，并在键盘导航中被跳过。

trans-unit.source: Other words that find the setting (synonyms separated by spaces or commas), such as "dark light appearance".
trans-unit.target: 其他能搜到该设置的词语（用空格或逗号分隔的同义词），例如“深色 浅色 外观”。

trans-unit.source: An on / off setting. Enter or a click flips `IsChecked`; the row shows a switch.
trans-unit.target: 开 / 关设置。按 Enter 或点击会切换 `IsChecked`；该设置行会显示开关。

trans-unit.source: Whether the setting is on (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 是否开启该设置（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: A group of related settings: an optional header with a description and actions, a stack of rows (usually `SettingsRow`, written inline or bound through `ItemsSource`), and an optional footer strip for a note or a save button. Drawn as a card by default, or plain inside a page.
trans-unit.target: 一组相关设置：可选的标题（含描述和操作）、一组设置行（通常为 `SettingsRow`，可直接写在 XAML 中，或通过 `ItemsSource` 绑定），以及可选的底部条，用于放置备注或保存按钮。默认以卡片形式绘制，在页面中则为平铺。

trans-unit.source: Card (default) or Plain.
trans-unit.target: 卡片（默认）或平铺。

trans-unit.source: A sentence under the header.
trans-unit.target: 标题下方的一句说明。

trans-unit.source: Content of the strip under the rows, such as a note and a save button.
trans-unit.target: 设置行下方底部条中的内容，例如备注或保存按钮。

trans-unit.source: Content at the right of the header, such as a button.
trans-unit.target: 标题右侧的内容，例如按钮。

trans-unit.source: A full settings page. The left column holds the page `Title`, one navigation item per `SettingsSection` (icon, header, badge) under a raised selection pill that glides between them, and a `Footer` such as an account card; the chosen section fills the rest of the page. While the chosen section is `IsDirty`, a save bar rises at the bottom with Discard and Save. Narrower than `CompactWidth`, the page becomes one column with the sections as a scrolling row of pills. Write the sections inline (`<arc:SettingsSection Header="Billing" Icon="...">…</arc:SettingsSection>`) or bind them through `ItemsSource`; the first enabled section is selected by default.
trans-unit.target: 完整的设置页。左列显示页面的 `Title`，每个 `SettingsSection` 对应一个导航项（图标、标题、徽标），导航项之间有一个凸起的选中胶囊滑动切换；左列底部是 `Footer`，例如账户卡片。所选分区占满页面其余部分。所选分区有未保存的修改（`IsDirty`）时，底部会升起保存条，带有放弃和保存按钮。宽度小于 `CompactWidth` 时，页面变为单列，分区以一排可滚动的胶囊显示。可直接内联书写分区（`<arc:SettingsSection Header="Billing" Icon="...">…</arc:SettingsSection>`），也可通过 `ItemsSource` 绑定；默认选中第一个已启用的分区。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the page becomes one column with the sections as a row of pills (default 720).
trans-unit.target: 低于此宽度时，页面变为单列，分区以一排胶囊显示（默认 720）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Discard is pressed in the save bar.
trans-unit.target: 在保存条中按下“放弃”时引发。

trans-unit.source: Content at the bottom of the navigation column, such as an account card. Hidden on compact pages.
trans-unit.target: 导航列底部的内容，例如账户卡片。在紧凑布局的页面中隐藏。

trans-unit.source: Whether the page is narrower than `CompactWidth` and shows one column.
trans-unit.target: 页面是否窄于 `CompactWidth` 并显示为单列。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text (save bar, accessible names). Replace the whole object to translate it.
trans-unit.target: 内置文本（保存条、无障碍名称）。替换整个对象即可翻译。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Save is pressed (or Ctrl/⌘+S) while the selected section has unsaved changes.
trans-unit.target: 所选分区有未保存的修改时，按下保存（或 Ctrl/⌘+S）时引发。

trans-unit.source: The page title above the navigation (default "Settings").
trans-unit.target: 导航上方的页面标题（默认为“设置”）。

trans-unit.source: One setting: an optional icon, a header and description on the left, and the control that changes it (`Content`) on the right. Below `StackWidth` the control moves under the text. Rows in a `SettingsGroup` (or any panel) are separated by a hairline; the first row has none. When the control is a toggle (Switch, Checkbox), clicking the header or description toggles it too, and the control takes the header as its accessible name and the description as its help text unless it has its own.
trans-unit.target: 一项设置：左侧是可选的图标、标题和描述，右侧是用于修改该设置的控件（`Content`）。宽度小于 `StackWidth` 时，控件会移到文字下方。`SettingsGroup`（或任意面板）中的设置行之间以细线分隔，第一行没有分隔线。当控件是开关（Switch）或复选框（Checkbox）时，点击标题或描述也会切换它；除非控件已有自己的名称和帮助文本，否则控件会以标题作为无障碍名称，以描述作为帮助文本。

trans-unit.source: A sentence under the header that explains the setting; also the control's help text.
trans-unit.target: 标题下方说明该设置的一句话；同时也是控件的帮助文本。

trans-unit.source: The setting's name, shown in medium weight; also the control's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 设置的名称，以中等字重显示；同时也是控件的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon (for example an `ArcIcons` member) shown in a tile before the header.
trans-unit.target: 24×24 线性图标（例如 `ArcIcons` 的成员），显示在标题前的图块中。

trans-unit.source: Whether the control currently sits under the text (the row is narrower than `StackWidth`).
trans-unit.target: 控件当前是否位于文字下方（即设置行宽度小于 `StackWidth`）。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the control moves under the header and description (default 440).
trans-unit.target: 低于此宽度时，控件移到标题和描述下方（默认 440）。

trans-unit.source: One section of a `SettingsPage`: its `Header`, `Icon` and `Badge` appear in the page's navigation, and while it is selected the section itself (header, `Description` and content) fills the page's content area. Set `IsDirty` while it has unsaved changes to show the page's save bar.
trans-unit.target: `SettingsPage` 的一个分区：其 `Header`、`Icon` 和 `Badge` 显示在页面导航中；选中时，分区本身（标题、`Description` 和内容）会占满页面的内容区域。分区有未保存的修改时，设置 `IsDirty` 即可显示页面的保存条。

trans-unit.source: A short marker at the end of the navigation item, such as "New" or a count.
trans-unit.target: 导航项末尾的简短标记，例如“New”或计数。

trans-unit.source: A sentence under the section title in the content area.
trans-unit.target: 内容区域中分区标题下方的一句说明。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon shown before the header in the navigation.
trans-unit.target: 导航中标题前显示的 24×24 线性图标。

trans-unit.source: Whether the section has unsaved changes: the page shows its save bar while this section is selected.
trans-unit.target: 分区是否有未保存的修改：选中此分区时，页面会显示其保存条。

trans-unit.source: Arc shortcut recorder: a field that records a keyboard shortcut. Press it (Enter, Space or a click), then press the combination: held modifiers light up as key caps while the chord is built, the finished shortcut settles into place (caps pop in with a 35ms stagger), and a combination that is already taken (`Bindings`, or one the browser or system keeps such as ⌘W and ⌘C) asks before it is used. Escape cancels, Backspace / Delete clears, Tab stops recording and moves on, and the reset button restores `ResetValue`. Caps follow the platform: ⌘ ⇧ glyphs on a Mac, Ctrl+Shift names elsewhere.
trans-unit.target: Arc 快捷键录入框：记录键盘快捷键的字段。按下它（Enter、Space 或单击），再按下组合键：组合过程中，已按住的修饰键会以键帽形式点亮；完成的快捷键以 35ms 错开的节奏弹出键帽并定位。若组合键已被占用（`Bindings` 中的，或浏览器、系统保留的如 ⌘W 与 ⌘C），使用前会先询问。Escape 取消录入，Backspace / Delete 清除，Tab 停止录入并移动到下一项，重置按钮则恢复 `ResetValue`。键帽遵循平台约定：Mac 上显示 ⌘ ⇧ 符号，其他平台显示 Ctrl+Shift 文字。

trans-unit.source: Shortcuts already in use.
trans-unit.target: 已被占用的快捷键。

trans-unit.source: The conflict action that keeps the previous shortcut.
trans-unit.target: 保留原快捷键的冲突操作。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the clear button.
trans-unit.target: 清除按钮的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the field, shown while no other message is.
trans-unit.target: 字段下方的辅助文字，在没有其他提示信息时显示。

trans-unit.source: When false the label is only read by assistive technology (Arc: `hideLabel`).
trans-unit.target: 为 false 时标签不显示，仅供辅助技术读取（Arc 中为 `hideLabel`）。

trans-unit.source: Require ⌘, Ctrl or ⌥ / Alt; function keys are always allowed (Arc: `requireModifier`, on by default).
trans-unit.target: 要求包含 ⌘、Ctrl 或 ⌥ / Alt；功能键始终允许（Arc 中为 `requireModifier`，默认开启）。

trans-unit.source: True while the recorder listens for a combination.
trans-unit.target: 录入器正在监听组合键时为 true。

trans-unit.source: Also warn about combinations the browser or system keeps (Arc: `warnReserved`, on by default).
trans-unit.target: 同时对浏览器或系统保留的组合键发出警告（Arc 中为 `warnReserved`，默认开启）。

trans-unit.source: The field label (Arc: required); also the start of the recorder's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 字段标签（Arc 中必填）；同时作为录入器无障碍名称的开头。

trans-unit.source: Shown while there is no shortcut.
trans-unit.target: 没有快捷键时显示。

trans-unit.source: Key cap conventions; null detects the platform (Mac on macOS and iOS).
trans-unit.target: 键帽显示约定；null 时自动检测平台（macOS 与 iOS 为 Mac）。

trans-unit.source: The message under the field while recording.
trans-unit.target: 录入过程中显示在字段下方的提示信息。

trans-unit.source: Shown while recording, before a key is held.
trans-unit.target: 录入中、尚未按下按键时显示。

trans-unit.source: What the reset button restores (Arc: `resetValue`, defaulting to `defaultValue`).
trans-unit.target: 重置按钮恢复的值（Arc 中为 `resetValue`，默认为 `defaultValue`）。

trans-unit.source: The conflict action that takes the shortcut.
trans-unit.target: 仍然使用该快捷键的冲突操作。

trans-unit.source: The recorded shortcut (two-way); null means none.
trans-unit.target: 已录入的快捷键（双向）；null 表示没有。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Value` changes (recorded, cleared, reset, or set by code).
trans-unit.target: `Value` 变化时触发（录入、清除、重置或由代码设置）。

trans-unit.source: The app's main navigation (an original TKCode design): a header for a logo or a workspace switcher, an optional filter box, sections of pages with icons, counts and one level of nested pages, and a footer for the signed-in user. The selected page carries a muted block behind it and an accent-colored icon; the block glides between rows on a snappy spring. Parents open their pages with a height spring and a turning chevron. The sidebar collapses to a 64px icon rail on a width spring: labels and counts fade, counts become dots, every page gets a tooltip on the right and a parent shows its pages in a menu. Keyboard (WAI-ARIA tree model): the list is one tab stop; ↑ / ↓, Home / End move, → opens a parent or enters it, ← closes it or goes back to the parent, Enter / Space choose, typing jumps to a page by its first letters, and Cmd / Ctrl+B collapses or expands the sidebar while focus is inside it.
trans-unit.target: 应用的主导航（TKCode 原创设计）：顶部区域放徽标或工作区切换器，下面是可选的筛选框，然后是分区的页面（带图标和计数，并支持一层嵌套页面），底部区域显示已登录的用户。选中的页面背后有一块柔和色块，图标变为强调色，色块以轻快的弹簧动画在各行之间滑动；父级页面通过高度弹簧动画展开子页面，并带有旋转的 V 形箭头。侧边栏通过宽度弹簧动画收起为 64px 的图标窄栏：文字和计数淡出，计数变为圆点，每个页面在右侧显示工具提示，父级页面则以菜单形式显示其子页面。键盘操作（WAI-ARIA 树形模型）：列表只占一个 Tab 停靠点；↑ / ↓、Home / End 移动焦点，→ 展开父级或进入其中，← 收起或返回父级，Enter / Space 选择，输入字母可按页面首字母跳转，焦点在侧边栏内时 Cmd / Ctrl+B 可收起或展开侧边栏。

trans-unit.source: Where the collapse button sits while the sidebar is open: in the header row (default) or beside the filter box. On the rail it always sits at the top.
trans-unit.target: 侧边栏展开时收起按钮的位置：头部行（默认）或筛选框旁边。在窄栏上它总是位于顶部。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name and tooltip of the collapse button while the sidebar is open.
trans-unit.target: 侧边栏展开时，收起按钮的无障碍名称和工具提示。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name and tooltip of the collapse button while the sidebar is the rail.
trans-unit.target: 侧边栏为窄栏时，收起按钮的无障碍名称和工具提示。

trans-unit.source: Placeholder and accessible name of the filter box.
trans-unit.target: 筛选框的占位文字与无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: The filter text (two-way). Pages whose label contains it stay; a parent with a matching page opens.

trans-unit.target: 底部内容（已登录用户、存储用量条），位于一条细分隔线下。在窄栏上仍保持展开时的宽度布局，并裁剪至窄栏内；可使用 `:collapsed` 伪类进行适配。

trans-unit.source: Content at the top (a logo and title, a workspace switcher), beside the collapse button when that sits in the header row. It is hidden on the rail while the collapse button shows.
trans-unit.target: 顶部内容（徽标和标题、工作区切换器）；收起按钮位于头部行时，显示在它旁边。在窄栏上，收起按钮显示时此区域隐藏。

trans-unit.source: Shows the collapse / expand button (PanelLeft icon). Its place is `CollapseButtonPlacement`.
trans-unit.target: 显示收起或展开按钮（PanelLeft 图标）。它的位置由 `CollapseButtonPlacement` 决定。

trans-unit.source: A sign in card that morphs from an email address to a six digit code to the signed in account, with a passkey button and single sign-on buttons (Arc's free sign-in block, the "Email code" variant of Login). trans-unit.source: Arc's signature field with real ink: width follows pen pressure, or speed for a mouse or finger, and the ends taper like a nib lifting off. It keeps undo and redo, clears with a wipe across the pad, replays the signature in its original rhythm, and exports a cropped PNG or SVG. A "Sign here" hint rests on the baseline until the first stroke.
trans-unit.target: Arc 签名板，带真实墨迹：线宽随笔压变化；使用鼠标或手指时则随速度变化，笔画两端像笔尖离纸一样逐渐收细。支持撤销与重做，用一次擦拭划过整个画板即可清空，并能按原有节奏回放签名，还可导出裁剪后的 PNG 或 SVG。在第一笔落下之前，基线上会保留一个“在此签名”提示。

trans-unit.source: True when an undone change can be redone.
trans-unit.target: 存在可重做的已撤销更改时为 true。

trans-unit.source: True when a change can be undone (the last 60 are kept).
trans-unit.target: 存在可撤销的更改时为 true（保留最近 60 次）。

trans-unit.source: File name for exports, without extension (default "signature").
trans-unit.target: 导出文件的文件名，不含扩展名（默认为 "signature"）。

trans-unit.source: The resting hint on the baseline before the first stroke (default "Sign here").
trans-unit.target: 第一笔落下之前，基线上的静置提示（默认为“在此签名”）。

trans-unit.source: The ink for new strokes (default black). Each stroke keeps the ink it was drawn with.

trans-unit.source: The nib for new strokes (default medium).

trans-unit.target: 签名的笔画，以画板单位表示（600 × 260）。

trans-unit.source: An account creation card (Arc's Sign up block): Google, Apple and GitHub buttons, then the full name, a work email and a password with a four-bar strength meter, a product updates opt-in and Create account. When the account is made, the card slides to a completion panel whose check draws itself in, with how the account was made and Start over; the card's height glides between the two.
trans-unit.target: 账号创建卡片（Arc 的注册区块）：包括 Google、Apple 和 GitHub 按钮，然后是全名、工作邮箱和密码（带四格强度条）、产品更新订阅选项，以及 "Create account" 按钮。账号创建完成后，卡片滑动到完成面板，面板中的对勾会逐步绘制出现，并显示账号的创建方式以及 "Start over" 按钮；卡片高度会在两个视图之间平滑过渡。

trans-unit.source: A website footer in three layouts: link columns with a newsletter signup (`Columns`), a single quiet row (`Minimal`), and a closing layout where the Arc arch rises in, oversized and cropped by the bottom edge, fading into the page (`Logo`). The newsletter validates in place, keeps its width while the button morphs, and confirms without a toast. Every text, link, column and the status line can be replaced; with nothing set the footer shows Arc's sample footer.
trans-unit.target: 网站页脚，提供三种布局：带电子报订阅的链接列（`Columns`）、单行简洁布局（`Minimal`），以及收尾布局（`Logo`），在此布局中 Arc 的拱形图案从底部升起，尺寸放大并被底边裁切，渐隐于页面之中。电子报订阅会就地验证，按钮变形时保持宽度，并在不弹出提示的情况下确认。所有文字、链接、列和状态行都可以替换；未设置时显示 Arc 的示例页脚。

trans-unit.source: A website header in three layouts (Arc's site header block): it sticks to the top of its scroll view and turns solid once the page scrolls, marks the current section with an indicator that glides between links, opens springy mega menu panels whose content slides in from the side you moved toward, and folds into a menu sheet when it is narrower than `CollapseWidth` (the block's own width, not the window's). Data driven: the links are `SiteHeaderItem`s (or `ItemsSource`); without items the header shows Arc's example set. Choosing any destination raises `Navigate` (and runs `NavigateCommand`); when nobody handles the event and the destination has an absolute http, https or mailto address, it is opened.
trans-unit.target: 网站页眉，提供三种布局（Arc 网站页眉区块）：它会吸附在滚动视图顶部，页面滚动后变为实色背景；用随链接滑动的指示器标记当前章节；打开带弹性的大型菜单面板，其内容从你移动的方向滑入；当宽度小于 `CollapseWidth`（区块自身的宽度，而非窗口宽度）时，折叠为菜单面板。数据驱动：链接为 `SiteHeaderItem`s（或 `ItemsSource`）；未提供项目时，页眉显示 Arc 的示例项。选择任一目标都会引发 `Navigate`（并执行 `NavigateCommand`）；若无人处理该事件且目标为绝对 http、https 或 mailto 地址，则会将其打开。

trans-unit.source: Reserves space while content is still loading (Arc Skeleton): an optional round avatar and 1–6 text lines that pulse top to bottom in a calm, finite wave. With `Content` it crossfades into the content when `IsLoading` turns false (the content rises 4px into place) while the height springs from the placeholder to the content. Without content the placeholder always shows.
trans-unit.target: 在内容仍在加载时预留空间（Arc 骨架屏）：可选的圆形头像和 1–6 行文本占位，以平稳有限的波浪自上而下脉动。设置 `Content` 后，当 `IsLoading` 变为 false 时，内容会淡入替换占位（内容上移 4px 就位），同时高度以弹簧从占位过渡到内容的高度。没有内容时始终显示占位。

trans-unit.source: Arc slider: a value or a range on a track. The thumb follows the pointer 1:1, rubber-bands up to 9px past its limits and settles on the step grid with the velocity of the release (on a coarse grid the release may carry it one step further); pressing the track springs the nearest thumb there. A bubble with rolling digits rides the thumb while it is dragged or keyboard focused and lingers 700ms after a release. Arrows, Shift+arrows, PageUp / PageDown and Home / End work as in a native range input; a key at a limit makes the thumb strain toward the press and spring home. Unlike `Slider`, `SmallChange` is the step the value snaps to. Set `IsRange` for two thumbs (`LowerValue` / `UpperValue`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 滑块：在轨道上选择一个值或一个范围。滑块跟随指针 1:1 移动，超出限制时会有 9px 的回弹，并以松开时的速度落到步进网格上（在粗网格上，松开时可能再多移动一步）；按下轨道会使最近的滑块弹到该处。拖动或键盘聚焦时，一个带滚动数字的气泡会跟随滑块，松开后再保留 700ms。方向键、Shift+方向键、PageUp / PageDown 以及 Home / End 的行为与原生范围输入一致；在极限处按键时，滑块会向按压方向拉伸，然后弹回原位。与 `Slider` 不同，`SmallChange` 是数值吸附的步长。设置 `IsRange` 可使用两个滑块（`LowerValue` / `UpperValue`）。

trans-unit.source: Content after the track, such as an icon or a button.
trans-unit.target: 轨道之后的内容，例如图标或按钮。

trans-unit.source: Two thumbs: `LowerValue` and `UpperValue` instead of `Value`.
trans-unit.target: 两个滑块：使用 `LowerValue` 和 `UpperValue`，而不是 `Value`。

trans-unit.source: A before / after comparison on two shared axes (Arc "Slope chart"). Lines draw in from the first column to the second on first view; labels push apart instead of overlapping and connect back to their dots with thin leaders; rank movement sits beside each end value. A new dataset slides every line, dot and label to its new place on the shared morph spring. Hover or the arrow keys (in end-value order) bring one line forward and show a tooltip.
trans-unit.target: 在两个共享坐标轴上进行的前后对比（Arc“斜率图”）。首次显示时，线条从第一列向第二列逐渐画出；标签会相互推开而不是重叠，并用细引线连回各自的圆点；每个端点数值旁边显示排名变化。新数据集会以共享的变形弹簧，把每条线、每个圆点和每个标签滑动到新位置。悬停或使用方向键（按终点数值顺序）可将某条线置于前方并显示提示。

trans-unit.source: Arc's sortable data table: compare structured records with sortable columns. Click a header (or press Enter / Space on it) to sort ascending, again for descending; rows slide to their new places on a smooth spring and the sort arrow flips on a snappy one. `IsSelectable` adds a checkbox column, row-click selection, Shift range selection, Escape to clear and a count line with Clear selection. Rows are drawn as light text cells, virtualized for thousands of records, sorted by index (never by container), and the header sticks to the top of the visible area. Below 620px rows fold into two lines and the header becomes a strip of sort pills, as in Arc.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可排序数据表格：以可排序的列比较结构化记录。点击表头（或在表头上按 Enter / Space）升序排列，再点一次降序；行以平滑的弹簧滑动到新位置，排序箭头以更灵敏的弹簧翻转。`IsSelectable` 会添加复选框列、点击行选择、Shift 范围选择、Escape 清除选择，以及带“清除选择”的计数行。行以轻量文本单元格绘制，对数千条记录进行虚拟化，按索引（而非容器）排序，表头会吸附在可见区域顶部。宽度低于 620px 时，行会折叠为两行，表头则变为排序胶囊条，与 Arc 一致。

trans-unit.source: Arc's sparkline: a compact trend beside a value, for cards, table rows and KPI blocks. Scrub it with the pointer or the arrow keys: the cursor springs between points, the stretch after it dims as if it has not happened yet, and the headline and aside roll to the scrubbed point. The line draws once like a pen the first time it is half visible; the fill follows the tip, then the end dot lands. New data morphs the line from the shape on screen. Motion is code-driven because the pen tip, cursor and morph are coordinates inside the self-drawn plot.

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of speculative decoding in one card. A small draft model proposes a few ghost tokens quickly; the large target model checks them in one sweep. Accepted guesses get a check and fly into the answer, the first miss is struck through and replaced by the target's own token, and the guesses after it fade. When every guess is kept the target adds a bonus token. Rounds repeat until the sentence is written; a switch races a line where the target writes one token per pass on the same clock, and the speedup, the share of drafts accepted and the tokens per pass roll up below. Every token of the answer is underlined in the color of the model that wrote it. With `Tokens` the run is simulated from each token's ease and the `Seed`; with `Rounds` a recorded run is replayed. The numbers are illustrative. The run plays once when the card comes into view (never on its own under reduced motion, where tokens appear in place and the sweep steps a cell at a time).
trans-unit.target: 单张卡片中推测解码的动画讲解。一个小型草稿模型快速提出几个幽灵 token；大型目标模型在一次前向计算中检查它们。被接受的猜测会打上勾并飞入答案，第一个未命中的被划掉，并由目标模型自己的 token 替换，其后的猜测淡出。若所有猜测都被保留，目标模型会再加一个奖励 token。每轮重复，直到句子写完；一个开关会让一条线与之并行竞速，其中目标模型在同一时钟下每次前向计算写出一个 token，其加速比、草稿接受率与每次前向计算的 token 数汇总于下方。答案的每个 token 都以写出它的模型的颜色加下划线。使用 `Tokens` 时，演示依每个 token 的难易度与 `Seed` 模拟；使用 `Rounds` 时，则重放一次记录的运行。数字仅为示意。该演示在卡片进入视野时播放一次（在减少动效下永不自动播放，此时 token 原地出现，扫过则逐格推进）。

trans-unit.source: Arc's streamgraph: layers stacked on a wiggle baseline, flowing over time. Hovering a layer isolates it and reads every layer at that moment; switching ranges blends every layer from the shape on screen on a shared 161-point grid, a hidden layer thins to nothing while the others close over it, and the first time the chart is seen the whole stream swells out of a hairline along its center. Motion is code-driven (a per-sample spring array and `MotionValue`) because every layer edge is recomputed from the stack each frame inside one self-drawn plot.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的流图：各图层堆叠在摆动基线上，随时间流动。悬停某一图层会将其单独突出，并读取该时刻每个图层的数值；切换范围时，所有图层会从屏幕上的形状出发，在共享的 161 点网格上过渡融合，隐藏的图层会收缩至消失，其余图层随之闭合；图表首次出现时，整个流从中线处的细线舒展开。动画由代码驱动（每个采样点的弹簧数组加 `MotionValue`），因为每个图层边缘都要在单个自绘绘图区内逐帧根据堆叠结果重新计算。

trans-unit.source: A list whose rows reveal actions on a horizontal swipe, the way a mail inbox does (Arc swipe actions): short, touch-first triage lists such as mail, notifications or tasks. Rows are `SwipeActionsRow`s declared inline or generated from `ItemsSource` (with `LeadingActions` / `TrailingActions` shared by every row that declares none, and `RowLabelBinding` naming each row). Only one row stays open at a time; pressing anywhere else or Escape puts it away. Every row also has a More actions menu with the same actions, so keyboard and screen reader users never need the gesture. Remove the item in `ActionInvoked` (or the action's own handler or command): removing actions run once their row has slid away and collapsed. The surface fades with the last row and hides when the list is empty. Rows are not virtualized; paginate long lists.

trans-unit.source: One row of `SwipeActions` (Arc SwipeActionsRow): its content follows a horizontal swipe to reveal `LeadingActions` under the left edge and `TrailingActions` under the right. Past the last stop the row still follows with rubber-band resistance; a full swipe commits the outermost action (the action stretches across the row, the row slides away and collapses), and a release settles open or closed on a spring that carries the release velocity. Vertical drags pass through to the page. Every row also has a More actions button with the same actions in a menu, so the gesture is never required: Enter or Space opens it on the first row, arrows move, Escape closes the menu or puts an open row away. Pressing outside an open row closes it, and only one row of a list is open at a time. Use it on its own or inside a `SwipeActions` list (whose actions it uses when it declares none of its own).
trans-unit.target: `SwipeActions` 的一行（Arc SwipeActionsRow）：其内容随水平滑动移动，以显示左边缘下方的 `LeadingActions` 和右边缘下方的 `TrailingActions`。超过最后一个停靠点后，行仍会以橡皮筋阻力跟随；完整滑动会提交最外侧的操作（该操作横跨整行，行滑开并收起）；松手后，行会以携带释放速度的弹簧停靠在展开或收起位置。垂直拖动会传递给页面。每行还提供“更多操作”按钮，菜单中包含相同的操作，因此手势并非必需：Enter 或空格键在第一行上打开菜单，方向键移动，Escape 关闭菜单或收起已展开的行。在已展开的行外按下即可将其关闭，列表中同一时间只有一行展开。可单独使用，也可置于 `SwipeActions` 列表中（未声明自身操作时使用列表的操作）。

trans-unit.source: Raised on the row (and bubbled to its list) after an action ran.
trans-unit.target: 操作执行后在该行引发（并冒泡至其列表）。

trans-unit.source: Lets a long swipe commit the outermost action without a tap; null follows the list (default on).
trans-unit.target: 允许长距离滑动无需点按即可提交最外侧的操作；null 则跟随列表（默认开启）。

trans-unit.source: Names the row in its More actions button, for example the message subject (Arc: required).
trans-unit.target: 在其“更多操作”按钮中为该行命名，例如邮件主题（Arc：必填）。

trans-unit.source: The side resting open (or heading there), or `None`.
trans-unit.target: 保持展开（或正在展开）的一侧，或 `None`。

trans-unit.source: Left inset of the hairline separator under the row (Arc `--swipe-actions-inset`, default 16).
trans-unit.target: 行下方细分隔线的左侧缩进（Arc `--swipe-actions-inset`，默认 16）。

trans-unit.source: Arc switch: a tactile toggle for settings that take effect immediately. While pressed the thumb widens toward the other side (far edge anchored); on release it glides on a critically damped spring. Toggles that did not come from a press (keyboard, code) play a brief stretch instead.
trans-unit.target: Arc 开关：用于即时生效设置的触感切换。按下时，滑块会向另一侧拉宽（远端固定）；松开后，它以临界阻尼弹簧滑动。非按下触发的切换（键盘、代码）则改为短暂拉伸。

trans-unit.source: Arc tabs: switch between related views of the same object. A single selection pill glides between the triggers on a morph spring, the incoming panel slides 8px in from the side of travel while the outgoing one is pinned in place and fades, and the panel area springs from the old panel height to the new one so the content below glides. Long tab lists scroll horizontally with soft edges and edge scroll buttons, and the selected or focused tab is always scrolled into view. Items are `TabItem` containers written inline (`<arc:TabItem Header="Overview">…</arc:TabItem>`) or generated from `ItemsSource`: `ItemTemplate` renders the trigger and `ContentTemplate` the panel.
trans-unit.target: Arc 标签页：在同一对象的相关视图之间切换。单个选中的胶囊形指示器在触发器之间沿弹簧曲线滑动，进入的面板从移动方向的一侧滑入 8px，而离开的面板固定在原处并淡出；面板区域从旧面板高度以弹簧过渡到新高度，使下方内容平滑滑动。标签较多时，标签列表可水平滚动，带柔和边缘和边缘滚动按钮，且选中或聚焦的标签始终滚动到可见范围内。项目可以内联书写为 `TabItem` 容器（`<arc:TabItem Header="Overview">…</arc:TabItem>`），也可由 `ItemsSource` 生成：`ItemTemplate` 渲染触发器，`ContentTemplate` 渲染面板。

trans-unit.source: Whether arrow keys select the tab they move to (`Automatic`, Arc default).
trans-unit.target: 方向键是否同时选中移动到的标签（`Automatic`，Arc 默认）。

trans-unit.source: Template for the panel of data items (the trigger uses `ItemTemplate`).
trans-unit.target: 数据项面板的模板（触发器使用 `ItemTemplate`）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the left scroll button.
trans-unit.target: 左侧滚动按钮的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the right scroll button.
trans-unit.target: 右侧滚动按钮的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: The panel content of the selected tab.
trans-unit.target: 选中标签的面板内容。

trans-unit.source: The template of the selected tab's panel.
trans-unit.target: 选中标签面板的模板。

trans-unit.source: Arc tag input: turns short typed values into removable tags. Enter or a comma adds the trimmed draft (a duplicate, compared case-insensitively, pulses the tag that exists instead); Backspace at the start of the field picks the last tag and the next Backspace removes it; the arrow keys move the pick and a ring glides to it; leaving the field commits the draft. New tags blur in where they were typed, removed tags leave their slot and the rest glide in, and the shell follows wrapped rows on a spring; the field never scrolls sideways.
trans-unit.target: Arc 标签输入框：将简短输入的值转换为可移除的标签。按 Enter 或逗号可添加去除首尾空格后的草稿（重复的标签（不区分大小写比较）会改为使已存在的那个标签闪动）；插入点位于字段开头时按 Backspace 选中最后一个标签，再按一次 Backspace 将其移除；方向键移动选中项，光圈会滑动到该处；离开字段时提交草稿。新标签在输入位置淡入，被移除的标签离开原位，其余标签滑动补位；外壳随换行的行以弹簧跟随调整，字段本身从不横向滚动。

trans-unit.source: Announced after an add; `{0}` is the tag (or the tags, comma separated, after a paste).
trans-unit.target: 添加后播报；`{0}` 为标签（粘贴后则为以逗号分隔的多个标签）。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the field; it describes the editor for assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 字段下方的辅助文字；为辅助技术描述编辑器。

trans-unit.source: Announced when the draft repeats a tag; `{0}` is the existing tag.
trans-unit.target: 草稿与已有标签重复时播报；`{0}` 为已存在的标签。

trans-unit.source: Error copy under the field; non-empty makes the field invalid.
trans-unit.target: 字段下方的错误提示；非空时字段为无效状态。

trans-unit.source: Invalid state (danger border). Always true while `ErrorMessage` is not empty.
trans-unit.target: 无效状态（危险色边框）。`ErrorMessage` 不为空时始终为 true。

trans-unit.source: When false the label is hidden visually but still names the editor.
trans-unit.target: 为 false 时标签视觉上隐藏，但仍为编辑器命名。

trans-unit.source: The visible label (Arc: required). Also the accessible name of the editor.
trans-unit.target: 可见标签（Arc：必填），同时也是编辑器的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: Announced when `MaxTags` refuses an add; `{0}` is the limit.
trans-unit.target: `MaxTags` 拒绝添加时播报；`{0}` 为上限。

trans-unit.source: The most tags a user can add (extension; null = unlimited, as Arc). Negative values read as 0.
trans-unit.target: 用户可添加的最多标签数（扩展；null 表示无限制，与 Arc 一致）。负值按 0 处理。

trans-unit.source: Announced when a tag is picked; `{0}` is the tag.
trans-unit.target: 选中某个标签时播报；`{0}` 为该标签。

trans-unit.source: Shown while there are no tags and no draft (Arc default "Add a tag").
trans-unit.target: 没有标签且没有草稿时显示（Arc 默认文字为“添加标签”）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of a tag's remove button; `{0}` is the tag.
trans-unit.target: 标签删除按钮的无障碍名称；`{0}` 为该标签。

trans-unit.source: Announced after a removal; `{0}` is the tag.
trans-unit.target: 移除后播报；`{0}` 为该标签。

trans-unit.source: The tags (two-way). Never null: setting null reads back as an empty list.
trans-unit.target: 标签（双向绑定）。从不为 null：设置为 null 时读回为空列表。

trans-unit.source: Raised (bubbling) whenever `Value` changes, by the user or in code.
trans-unit.target: `Value` 变化时引发（冒泡），无论由用户还是代码引起。

trans-unit.source: Morphs one short label into the next in place (P4): letters both strings share glide to their new positions, new letters sharpen in with a short stagger, removed letters blur away, and the width follows on a spring. Single line; assistive technology reads the plain text. Rendered directly: no control per letter.
trans-unit.target: 将一个短标签原地变形为下一个标签（P4）：两个字符串共有的字母滑动到新位置，新字母以短暂错开的节奏清晰浮现，被移除的字母模糊消失，宽度随弹簧调整。单行；辅助技术读取纯文本。直接渲染：不为每个字母创建控件。

trans-unit.source: Font family of the text (from TextElement).
trans-unit.target: 文本的字体族（继承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.target: 文本的字号，单位为与设备无关的像素（继承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.target: 文本的字重（继承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.source: Brush that paints the text (from TextElement).

trans-unit.target: 要显示的标签；变化时字母会从旧文本变形为新文本。

trans-unit.source: A headline that reveals itself once as it appears (Arc TextReveal): each word rises out of its own feathered clip while it sharpens from a soft blur and fades in, word after word (P20, P29). A title that mounts on screen starts with the first frame like Arc; one that mounts below the fold waits until it enters the viewport (S6, once). Whenever the animation cannot run (motion off, detached), the text shows at rest. Use `\n` for a deliberate line break; lines are at most `MaxWidthInChars` wide and balanced. Drawn as one control: no per-word controls.
trans-unit.target: 标题在出现时只播放一次的显现动画（Arc TextReveal）：每个词从各自带羽化边缘的裁剪区中升起，同时由柔和模糊逐渐清晰并淡入，逐词依次进行（P20、P29）。挂载于屏幕上的标题从第一帧开始，与 Arc 一致；挂载于视口之下的标题会等到进入视口后才播放（S6，仅一次）。无法播放动画时（动画关闭、已分离）文字直接以静止状态显示。使用 `\n` 来刻意换行；每行最多为 `MaxWidthInChars` 宽，且行宽均衡。作为一个控件绘制：没有逐词控件。

trans-unit.source: Starting blur of each word (BlurText for headings, BlurSoft for paragraphs).
trans-unit.target: 每个词的初始模糊半径（标题使用 BlurText，段落使用 BlurSoft）。

trans-unit.source: Wait before the first word rises.
trans-unit.target: 第一个词升起前的等待时间。

trans-unit.source: Font family of the text (from TextElement).
trans-unit.target: 文本的字体族（继承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.source: Font size of the text in device-independent pixels (from TextElement).
trans-unit.target: 文本的字号，单位为与设备无关的像素（继承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.source: Font weight of the text (from TextElement).
trans-unit.target: 文本的字重（继承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.source: Brush that paints the text (from TextElement).
trans-unit.target: 绘制文本的画笔（继承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.source: Line height as a multiple of the font size.
trans-unit.target: 行高，以字号的倍数表示。

trans-unit.source: Heading level (Arc `as`, default h2); a paragraph uses body type and a softer blur.
trans-unit.target: 标题级别（Arc `as`，默认 h2）；段落使用正文字体并采用更柔和的模糊。

trans-unit.source: Line length limit in "0" glyph widths (Arc: 24ch). 0 disables the limit.
trans-unit.target: 以 “0” 字形宽度计算的行长上限（Arc：24ch）。0 表示不限制。

trans-unit.source: The headline; use `\n` for a deliberate line break.
trans-unit.target: 标题文字；使用 `\n` 进行刻意换行。

trans-unit.source: Letter spacing in em (display tracking for headings).
trans-unit.target: 字间距，以 em 为单位（标题的展示字距）。

trans-unit.source: A calm light sweeping across a short status line (Arc TextShimmer), such as "Thinking" or "Generating summary": a bell-shaped band of the text color crosses a muted base, then pauses briefly before the next pass (P21). The sweep runs only while `IsActive`, within 64px of the viewport and visible, and resumes where it stopped. Turning `IsActive` off lets a band in flight glide off while the text settles to solid. A new label rises in place from a soft blur while the line springs to its width (P2, P5). Drawn as one control: the band is the text drawn again through a sliding opacity mask, so a frame allocates nothing.
trans-unit.target: 一道平静的光带扫过简短的状态行（Arc TextShimmer），例如 “Thinking” 或 “Generating summary”：一条钟形的文字颜色光带穿过静止的底色，然后在下一轮开始前短暂停顿（P21）。扫光仅在 `IsActive` 为 true、距视口 64px 以内且可见时运行，并从停止处继续。关闭 `IsActive` 时，正在进行的光带会滑出，文字则平稳过渡为实色。新标签从柔和的模糊中原地升起，同时该行以弹簧调整至其宽度（P2、P5）。作为一个控件绘制：光带是通过滑动不透明度蒙版再次绘制的文字，因此每帧不分配任何内存。

trans-unit.source: Resting base color; when unset it is 12% of the text color mixed into muted text.
trans-unit.target: 静止的底色；未设置时为文字颜色的 12%，与次要文字颜色混合。

trans-unit.source: Font family of the text; inherited from TextElement unless set.
trans-unit.target: 文本的字体族；除非设置，否则继承自 TextElement。

trans-unit.source: Font size in device-independent pixels; inherited from TextElement unless set.
trans-unit.target: 与设备无关像素单位的字号；除非设置，否则继承自 TextElement。

trans-unit.source: Sweeps while work is ongoing (Arc `active`, true).
