trans-unit.source: Arc textarea: a labeled multiline field (Enter adds a line) with the same helper / error rows as `Input`; a live count in the description ("120 characters") rolls only the digits that change. It fills its column with a 110px minimum height and, like Arc's `resize: vertical`, can be made taller by dragging the corner grip (`IsResizable`). Focus draws Arc's 3px focus ring around the border. Arc's textarea does not grow with its content, so neither does this one; it scrolls instead.
trans-unit.target: Arc 多行文本框：带标签的多行字段（Enter 添加换行），其辅助文字行和错误行与 `Input` 相同；描述中的实时计数（如 “120 characters”）只滚动变化的数字。它以 110px 的最小高度填满所在列，并且与 Arc 的 `resize: vertical` 一样，可通过拖动右下角手柄（`IsResizable`）加高。聚焦时在边框周围绘制 Arc 的 3px 焦点环。与 Arc 的多行文本框一样，此控件不随内容增长，而是改为滚动。

trans-unit.source: Height chosen with the grip, in px; NaN follows the minimum height.
trans-unit.target: 通过手柄选定的高度（单位 px）；NaN 表示遵循最小高度。

trans-unit.source: Shows the corner grip that drags the field taller (Arc: `resize: vertical`). Default true.
trans-unit.target: 显示可拖动字段加高的右下角手柄（Arc：`resize: vertical`）。默认为 true。

trans-unit.source: A single light / dark switch for a header: a secondary button that swaps sun and moon on a shared turn and names the next appearance. Pressing it raises `ThemeChangeRequested`; unless a handler marks it handled, the switcher applies the change through AtomUI's theme manager (toggling `ThemeAlgorithm.Dark` and keeping the rest of the current theme) inside the page transition of its `Variant`. Arc hands that transition to the View Transitions API; here the old window is snapshotted into an overlay whose animated clip reveals the new theme beneath (`RunTransitionAsync`, also usable from a handler). Reduced motion switches without a transition.
trans-unit.target: 用于页眉的单一明暗切换：一个次要按钮，在共享的转动动画中切换太阳与月亮图标，并标明下一种外观。按下时引发 `ThemeChangeRequested`；除非处理程序将其标记为已处理，否则切换器会通过 AtomUI 的主题管理器应用更改（切换 `ThemeAlgorithm.Dark` 并保留当前主题的其他设置），并在其 `Variant` 的页面过渡中进行。Arc 将该过渡交给 View Transitions API；此处则将旧窗口截取为覆盖层，由其动画裁剪区在下方显示新主题（`RunTransitionAsync`，也可在处理程序中使用）。减少动态效果时直接切换，不做过渡。

trans-unit.source: The appearance shown; null follows the control's actual theme variant (default).

trans-unit.source: Accessible name; null says "Switch to dark mode" or "Switch to light mode".
trans-unit.target: 无障碍名称；null 时为“切换到深色模式”或“切换到浅色模式”。

trans-unit.source: The visible text beside the icon (default "Switch theme").
trans-unit.target: 图标旁可见的文字（默认为“切换主题”）。

trans-unit.source: Raised before the theme changes. Set `Handled` to apply the theme yourself (optionally inside `RunTransitionAsync`); otherwise the switcher applies it through AtomUI's theme manager.
trans-unit.target: 主题更改前引发。设置 `Handled` 以自行应用主题（可选择在 `RunTransitionAsync` 中进行）；否则切换器通过 AtomUI 的主题管理器应用。

trans-unit.source: Which page transition to play (default Reveal).
trans-unit.target: 播放哪种页面过渡（默认为 Reveal）。

trans-unit.source: A comment and its replies (Arc's `ThreadComment`). Immutable: every change made in a `CommentThread` produces a new tree (unchanged comments are shared), so it can be stored as is.
trans-unit.target: 一条评论及其回复（Arc 的 `ThreadComment`）。不可变：在 `CommentThread` 中做出的每次更改都会生成新的树（未更改的评论会被共享），因此可以原样存储。

trans-unit.source: Arc time field: a trigger over a scrolling list of times generated every `MinuteStep` minutes. The list opens centred on the chosen time, arrow keys move the highlight (the list glides to keep it in view, wrapping at both ends), Enter or a click chooses and closes, Escape closes. The shown time rolls like a clock face: a later time rises from below, an earlier one drops from above. 12- or 24-hour display follows the culture unless `ClockFormat` says otherwise; the value is always a 24-hour `TimeOnly`.
trans-unit.target: Arc 时间字段：触发器下方是一个可滚动的时间列表，每隔 `MinuteStep` 分钟生成一项。列表打开时以所选时间为中心，方向键移动高亮（列表会滑动以保持其可见，两端循环），Enter 或点击选择并关闭，Escape 关闭。显示的时间如同钟面一样滚动：较晚的时间从下方升起，较早的时间从上方落下。除非 `ClockFormat` 另有指定，否则 12 小时制或 24 小时制显示跟随文化设置；值始终为 24 小时制的 `TimeOnly`。

trans-unit.source: 12- or 24-hour display (Auto follows the culture).
trans-unit.target: 12 小时制或 24 小时制显示（Auto 跟随文化设置）。

trans-unit.source: Culture for the clock format and the AM / PM designators (null = current UI culture).

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the trigger.
trans-unit.target: 触发器下方的辅助文字。

trans-unit.source: Error copy under the trigger; non-empty makes the field invalid.

trans-unit.source: Whether the list is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 列表是否展开（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: When false the label is hidden but still names the field.
trans-unit.target: 为 false 时标签隐藏，但仍为字段命名。

trans-unit.source: The visible label above the trigger (Arc: required).
trans-unit.target: 触发器上方的可见标签（Arc：必填）。

trans-unit.source: Tallest the list grows before it scrolls (Arc: 250px).
trans-unit.target: 列表增长的最大高度，超过后滚动（Arc：250px）。

trans-unit.source: Minutes between options (Arc: 1, 5, 10, 15 or 30; default 15).
trans-unit.target: 选项之间的分钟间隔（Arc：1、5、10、15 或 30；默认 15）。

trans-unit.source: A vertical activity feed grouped by day, newest first (Arc's `Timeline`), for project history, audit logs and deploy streams. Day labels stay pinned while their updates scroll, the connecting line draws itself as rows come into view, rows with a `Detail` expand in place, and new updates slide in at the top while the rest glide down. ↑ / ↓ / Home / End move between expandable rows; Enter or Space expands one.
trans-unit.target: 按日期分组的垂直活动动态，最新的在前（Arc 的 `Timeline`），适用于项目历史、审计日志和部署流。日期标签在其更新滚动时保持固定，连接线会随行进入视口而自行绘制，带有 `Detail` 的行会原地展开，新的更新从顶部滑入，其余内容滑动下移。↑ / ↓ / Home / End 在可展开的行之间移动；Enter 或空格键展开一行。

trans-unit.source: Arc toast: a brief confirmation for a completed background action (one locally controlled success message such as "Changes saved"). It rises from its edge on the morph spring while its check mark draws itself, closes after `Duration` (the timer does not pause, so keep the copy short), and can be swiped away in either direction with velocity. Text changes rise in place while the height springs to fit. For app-wide notifications (types, actions, updates, stacking) call `Show` from anywhere: it goes to the window's `ToastStack` (see `ToastHost`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 通知提示（Toast）：用于已完成后台操作的简短确认（一条本地控制的成功消息，如“Changes saved”）。它沿边缘升起，依托形变弹簧运动，同时其对勾逐步绘出；经过 `Duration` 后关闭（计时器不会暂停，因此请保持文案简短），并可按速度向任一方向滑动移除。文本变化时原位上浮，高度以弹簧方式调整至合适大小。若需应用级通知（类型、操作、更新、堆叠），请在任意位置调用 `Show`：它会进入窗口的 `ToastStack`（参见 `ToastHost`）。

trans-unit.target: 可选的第二行文字。

trans-unit.source: Arc toast stack: short, non-blocking results of what someone just did, stacked at the edge of the window until they reach for them. New toasts rise from the bottom edge, older ones tuck 14px behind and shrink by 5% per step; hovering or focusing the stack fans it out into a list (Alt+T moves focus in). Toasts pause while the stack is open, dragged or the window is minimized, swipe right to dismiss, and morph in place when updated (`Update`): a loading toast becomes its result. Place one in the window (over the content, for example as the last child of the root panel) or let `ToastHost` create one on the window's overlay layer; then call `Show` or this control's `IToastService` methods from anywhere.
trans-unit.target: Arc 通知堆叠：对某人刚完成操作的简短、非阻塞结果，堆叠在窗口边缘，直到用户主动查看。新提示从底部边缘升起，较旧的提示向后收入 14px 并每层缩小 5%；悬停或聚焦到堆叠区时会展开为列表（Alt+T 可将焦点移入）。打开、拖动或窗口最小化时提示会暂停；向右滑动可关闭；通过 `Update` 更新时会原位变形（加载中的提示会变为其结果）。可将其放置在窗口中（覆盖在内容之上，例如作为根面板的最后一个子元素），或让 `ToastHost` 在窗口的覆盖层上自动创建；之后在任意位置调用 `Show` 或此控件的 `IToastService` 方法即可。

trans-unit.source: One tool call of an agent transcript (Arc Tool call, design reference): the tool's mark, the call as a verb phrase, quiet meta ("4 results · 1.2s") and a status icon. The whole row is a button: it springs open into Input (the arguments as a mono key / value list) and Output (the result as a list, a table, tinted JSON or text, folding long ones behind "Show N more lines"), each with a copy button. A running call shimmers its title next to a spinner; a failed one shows its reason and Retry; one that waits for approval sits on an accent outline with Deny and Allow; a denied one is muted. Bind `Item` and change the item in place as the call moves on. Allow, Deny and Retry raise `ApproveRequested`, `DenyRequested` and `RetryRequested` (they bubble, so a `ToolCallGroup` or any parent can handle them): update the call's status yourself and set `Handled`. When nothing handles them, Deny marks the call denied here; Allow and Retry only simulate a run on the built-in sample data (`ToolCallSamples`) and change nothing otherwise. With no item the row shows a sample web search. On its own the row sits in a 1px bordered Surface frame (radius 16, 4px in); inside a group it is flush.
trans-unit.target: 智能体转录中的一次工具调用（Arc Tool call，设计参考）：工具的标记、以动词短语表示的调用、低调的元信息（"4 results · 1.2s"）以及状态图标。整行是一个按钮：点击后以弹性动效展开为输入（参数，等宽的键/值列表）和输出（结果，以列表、表格、着色的 JSON 或文本呈现，过长内容折叠在"Show N more lines"之后），两者都带复制按钮。运行中的调用会在旋转指示器旁让标题闪烁；失败的调用会显示原因和重试；等待批准的调用带强调色轮廓，并显示拒绝和允许；被拒绝的调用会变为弱化显示。绑定 `Item`，调用推进时就地修改该项。允许、拒绝和重试会引发 `ApproveRequested`、`DenyRequested` 和 `RetryRequested`（它们会冒泡，因此 `ToolCallGroup` 或任何父级都可以处理）：由你自行更新调用的状态并设置 `Handled`。若无人处理，拒绝会在此处将调用标记为已拒绝；允许和重试只会在内置示例数据（`ToolCallSamples`）上模拟运行，其他情况下不做任何改变。没有项目时，该行显示一个示例网页搜索。单独使用时，该行位于 1px 带边框的 Surface 外框中（圆角 16，内缩 4px）；在分组中则与边缘齐平。

trans-unit.source: Every tool call of one assistant turn in one quiet card (Arc Tool call group, design reference): a header with the tools' overlapping marks, "Used 4 tools" (or "Using 3 tools" with a shimmer while the agent works, or "Waiting for approval") and, on the right, "1 failed" or the total duration; below it, one `ToolCall` row per call. Append calls to `Items` (or an observable `ItemsSource`) as the agent starts them and change them in place: a new row grows in from zero height, a new tool's mark joins the stack on a spring. Opening the header staggers the rows in. While the agent works the group stays open; 450ms after every call finished it folds itself away (`AutoCollapse`) unless the person opened or closed the group or a row. A call that needs a decision (a failure, an approval) opens a folded group. An empty group takes no space; its first call grows it in. With neither `Items` nor `ItemsSource` it shows four finished sample calls. Allow, Deny and Retry bubble up from the rows as `ApproveRequested`, `DenyRequested` and `RetryRequested`; see `ToolCall` for what happens when nothing handles them.
trans-unit.target: 将一个助手回合的所有工具调用放在一张安静的卡片中（Arc 工具调用组，设计参考）：标题栏包含工具的重叠标记，"Used 4 tools"（代理工作时为带闪烁效果的 "Using 3 tools"，或 "Waiting for approval"），右侧为 "1 failed" 或总时长；下方每个调用对应一行 `ToolCall`。代理开始调用时将其追加到 `Items`（或可观察的 `ItemsSource`），并原地修改它们：新行从零高度展开，新工具的标记以弹簧动画加入标记堆叠。展开标题栏时各行依次错开进入。代理工作期间该组保持展开；每次调用完成后 450ms，若用户未展开或收起该组或任一行，它会自动折叠（`AutoCollapse`）。需要决定的调用（失败、需要批准）会展开已折叠的组。空组不占用空间；其第一个调用会使其展开。若既未设置 `Items` 也未设置 `ItemsSource`，则显示四个已完成的示例调用。行中的允许、拒绝和重试会以 `ApproveRequested`、`DenyRequested` 和 `RetryRequested` 冒泡上传；未被处理时的行为见 `ToolCall`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a row's Allow is pressed (it bubbles from the row).
trans-unit.target: 按下某行的允许时引发（从该行冒泡）。

trans-unit.source: Folds the list `AutoCollapseDelay` after every call finished, so the answer reads right under "Used 4 tools"; skipped once the person opened or closed the group or any row.
trans-unit.target: 每次调用完成后等待 `AutoCollapseDelay`，然后折叠列表，使答案紧接在 "Used 4 tools" 下方显示；若用户已展开或收起该组或任一行，则跳过。

trans-unit.source: The wait before the group folds itself (450ms).
trans-unit.target: 群组自动折叠前的等待时间（450ms）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a row's Deny is pressed (it bubbles from the row).
trans-unit.target: 按下某行的拒绝时引发（从该行冒泡）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the list opens or closes, by the person, the app or the group itself (see `IsAutomatic`).
trans-unit.target: 列表展开或收起时引发，无论是由用户、应用程序还是群组自身触发（参见 `IsAutomatic`）。

trans-unit.source: The number of failed calls.
trans-unit.target: 失败调用的数量。

trans-unit.source: The header as read: the label and the meta ("Used 3 tools 1 failed").
trans-unit.target: 读出的标题栏文字：标签和元信息（"Used 3 tools 1 failed"）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the agent is still working in this turn, so the header keeps saying "Using" between calls; null (default) means "while any call runs".
trans-unit.target: 代理在本回合中是否仍在工作，使标题在调用之间保持"Using"的状态；null（默认）表示"任一调用运行期间"。

trans-unit.source: Whether the list is open (two-way). Until it is set, the group opens while any call runs, waits or failed, and a finished transcript starts folded.
trans-unit.target: 列表是否展开（双向绑定）。在设置之前，只要有任一调用在运行、等待或失败，该组就会展开；已完成的记录默认折叠。

trans-unit.source: An observable list of calls that wins over `Items`.
trans-unit.target: 可观察的调用列表，优先于 `Items`。

trans-unit.source: Every word the group and its rows show or say.
trans-unit.target: 群组及其各行展示或说出的每一个文字。

trans-unit.source: A custom result view for every successful call (see `OutputTemplate`).
trans-unit.target: 每个成功调用的自定义结果视图（参见 `OutputTemplate`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a row's Retry is pressed (it bubbles from the row).
trans-unit.target: 按下某行的重试时引发（从该行冒泡）。

trans-unit.source: The sum of the successful calls' durations (shown once nothing runs or waits).
trans-unit.target: 成功调用耗时的总和（在没有任何调用运行或等待后显示）。

trans-unit.source: One tool call of an agent turn: which tool ran, what it did in plain words, how it went, its arguments and what came back. Change `Status` (and the other properties) in place as the call moves on: a row keeps its place and its open state, and every change reaches the screen. Keep `Id` stable.
trans-unit.target: 代理回合中的一个工具调用：运行了哪个工具、用平实的语言说明其作用、结果如何、它的参数以及返回了什么。随调用推进原地修改 `Status`（及其他属性）：行会保持其位置和展开状态，每次修改都会反映到屏幕上。保持 `Id` 稳定。

trans-unit.source: The phrase while waiting for approval, as a request ("Post a status note to #finance-ops"); null uses `Title`.
trans-unit.target: 等待批准时显示的短语，写成请求的形式（"Post a status note to #finance-ops"）；为 null 时使用 `Title`。

trans-unit.source: How long the call took, shown as "760ms" or "1.2s"; a group adds up the successful ones.
trans-unit.target: 调用耗时，显示为 "760ms" 或 "1.2s"；群组会将成功调用的耗时相加。

trans-unit.source: The phrase after a failure ("Could not read the export job log"); null uses `Title`.
trans-unit.target: 失败后显示的短语（"Could not read the export job log"）；为 null 时使用 `Title`。

trans-unit.source: A stable id. A group keys its rows by it, so a call whose status changes keeps its row.
trans-unit.target: 稳定的 id。群组按此 id 为各行建立索引，因此状态变化的调用会保留其行。

trans-unit.source: One line under the title while the call failed (the reason) or waits for approval (what allowing will do). Not shown in the other statuses.
trans-unit.target: 调用失败（原因）或等待批准（允许后将发生什么）时，标题下方的一行文字。其他状态下不显示。

trans-unit.source: What came back: a list, a table, JSON or text. Shown under Output once the call succeeded.
trans-unit.target: 返回的内容：列表、表格、JSON 或文本。调用成功后显示在"Output"下方。

trans-unit.source: The phrase while running, in the present tense ("Searching tickets in finance/close"); null uses `Title`.
trans-unit.target: 运行期间显示的现在时短语（"Searching tickets in finance/close"）；为 null 时使用 `Title`。

trans-unit.source: Where the call stands. Change it in place as the call runs, fails, waits or finishes.
trans-unit.target: 调用当前所处的状态。随调用运行、失败、等待或完成而原地修改。

trans-unit.source: Quiet meta before the duration, such as "4 results". Null derives it from `Output` (results, rows, fields, items).
trans-unit.target: 耗时之前的次要元信息，例如 "4 results"。为 null 时从 `Output` 推导（结果、行、字段、项目）。

trans-unit.source: The settled verb phrase in the past tense, such as "Searched tickets in finance/close". One line; it truncates.
trans-unit.target: 已完成的过去时动词短语，例如 "Searched tickets in finance/close"。一行；超出时截断。

trans-unit.source: The tool's mark: a 24 × 24 stroked glyph such as a Lucide icon, drawn at 16px in the row and 12px in a group's mark stack. Null draws a wrench.
trans-unit.target: 工具的标记：一个 24 × 24 的描边图标（例如 Lucide 图标），在行中以 16px 绘制，在群组的标记堆叠中以 12px 绘制。为 null 时绘制扳手。

trans-unit.source: The mark's color; null uses the text color, which follows the theme.
trans-unit.target: 标记的颜色；为 null 时使用随主题变化的文本颜色。

trans-unit.source: The tool's name, read before the title by screen readers ("Search: Searched the web …").
trans-unit.target: 工具的名称，屏幕阅读器会在标题之前读出（"Search: Searched the web …"）。

trans-unit.source: A JSON result (an API response): indented two spaces, tinted (keys, strings, numbers, literals and punctuation in their own colors), 20px lines, folding after ten lines behind "Show N more lines". Wide lines scroll inside the well. Built on `Nodes`, so no reflection is involved.
trans-unit.target: JSON 结果（API 响应）：以两个空格缩进，带颜色高亮（键、字符串、数字、字面量和标点各有其颜色），每行 20px，超过十行后折叠，并显示"Show N more lines"。过宽的行在结果区域内滚动。基于 `Nodes` 构建，不涉及反射。

trans-unit.source: Every word `ToolCall` and `ToolCallGroup` show or say, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; sentences with numbers or names are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `ToolCall` 和 `ToolCallGroup` 展示或说出的每一个文字，默认为英文。若要本地化或改写，请替换整个对象；包含数字或名称的句子使用格式化函数。

trans-unit.source: One entry of a `ToolCallListOutput`: a short mono lead (an id such as "#482"), a title and a tag.
trans-unit.target: `ToolCallListOutput` 的一个条目：简短的等宽前导（如 "#482" 之类的 id）、标题和标签。

trans-unit.source: A list result (search hits, tickets): a lead, a title and a tag per row, 32px rows, folding after five.
trans-unit.target: 列表结果（搜索命中、工单）：每行一个前导、标题和标签，行高 32px，超过五行后折叠。

trans-unit.source: What a tool call returned, shown under Output once the call succeeded: a `ToolCallListOutput`, a `ToolCallTableOutput`, a `ToolCallJsonOutput` or a `ToolCallTextOutput`. Assign a new output to change what a row shows; an output is read when the row opens.
trans-unit.target: 工具调用的返回内容，在调用成功后显示在"Output"下方：`ToolCallListOutput`、`ToolCallTableOutput`、`ToolCallJsonOutput` 或 `ToolCallTextOutput` 之一。赋予新的输出即可更改该行显示的内容；行在打开时才读取输出。

trans-unit.source: Plays a scripted agent turn into `Items` on a clock: calls are appended one after another, run for their time and settle; a failing call waits for `Retry` and a call that needs approval waits for `Approve` or `Deny`. Bind a `ToolCallGroup`'s `ItemsSource` to `Items` and its `IsActive` to `IsWorking`: Allow, Deny and Retry on the group's rows reach the simulation when nothing else handles them. The default script is `Script`. Time comes from a `TimeProvider`, so tests can step it; callbacks run on the UI thread.
trans-unit.target: 按时间顺序将脚本化的代理回合播放到 `Items` 中：调用依次追加，运行其耗时后结束；失败的调用等待 `Retry`，需要批准的调用等待 `Approve` 或 `Deny`。将 `ToolCallGroup` 的 `ItemsSource` 绑定到 `Items`，并将其 `IsActive` 绑定到 `IsWorking`：群组各行上的允许、拒绝和重试，若无其他处理方，会传递给模拟。默认脚本为 `Script`。时间来自 `TimeProvider`，因此测试可以逐步推进；回调在 UI 线程上运行。

trans-unit.source: Raised on the UI thread at every beat of the run (a call appended, settled, failed, retried, allowed, denied; the start and the end).
trans-unit.target: 在运行的每个节拍时于 UI 线程上引发（调用被追加、完成、失败、重试、允许、拒绝；以及开始和结束）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the agent is working (appending or running calls): bind a group's `IsActive` to it, so its header keeps saying "Using" between calls.
trans-unit.target: 代理是否正在工作（追加或运行调用）：将群组的 `IsActive` 绑定到它，使其标题在调用之间保持"Using"的状态。

trans-unit.source: Where the run stands.
trans-unit.target: 运行所处的状态。

trans-unit.source: Data of `Changed`.
trans-unit.target: `Changed` 的数据。

trans-unit.source: One scripted call of a `ToolCallSimulation`.
trans-unit.target: `ToolCallSimulation` 的一个脚本化调用。

trans-unit.source: A table result (database rows): column headers and mono cells, 30px rows, folding after five rows. A null cell reads "null". A wide table scrolls inside its well.
trans-unit.target: 表格结果（数据库行）：列标题和等宽单元格，行高 30px，超过五行后折叠。空单元格显示为 "null"。过宽的表格在其结果区域内滚动。

trans-unit.source: A text result (a sent message, a short log): one paragraph that keeps its line breaks.
trans-unit.target: 文本结果（已发送的消息、简短日志）：一个保留换行的段落。

trans-unit.source: A short label on hover or keyboard focus. Attach it to any control with `arc:Tooltip.Tip="Copy link"` (and optionally `arc:Tooltip.Side`). The first tooltip waits 250ms and rises 3px from its trigger; while any tooltip is open, and for 300ms after the last one closes, the next opens at once with a fade only. String content that changes while open crossfades and the bubble springs to the new size. The `Tooltip` instance itself is the bubble shown in the popup.
trans-unit.target: 悬停或键盘聚焦时显示的简短标签。使用 `arc:Tooltip.Tip="Copy link"`（可选 `arc:Tooltip.Side`）即可将其附加到任意控件。第一个提示会等待 250ms，并从其触发点上浮 3px；当任一提示打开时，以及最后一个提示关闭后的 300ms 内，下一个提示会立即打开，仅做淡入淡出。打开期间变化的字符串内容会交叉淡入，气泡以弹簧方式调整到新尺寸。`Tooltip` 实例本身即为弹出层中显示的气泡。

trans-unit.source: Shows or hides the tooltip on the element at once, without ShowDelay.
trans-unit.target: 立即显示或隐藏该元素上的提示，不经过 ShowDelay。

trans-unit.source: Wait before the first tooltip opens after hover or focus; default 250 ms. Open tooltips skip the wait.
trans-unit.target: 悬停或获得焦点后，第一个提示打开前的等待时间；默认 250 ms。已打开的提示会跳过等待。

trans-unit.source: Side of the trigger the bubble opens on: Top (default), Bottom, Left or Right.
trans-unit.target: 气泡相对于触发元素打开的一侧：Top（默认）、Bottom、Left 或 Right。

trans-unit.source: Tooltip content: a string, or any object (bind it when the text comes from the view model).
trans-unit.target: 提示内容：字符串或任意对象（当文本来自视图模型时进行绑定）。

trans-unit.source: A keyboard-navigable file tree with animated folders and a selection fill that glides between rows. Folders open with their space growing on a smooth spring while the new rows stagger in; the chevron turns on a snappy spring and the folder icon pops open. Keyboard: ↑/↓ move, → opens or enters, ← closes or goes to the parent, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Enter/Space select and toggle, and typing jumps to a matching row. Unlike `TreeView` (nested item containers), rows are a flat, virtualized list of pooled, self-drawn rows (see `TablesTreeRowsPanel`): thousands of open nodes cost one screenful of rows, and the open / close motion never relayouts the whole tree. Nodes come from inline `Items` (`TreeViewItem`) or from `ItemsSource` with `ChildrenSelector`.
trans-unit.target: 可用键盘导航的文件树，文件夹带动画，选中填充会在行之间平滑滑动。文件夹展开时其空间以平滑弹簧增长，新行依次交错出现；箭头以灵敏的弹簧转动，文件夹图标弹出展开。键盘操作：↑/↓ 移动，→ 展开或进入，← 收起或转到父级，Home/End，PageUp/PageDown，Enter/Space 选取并切换展开，输入字符可跳转到匹配的行。与 `TreeView`（嵌套的项容器）不同，行是扁平的虚拟化列表，由池化的自绘行组成（参见 `TablesTreeRowsPanel`）：数千个展开的节点只需渲染一屏的行，展开和收起动画也从不重新布局整棵树。节点可来自内联的 `Items`（`TreeViewItem`），或来自带 `ChildrenSelector` 的 `ItemsSource`。

trans-unit.source: Children of a data item (null or empty: a file). Not needed for `TreeViewItem` nodes.
trans-unit.target: 数据项的子项（为 null 或空时：表示文件）。`TreeViewItem` 节点无需设置。

trans-unit.source: Row label of a data item; `ToString()` when not set.
trans-unit.target: 数据项的行标签；未设置时使用 `ToString()`。

trans-unit.source: Optional icon of a data item (24x24 stroked glyph); folders and files get Arc's icons otherwise.
trans-unit.target: 数据项的可选图标（24x24 描边图标）；否则文件夹和文件使用 Arc 的图标。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a branch item collapses.
trans-unit.target: 分支项收起时引发。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a branch item expands.
trans-unit.target: 分支项展开时引发。

trans-unit.source: A row was clicked or activated with Enter / Space (Arc `onSelect`), even when already selected.
trans-unit.target: 行被点击或通过 Enter / Space 激活时引发（Arc 的 `onSelect`），即使该行已被选中。

trans-unit.source: Root nodes from data; takes precedence over `Items`.
trans-unit.target: 来自数据的根节点；优先于 `Items`。

trans-unit.source: The selected node (two-way). Setting it to a hidden node opens its ancestors.
trans-unit.target: 选中的节点（双向绑定）。将其设置为隐藏节点时会展开其祖先节点。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the selected item changes; the argument carries the old and new item.
trans-unit.target: 选中项改变时引发；参数携带旧项和新项。

trans-unit.source: Shows each row's icon (16px slot before the label); when false the label starts at the indent.
trans-unit.target: 显示每行的图标（标签前有 16px 的占位）；为 false 时标签从缩进处开始。

trans-unit.source: Draws the short branch line beside nested rows (Arc's indent guide).
trans-unit.target: 在嵌套行旁绘制短的分支线（Arc 的缩进参考线）。

trans-unit.source: A node written inline in a `TreeView` (Arc's `TreeNode`): a label, optional icon and child nodes. A node with children is a folder. Not a control: the tree draws its rows itself (virtualized), so nodes stay cheap however many there are.
trans-unit.target: 在 `TreeView` 中内联编写的节点（Arc 的 `TreeNode`）：包含标签、可选图标和子节点。含子节点的节点即为文件夹。它不是控件：树会自行绘制其行（虚拟化），因此无论节点多少都很轻量。

trans-unit.source: Label of the row.
trans-unit.target: 行的标签。

trans-unit.source: Optional 24x24 stroked glyph (for example an `ArcIcons` member) replacing the folder / file icon.
trans-unit.target: 可选的 24x24 描边图标（例如 `ArcIcons` 成员），用于替代文件夹或文件图标。

trans-unit.source: Whether the folder is open (two-way; the tree keeps it in sync).
trans-unit.target: 文件夹是否展开（双向绑定；树会保持同步）。

trans-unit.source: A squarified treemap (Arc "Treemap") for a hierarchy of parts. Top-level branches take Series1–4 and, with `ColorLabel`, every tile deepens with a second measure. Clicking (or Enter on) a branch zooms in: the tile grows to fill the view while its siblings fly out and its children open inside it, all on one affine 0.62s spring; the breadcrumb, Escape or Backspace zoom back out along the same path. A data change morphs every tile in place. Labels never scale: each tile lays its text out at its size and shows it only when it fits.
trans-unit.target: 方块化树状图（Arc 的“Treemap”），用于展示层级结构的各个部分。顶层分支使用 Series1–4；设置 `ColorLabel` 后，每个方块会随第二个度量值加深颜色。点击（或在分支上按 Enter）可放大该分支：方块放大以填满视图，同级方块飞出，其子项在其中展开，全部由一个 0.62s 的仿射弹簧驱动；面包屑导航、Escape 或 Backspace 会沿同一路径缩小返回。数据变化时，每个方块原位变形。标签从不缩放：每个方块以其自身尺寸排版文本，并仅在能放下时显示。

trans-unit.target: 定义 `ChildrenSelector` 属性。

trans-unit.source: A node of a `Treemap`: a leaf with a value, or a branch whose value is the sum of its children.
trans-unit.target: `Treemap` 的节点：叶节点带有一个值，或分支节点的值为其子节点之和。

trans-unit.source: A metered billing period on one page: what has been spent so far and the projected total, the spend per day, each meter's usage against what the plan includes (with the overage priced), and a spending limit that can be turned on and set in place. The totals follow the meters: change `Used` and the amounts, bars and projection update. "Today" comes from `Clock`.
trans-unit.target: 页面中的一个计量计费周期：迄今已花费的金额与预计总额、每日花费、每个计量项的用量与套餐包含额度的对比（超额部分按价格计费），以及可就地开启并设置的花费上限。总额随计量项变化：修改 `Used` 后，金额、进度条和预计总额都会随之更新。“今天”取自 `Clock`。

trans-unit.source: The share of the limit (0–1, default 0.8) at which the progress turns to the warning color and the tick sits.
trans-unit.target: 达到上限的比例（0–1，默认 0.8），进度条到达该比例时变为警告色，刻度线也位于此处。

trans-unit.source: The fixed charge of the period (the plan price), added to the metered charges.
trans-unit.target: 本周期的固定费用（套餐价格），会加到计量费用之上。

trans-unit.source: ISO 4217 code of every amount ("USD" by default).
trans-unit.target: 所有金额所用的 ISO 4217 货币代码（默认为“USD”）。

trans-unit.source: What the period has cost so far: `BaseFee` + `MeteredTotal`.
trans-unit.target: 本周期迄今的费用：`BaseFee` + `MeteredTotal`。

trans-unit.source: The amount spent on each day of the period, starting with the first day. Days after today are not drawn; a null or empty list hides the daily spend card. A list that raises collection changes redraws as it changes.
trans-unit.target: 计费周期内每天的花费金额，从第一天开始。今天之后的日期不绘制；null 或空列表会隐藏每日花费卡片。引发集合变更的列表会随其变化重新绘制。

trans-unit.source: Whether the spending limit applies. Two-way: the limit switch edits it.

trans-unit.source: Shows what fills a fixed allowance and how close it is to the limit (Arc UsageMeter): a title with a status badge, the rolling total, a bar of accent steps (one per category) and a legend that doubles as the keyboard path. The first time 40% of the meter is visible the categories grow in left to right; later changes re-flow every category on its own smooth spring (P18, P23) and the numbers roll the way they moved (P14). Past the limit the bar is struck through with a hatch beside a limit marker, so the overage reads without color. Hovering or focusing a category previews it (the others dim); a press pins it until pressed again or Escape. Categories come from `ItemsSource` or the inline `Segments`.
trans-unit.target: 显示固定配额已占用多少，以及距离上限还有多远（Arc UsageMeter）：包括标题和状态徽标、滚动的总量、按类别分段的强调色进度条，以及兼作键盘操作路径的图例。首次有 40% 的仪表可见时，各类别从左到右增长；之后的变化会以各自的平滑弹簧重新排布每个类别（P18, P23），数字也会按变化方向滚动（P14）。超过上限后，进度条会以斜线划掉，并在旁边显示上限标记，即使没有颜色也能看出超出部分。悬停或聚焦某一类别会预览它（其余变暗）；按下会将其固定，直到再次按下或按 Escape。类别来自 `ItemsSource` 或内联的 `Segments`。

trans-unit.source: The account menu behind a person's avatar in an app's top bar (Arc user menu): a compact identity header, a short group of account destinations (`Items`, keep it to three or four), an inline light / dark / system switch, an optional presence switch and sign out. Theme and status choices keep the menu open; everything else closes it and returns focus to the avatar. When `SignOutAction` returns an unfinished task the row shows a spinner and "Signing out", and the menu closes once it settles. Below a 640px wide window the menu opens as a bottom sheet that follows a downward drag. The panel scales out of the avatar on a spring that never overshoots, rows fade in 16ms apart, one highlight glides between rows and the switch thumbs slide on Arc's CSS spring.
trans-unit.target: 应用顶栏中位于用户头像后的账户菜单（Arc 用户菜单）：包含紧凑的身份标题、一组简短的账户目的地（`Items`，建议保留三到四个）、内联的浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统切换、可选的在线状态切换以及退出登录。主题和状态选项会使菜单保持打开；其他操作会关闭菜单并将焦点返回头像。当 `SignOutAction` 返回未完成的任务时，该行会显示加载指示并显示“Signing out”，待其完成后菜单再关闭。窗口宽度小于 640px 时，菜单会以底部面板形式打开，并跟随向下拖动。面板以不会过冲的弹簧从头像处缩放展开，各行每隔 16ms 依次淡入，一个高亮块在行间滑动，开关滑块按 Arc 的 CSS 弹簧滑动。

trans-unit.source: An animated semantic search: a question is typed, embedded into a vector, dropped into a map of document vectors, and its nearest neighbours by cosine similarity become the ranked answers. The search is real (hashed bag-of-words embeddings, cosine ranking, a principal-component map), so `Search` works with any question.

trans-unit.source: A unit chart (Arc "Waffle chart"): a rows × columns grid where every cell is one share of the whole (10 × 10 = one cell per percent), filled column by column from the bottom-left corner. Cells are persistent: when the data changes they stay put where they can and the rest fly, staggered, to their new block while dipping and changing color. The legend rolls each share to its new value; hovering or focusing a category dims the others, clicking pins it. Arrow keys walk the grid cell by cell, Page Up / Page Down jump between categories, Escape clears the reading.
trans-unit.target: 单位图表（Arc“Waffle chart”）：行 × 列的网格，每个方格代表整体的一份（10 × 10 = 每格一个百分比），从左下角开始逐列填充。方格是持久的：数据变化时，尽量保留在原位，其余方格则交错飞至新的区块，过程中下沉并改变颜色。图例会将各占比滚动到新值；悬停或聚焦某一类别会使其他类别变暗，点击则将其固定。方向键逐格移动网格，Page Up / Page Down 在类别之间跳转，Escape 清除读数。

trans-unit.source: A desktop-class week planner: a toolbar with Today, previous / next and a view switch; a sidebar with a month and the calendars to show (it folds into a Calendars popover on narrower calendars); a header of days, an all-day row and a scrolling time grid with the events of each day side by side, the current time and the past dimmed. Week, work week and day views; narrow calendars show three days, a day or an agenda. Changing the range slides the header, the all-day row and the grid together on one spring; changing the view crossfades. Events are data (`Events` or `EventsSource`) in absolute time, shown in `TimeZone`. Drag across empty time to draw an event and name it in a quick create popover, drag events between days and times, drag their bottom edge to resize, click one to edit its title, day, times and calendar; everything snaps to 15 minutes, and the last change can be undone.
trans-unit.target: 一款桌面级的周日程规划器：工具栏包含“今天”、上一个/下一个按钮以及视图切换；侧边栏包含迷你月历和要显示的日历（在较窄的日历中，它会折叠进“日历”弹层）；头部是日期行、全天行以及可滚动的时间网格，网格中每天的日程并排显示，当前时间线和已过去的时段会变暗。提供周视图、工作周视图和日视图；较窄的日历显示三天、单日或议程。切换范围时，头部、全天行和网格会沿同一弹簧曲线一起滑动；切换视图时则为淡入淡出的交叉过渡。日程是数据（`Events` 或 `EventsSource`），以绝对时间表示，并按 `TimeZone` 显示。在空白时段上拖动即可画出一个日程，并在快速新建弹层中为其命名；可在日期和时间之间拖动日程，拖动其底边可调整时长；点击日程可编辑标题、日期、时间和日历。所有操作都会对齐到 15 分钟，最后一次更改可以撤销。

trans-unit.target: 显示侧边栏（true）、隐藏侧边栏（false），或在宽度达到 1100 时显示（null）。

trans-unit.source: Every text the calendar shows or reads to screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 日历显示或读给屏幕阅读器的每一段文字。

trans-unit.source: Runs when New event is pressed (parameter: the focused `DateOnly`), after `NewEventRequested`.
trans-unit.target: 按下“New event”时运行（参数：聚焦的 `DateOnly`），在 `NewEventRequested` 之后执行。

trans-unit.source: Raised when New event is pressed, with the focused day; set Handled to keep the calendar from drafting one at the day's next free hour.
trans-unit.target: 按下“New event”时引发，附带聚焦的日期；设置 Handled 可阻止日历在当天的下一个空闲小时自动起草日程。

trans-unit.source: A fixed "now" for demos and tests; null follows the clock, moving the current time line every minute.
trans-unit.target: 用于演示和测试的固定“当前时间”；为 null 时跟随系统时钟，每分钟移动一次当前时间线。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the days shown change (previous / next, Today, a day in the month, the keys, a view change).
trans-unit.target: 显示的日期范围改变时引发（上一个／下一个、“Today”、月历中的某一天、键盘操作、视图切换）。

trans-unit.source: The last day shown.
trans-unit.target: 显示的最后一天。

trans-unit.source: The first day shown.
trans-unit.target: 显示的第一天。

trans-unit.source: The title of the days shown ("Sep 21 to 27, 2026", "Thursday, November 5").
trans-unit.target: 显示日期的标题（"Sep 21 to 27, 2026"、"Thursday, November 5"）。

trans-unit.source: The selected event (two-way): clicking, dragging or a keyboard move selects one; Escape clears it.
trans-unit.target: 选中的日程（双向绑定）：点击、拖动或键盘移动都会选中一个日程；Escape 清除选中。

trans-unit.source: Draws the current time line on today's range.
trans-unit.target: 在今天所在的日期范围内绘制当前时间线。

trans-unit.source: Shades Saturday and Sunday.
trans-unit.target: 为星期六和星期日添加底纹。

trans-unit.source: The first hour of the grid (0–23); the gutter labels start one hour later.
trans-unit.target: 网格的第一个小时（0–23）；时间刻度标签从其后一个小时开始。

trans-unit.source: The zone the grid shows times in; null uses the computer's. The header's corner shows its offset ("GMT+8").
trans-unit.target: 网格显示时间所用的时区；为 null 时使用计算机的时区。标题区的角落会显示其偏移量（"GMT+8"）。

trans-unit.source: How long the undo toast stays (6 s); zero turns undo off.
trans-unit.target: 撤销提示条的显示时长（6 秒）；设为零则关闭撤销功能。

trans-unit.source: The chosen view (two-way). Narrow calendars show `EffectiveView` instead.
trans-unit.target: 所选的视图（双向绑定）。窄日历改为显示 `EffectiveView`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `View` changes.
trans-unit.target: `View` 改变时引发。

trans-unit.source: One event of a `WeekCalendar`. `Start` and `End` are instants (store them in UTC or with their offset); the calendar shows them in its `TimeZone`. An all-day event covers whole dates: the dates of `Start` and `End` as written, with `End` exclusive (midnight after the last day); its time zone is ignored. Changing any property moves or redraws the event at once.
trans-unit.target: `WeekCalendar` 中的一个日程。`Start` 和 `End` 是时间点（请以 UTC 或带偏移量的形式保存）；日历会按其 `TimeZone` 显示它们。全天日程覆盖完整的日期：`Start` 和 `End` 按所写的日期取值，`End` 为开区间（即最后一天之后的午夜）；其时区被忽略。修改任何属性都会立即移动或重绘该日程。

trans-unit.source: The people invited; tall events show up to four avatars, the agenda three and a count.
trans-unit.target: 受邀的人员；较高的日程最多显示四个头像，议程中显示三个并加上计数。

trans-unit.source: The screen reader name; null composes "title, day, start to end, calendar, location".
trans-unit.target: 屏幕阅读器读出的名称；为 null 时由 "title, day, start to end, calendar, location" 组合而成。

trans-unit.source: The `Id` of its calendar; an unknown id draws the event in gray.
trans-unit.target: 其所属日历的 `Id`；未知的 id 会使日程以灰色绘制。

trans-unit.source: When the event ends (exclusive); an end at or before the start shows a 15 minute event.
trans-unit.target: 日程结束的时间（开区间）；结束时间早于或等于开始时间时，显示为 15 分钟的日程。

trans-unit.source: A stable id: focus, selection and callbacks follow it across rebuilds.
trans-unit.target: 稳定的 id：焦点、选中状态和回调在重建后仍跟随该日程。

trans-unit.source: True shows the event in the all-day row, spanning its dates.
trans-unit.target: 为 true 时，日程显示在全天行中，跨越其日期。

trans-unit.source: Where it takes place: a line with a pin on tall events, the second line in the agenda.
trans-unit.target: 地点：较高的日程中为带图钉的一行，议程中为第二行。

trans-unit.source: When the event starts.
trans-unit.target: 日程开始的时间。

trans-unit.source: Any object the app wants to keep with the event.
trans-unit.target: 应用希望与该日程一同保存的任意对象。

trans-unit.source: The title shown on the event.
trans-unit.target: 日程上显示的标题。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `EventUpdated`: the event as it is now and a copy of it before the change.
trans-unit.target: `EventUpdated` 的参数：日程当前的状态，以及更改前的副本。

trans-unit.source: Every word `WeekCalendar` shows or reads to screen readers, in English by default. Replace the instance (`Labels`) to translate or reword. Dates and times inside the formatted texts come from `Culture`; the functions only arrange them, so the word order can change.
trans-unit.target: `WeekCalendar` 显示或读给屏幕阅读器的每个词，默认为英文。替换该实例（`Labels`）即可翻译或改写。格式化文本中的日期和时间来自 `Culture`；这些函数只负责排列它们，因此词序可以改变。

trans-unit.source: A calendar of a `WeekCalendar` ("Work", "Home"): its events take its color, and its toggle in the sidebar (or the Calendars popover) shows or hides them.
trans-unit.target: `WeekCalendar` 的一个日历（如“Work”“Home”）：其日程采用其颜色，侧边栏（或日历弹层）中的开关可显示或隐藏这些日程。

trans-unit.source: The palette color; `Custom` uses `CustomColor`.
trans-unit.target: 调色板中的颜色；`Custom` 使用 `CustomColor`。

trans-unit.source: Any color for `Custom`; fills and text are mixed from it like the presets.
trans-unit.target: `Custom` 所用的任意颜色；填充色和文字色会与预设颜色一样由它混合而成。

trans-unit.source: The id events refer to through `CalendarId`.
trans-unit.target: 日程通过 `CalendarId` 引用的 id。

trans-unit.source: False hides the calendar's events (two-way; the toggle in the calendars list sets it).
trans-unit.target: 为 false 时隐藏该日历的日程（双向绑定；日历列表中的开关会设置它）。

trans-unit.source: The name in the calendars list and in event names read by screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 日历列表中的名称，以及屏幕阅读器读出的日程名称中的名称。

trans-unit.source: Any object the app wants to keep with the calendar.
trans-unit.target: 应用希望与该日历一同保存的任意对象。

trans-unit.source: Shows a `WorkflowGraph` on a dotted canvas (visual rules from Arc's free hero-section block, HeroRelay): one card per step, edges between them, and a run played out step by step. Set the steps' states as your run goes; when a step finishes, the data draws along its edges in the accent before the next step shows as running, and the edges of a branch the run did not take turn dashed. Steps without a position are arranged in ranks; by default the whole workflow shows at actual size and shrinks like a screenshot when it does not fit. Pan with a drag or the wheel, zoom with Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel, a pinch or the keyboard, and move between steps with the arrow keys.
trans-unit.target: 在点阵画布上展示 `WorkflowGraph`（视觉规则来自 Arc 免费的 hero-section 区块 HeroRelay）：每个步骤一张卡片，步骤之间是连线，运行过程逐步呈现。随运行进度设置各步骤的状态；一个步骤完成后，数据会以强调色沿其连线绘制，之后下一个步骤才显示为运行中，运行未经过的分支连线变为虚线。没有位置的步骤按层排布；默认以实际大小显示整个工作流，放不下时像截图一样缩小。拖动或滚动滚轮可平移，用 Ctrl / ⌘ + 滚轮、双指捏合或键盘缩放，用方向键在步骤间移动。

trans-unit.source: How the workflow fits the canvas (default `ShrinkToFit`: actual size, centered, shrinking when it does not fit). Panning, zooming or setting `Zoom` or `Offset` stops fitting until `FitToContent`. In a container with unlimited height the canvas is as tall as the fitted workflow.
trans-unit.target: 工作流如何适配画布（默认 `ShrinkToFit`：实际大小、居中，放不下时缩小）。平移、缩放或自行设置 `Zoom`、`Offset` 后停止适配，直到调用 `FitToContent`。在高度不受限的容器中，画布与适配后的工作流一样高。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a person drops a new connection on the empty canvas: show a list of steps there, add the chosen one and connect it yourself.
trans-unit.target: 当用户将新连线拖放到空白画布上时触发：在此处显示步骤列表，由你自行添加所选步骤并连接它。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a person connects two ports, after the workflow's own checks (`CanConnect`) and before the edge is added: set `Cancel` to refuse it, with a `Reason` to tell them why.
trans-unit.target: 当用户连接两个端口时触发，发生在工作流自身的检查（`CanConnect`）之后、连线添加之前：设置 `Cancel` 可拒绝该连接，并可通过 `Reason` 告知用户原因。

trans-unit.source: How edges are drawn: curves (default, as in Arc), right angles with rounded corners, or straight lines.
trans-unit.target: 连线的画法：曲线（默认，与 Arc 相同）、带圆角的直角，或直线。

trans-unit.source: The workflow to show.
trans-unit.target: 要显示的工作流。

trans-unit.source: Raised once after each edit a person makes (moving steps, deleting steps), when it is done: save the workflow or record the edit here.
trans-unit.target: 每次用户完成一次编辑（移动步骤、删除步骤）后触发一次：在这里保存工作流或记录这次编辑。

trans-unit.source: Whether people can move and delete steps (default false). Selecting works either way.
trans-unit.target: 是否允许用户移动和删除步骤（默认 false）。无论是否开启，都可以选择步骤。

trans-unit.source: Whether people can pan and zoom (default true): dragging pans, the wheel works per `WheelMode`, a pinch zooms, and the + / − keys zoom. Turn it off for a workflow shown inside a scrolling page that should only fit (Arc's hero). `ZoomTo`, `FitToContent` and `ScrollIntoView` work either way.
trans-unit.target: 是否允许平移和缩放（默认 true）：拖动可平移，滚轮按 `WheelMode` 工作，双指捏合可缩放，+ / − 键可缩放。对于放在滚动页面中、只需适配的工作流（如 Arc 的 hero），请关闭它。无论是否开启，`ZoomTo`、`FitToContent` 和 `ScrollIntoView` 都可用。

trans-unit.source: Which way the workflow runs: down (default, as in Arc) or across. Edges and arranging follow it.
trans-unit.target: 工作流的运行方向：向下（默认，与 Arc 一致）或向右。连线和排布都随之变化。

trans-unit.source: The largest zoom (default 2).
trans-unit.target: 最大缩放比例（默认 2）。

trans-unit.source: The smallest zoom (default 0.25).
trans-unit.target: 最小缩放比例（默认 0.25）。

trans-unit.source: Below this width (default 520, as in Arc; 0 never) the canvas is narrow: cards shrink to 344 × 52 and 108 × 72, and a workflow the canvas arranged itself is arranged again with tighter spacing, so it stays readable on a phone instead of shrinking like a screenshot. Steps placed by your code keep their places.
trans-unit.target: 低于此宽度（默认 520，与 Arc 相同；0 表示从不）时画布为窄屏：卡片缩为 344 × 52 和 108 × 72，画布自己排布的工作流会以更紧凑的间距重新排布，在手机上依然清晰可读，而不是像截图一样缩小。由你的代码放置的步骤保持原位。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a step is opened: double-clicked, or Enter pressed on its card. Open its settings here.
trans-unit.target: 打开某个步骤时触发：双击它，或在其卡片上按 Enter。在这里打开它的设置。

trans-unit.source: The canvas point shown at the top-left corner of the view.
trans-unit.target: 显示在视图左上角的画布坐标点。

trans-unit.source: Whether a step that starts while the data is still drawing toward it keeps showing as waiting until the data arrives (default true), so a run reads step, edge, step as in Arc even when your run sets the next step running at once. Only what is shown waits; the steps' states are untouched. Full motion only.
trans-unit.target: 当数据仍在绘向某步骤时，该步骤即使已开始运行，是否仍显示为等待，直到数据到达（默认 true）。这样即使你的运行立即将下一步骤设为运行中，画面仍会按 Arc 的方式呈现步骤、连线、步骤的顺序。仅影响显示，步骤的状态不受影响。仅在完整动效下生效。

trans-unit.source: Raised once each time the selection changes, also when selected steps leave the workflow.
trans-unit.target: 选择每变化一次触发一次，包括选中的步骤离开工作流时。

trans-unit.source: Whether the dot grid shows (default true).
trans-unit.target: 是否显示点阵（默认 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether moved steps snap to the dot grid when let go (default true); holding Alt while dragging skips it.
trans-unit.target: 移动的步骤松手时是否吸附到点阵（默认 true）；拖动时按住 Alt 可跳过吸附。

trans-unit.source: What the wheel does (default `Pan`: scrolling pans, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel zooms; `ModifierZoom` leaves plain scrolling to the page).
trans-unit.target: 滚轮的作用（默认 `Pan`：滚动平移，Ctrl / ⌘ + 滚轮缩放；`ModifierZoom` 把普通滚动留给页面）。

trans-unit.source: Screen pixels per canvas unit; kept within `MinZoom` and `MaxZoom`.
trans-unit.target: 每个画布单位对应的屏幕像素数；保持在 `MinZoom` 与 `MaxZoom` 之间。

trans-unit.source: A connection dropped on the empty canvas, for `ConnectionDroppedOnCanvas`.
trans-unit.target: 拖放到空白画布上的连线，用于 `ConnectionDroppedOnCanvas`。

trans-unit.source: A connection a person is making, for `ConnectionRequested`.
trans-unit.target: 用户正在建立的连线，用于 `ConnectionRequested`。

trans-unit.source: A connection from one step of a `WorkflowGraph` to the next: the data of a run flows from `Source` to `Target`. The ends are fixed; to reconnect, remove the edge and add a new one.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowGraph` 中从一个步骤到下一个步骤的连接：运行的数据从 `Source` 流向 `Target`。两端固定；要重新连接，请移除该连线并添加新的连线。

trans-unit.source: How the edge shows the run. `Auto` (the default) follows its two steps, so a run only needs to set the steps' states.
trans-unit.target: 连线如何显示运行情况。`Auto`（默认）跟随其两端的步骤，因此运行只需设置步骤的状态即可。

trans-unit.source: One edit a person made on a `WorkflowCanvas`, for `GraphEdited`.
trans-unit.target: 用户在 `WorkflowCanvas` 上完成的一次编辑，用于 `GraphEdited`。

trans-unit.source: A workflow: its steps (`Nodes`) and the connections between them (`Edges`). Show it with a `WorkflowCanvas`; change the collections or any step and the canvas follows. Removing a step removes its edges; an edge whose steps are not in `Nodes` is refused.
trans-unit.target: 一个工作流：由其步骤（`Nodes`）和步骤之间的连接（`Edges`）组成。用 `WorkflowCanvas` 显示它；修改集合或任何步骤，画布都会随之更新。移除步骤时会一并移除其连线；两端步骤不在 `Nodes` 中的连线会被拒绝。

trans-unit.source: Whether a connection may close a loop (default false: people cannot connect a step to one before it).
trans-unit.target: 连线是否可以闭合成环（默认 false：用户不能将步骤连接到它之前的步骤）。

trans-unit.source: Undo and redo for the edits people make on a `WorkflowCanvas` showing the workflow: moving, deleting, connecting, disconnecting and pasting steps. Changes your code makes to the `WorkflowGraph` are recorded only inside `BeginGroup`. Keeps the last 100 edits.
trans-unit.target: 为用户在显示该工作流的 `WorkflowCanvas` 上所做的编辑提供撤销和重做：移动、删除、连接、断开连接和粘贴步骤。你的代码对 `WorkflowGraph` 所做的更改只在 `BeginGroup` 内记录。保留最近 100 次编辑。

trans-unit.source: Raised when what can be undone or redone changes.
trans-unit.target: 当可撤销或可重做的内容发生变化时触发。

trans-unit.source: A small map of a `WorkflowCanvas`: every step as a block (running and selected steps in the accent, failed ones in red) and the part the canvas shows as a frame. Press to move the view there, drag to pan. Set `Target` to the canvas and place the map over a corner, like `WorkflowZoomControls`. It is a pointer shortcut: the canvas's own keys do the same, so the map takes no focus and screen readers skip it.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowCanvas` 的小地图：把每个步骤画成一个方块（运行中和选中的步骤用强调色，失败的步骤用红色），并以一个框标出画布当前显示的区域。按下即可把视图移到该处，拖动则平移。将 `Target` 设为画布，并像 `WorkflowZoomControls` 一样把小地图放在某个角落。它只是指针快捷方式：画布自身的按键也能完成同样的操作，因此小地图不获取焦点，屏幕阅读器也会跳过它。

trans-unit.source: The canvas the map shows and moves.
trans-unit.target: 小地图显示并移动的画布。

trans-unit.source: One step of a `WorkflowGraph`: what it is (title, description, icon), where it sits on the canvas, and while a run goes through the workflow its state, result and time. Every property is observed, so changing a step updates the canvas.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowGraph` 中的一个步骤：它是什么（标题、描述、图标）、在画布上的位置，以及运行经过工作流时的状态、结果和耗时。每个属性都会被监听，因此修改步骤会更新画布。

trans-unit.source: One row (`Standard`) or two (`Compact`).
trans-unit.target: 一行（`Standard`）或两行（`Compact`）。

trans-unit.source: The line under the title while nothing has run yet: what the step works on ("Plan, seats and owner").
trans-unit.target: 尚未运行时位于标题下方的一行：说明该步骤处理的内容（例如 "Plan, seats and owner"）。

trans-unit.source: How long the step took; shown next to the check once it is done ("118 ms").
trans-unit.target: 步骤耗时；完成后显示在对勾旁边（例如 "118 ms"）。

trans-unit.source: Why the step failed; shown under the title in the failed state and read by screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 步骤失败的原因；在失败状态下显示在标题下方，并由屏幕阅读器朗读。

trans-unit.source: Whether the step has an implicit input when `Inputs` is empty (default true). Turn it off for a step nothing leads into, such as a trigger.
trans-unit.target: 当 `Inputs` 为空时，步骤是否具有隐式输入（默认 true）。对于没有任何连线指向它的步骤（例如触发器），请将其关闭。

trans-unit.source: The 20 × 20 mark at the start of the card: a Lucide geometry from `ArcIcons` (drawn as a stroke), an image, or any control.
trans-unit.target: 卡片起始处的 20 × 20 标记：来自 `ArcIcons` 的 Lucide 几何图形（以描边绘制）、图片或任意控件。

trans-unit.source: A locked step stays where it is and cannot be deleted on an editable canvas; it can still be selected and opened.
trans-unit.target: 锁定的步骤在可编辑画布上保持原位且不能删除，但仍可以被选择和打开。

trans-unit.source: Your own category of the step (trigger, action, condition); screen readers read it after the title.
trans-unit.target: 你自定义的步骤类别（如触发器、操作、条件）；屏幕阅读器在标题之后朗读它。

trans-unit.source: The card's top-left corner on the canvas. NaN (the default) lets the canvas place the step by arranging the whole workflow, and writes the place it chose back here.
trans-unit.target: 卡片在画布上的左上角位置。NaN（默认值）表示由画布通过排布整个工作流来放置该步骤，并将其选定的位置写回此处。

trans-unit.source: The line under the title once the step is done: what it found ("Enterprise, 212 seats"); null keeps the description.
trans-unit.target: 步骤完成后标题下方的一行：其发现的结果（例如 "Enterprise, 212 seats"）；为 null 时保留描述。

trans-unit.source: The card's size; null uses the size of its `Appearance` (300 × 60 or 200 × 84).
trans-unit.target: 卡片的尺寸；为 null 时使用其 `Appearance` 对应的尺寸（300 × 60 或 200 × 84）。

trans-unit.source: Where the step stands in the current run (`Idle` when there is no run).
trans-unit.target: 步骤在当前运行中所处的状态（没有运行时为 `Idle`）。

trans-unit.source: What the step does, on one line (it is cut with an ellipsis when it does not fit).
trans-unit.target: 步骤所做的事，占一行（放不下时以省略号截断）。

trans-unit.source: The card of one workflow step on a `WorkflowCanvas` (visual rules from Arc's free hero-section block, HeroRelay): icon, title, the description or result under it, and the run state at the end. A running card takes the accent, a skipped one fades, a failed one shows its error. The canvas creates one card per `WorkflowNode`; style it through the semantic part `arc.workflow.node`.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowCanvas` 上一个工作流步骤的卡片（视觉规则来自 Arc 免费的 hero 区块 HeroRelay）：图标、标题、其下的描述或结果，以及末尾的运行状态。运行中的卡片采用强调色，已跳过的卡片淡出，失败的卡片显示其错误。画布为每个 `WorkflowNode` 创建一张卡片；请通过语义部件 `arc.workflow.node` 为其设置样式。

trans-unit.source: Content for the card in place of its icon, title, subtitle and state, built from the `Node` when the template matches it (a `WorkflowNodeTemplate` matches a step's `Kind`). The frame, the run's colors, the selection and the focus ring stay. Without `Size` the card is as tall as its content. On a canvas, set `NodeTemplates` instead.
trans-unit.target: 卡片的内容替代其图标、标题、副标题和状态，由 `Node` 构建，在模板与之匹配时使用（`WorkflowNodeTemplate` 与步骤的 `Kind` 匹配）。框、运行状态的颜色、选中状态和焦点环保持不变。未设置 `Size` 时，卡片高度与其内容相同。在画布上，请改为设置 `NodeTemplates`。

trans-unit.source: The state the card shows. It is the step's `State`, except that on a canvas a step that starts while the data is still drawing toward it keeps showing `Pending` until the data arrives (`QueueRunVisuals`).
trans-unit.target: 卡片显示的状态。它与步骤的 `State` 相同，但在画布上，若某步骤在数据仍朝其绘制时开始，则会保持显示 `Pending`，直到数据到达（`QueueRunVisuals`）。

trans-unit.source: The step this card shows.
trans-unit.target: 此卡片所显示的步骤。

trans-unit.source: A step of a `WorkflowCanvas`, for `NodeActivated`.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowCanvas` 的一个步骤，用于 `NodeActivated`。

trans-unit.source: Content for the cards of one kind of step, written in XAML: put it in `NodeTemplates`. It matches the steps whose `Kind` is `Kind` (every step when null), and its content replaces the card's icon, title, subtitle and state; the data is the `WorkflowNode`. Write `x:DataType="arc:WorkflowNode"` on it for compiled bindings.
trans-unit.target: 为某一类步骤的卡片编写的内容，以 XAML 书写：将其放入 `NodeTemplates`。它匹配 `Kind` 为 `Kind` 的步骤（为 null 时匹配所有步骤），其内容替换卡片的图标、标题、副标题和状态；数据是 `WorkflowNode`。在其上写上 `x:DataType="arc:WorkflowNode"` 以使用编译绑定。

trans-unit.source: A named connection point of a `WorkflowNode`, such as the "Yes" and "No" outputs of a condition. A step without ports of a direction has one implicit port there (an edge's port is then null).
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowNode` 的一个命名连接点，例如条件步骤的 "Yes" 和 "No" 输出。若步骤在某个方向上没有端口，则该方向会有一个隐式端口（此时连线的端口为 null）。

trans-unit.source: Your name for the kind of data the port carries; two ports with a data type connect only when the types are the same (null connects to anything).
trans-unit.target: 你为端口所承载的数据种类指定的名称；两个带有数据类型的端口只有在类型相同时才能连接（null 可与任何类型连接）。

trans-unit.source: A short name shown next to the port, such as "Yes"; null shows none.
trans-unit.target: 显示在端口旁的简短名称，例如 "Yes"；为 null 时不显示。

trans-unit.source: How many edges the port takes (default no limit).
trans-unit.target: 端口可接入的连线数量（默认不限制）。

trans-unit.source: A change of a `WorkflowCanvas`'s selection, for `SelectionChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowCanvas` 选择的一次变化，用于 `SelectionChanged`。

trans-unit.source: A small zoom bar for a `WorkflowCanvas`: zoom out, the current zoom (click it for 100%), zoom in, and fit. Set `Target` to the canvas and place the bar where it suits, usually over a corner of the canvas. It matches the library's other zoom bars: a 34px pill with 28px buttons.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowCanvas` 的小型缩放条：缩小、当前缩放比例（点击可回到 100%）、放大和适配。把 `Target` 设为画布，再把缩放条放在合适的位置，通常是画布的一角。它与库中其他缩放条一致：34px 的胶囊，内含 28px 的按钮。

trans-unit.source: The canvas the buttons zoom.
trans-unit.target: 按钮所缩放的画布。
